verses.sa:
त्वां ह्यग्ने सदमित्समन्यवो देवासो देवमरतिं न्येरिर इति क्रत्वा न्येरिरे ।
अमर्त्यं यजत मर्त्येष्वा देवमादेवं जनत प्रचेतसं विश्वमादेवं जनत प्रचेतसम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyagne sadamitsamanyavo devaso devamaratim nyerira iti kratva nyerire |
amartyam yajata martyeshva devamadevam janata prachetasam vishvamadevam janata prachetasam ||
verses.en:
THEE Agni, have the Gods, ever of one accord, sent hither down, a God, appointed messenger, yea, with their wisdom sent thee down.
The Immortal, O thou Holy One, mid mortal men, the God-devoted God, the wise, have they brought forth, brought forth the omnipresent God-devoted Sage.

verses.sa:
स भ्रातरं वरुणमग्न आ ववृत्स्व देवाँ अच्छा सुमती यज्ञवनसं ज्येष्ठं यज्ञवनसम् ।
ऋतावानमादित्यं चर्षणीधृतं राजानं चर्षणीधृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa bhrataram varunamagna a vavritsva devan achchha sumati yajnavanasam jyeshtham yajnavanasam |
ritavanamadityam charshanidhritam rajanam charshanidhritam ||
verses.en:
As such, O Agni, bring with favour to the Gods thy Brother Varuna who loveth sacrifice,
True to the Law, the Aditya who supporteth men, the King, supporter of mankind.

verses.sa:
सखे सखायमभ्या ववृत्स्वाशुं न चक्रं रथ्येव रंह्यास्मभ्यं दस्म रंह्या ।
अग्ने मृळीकं वरुणे सचा विदो मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु ।
तोकाय तुजे शुशुचान शं कृध्यस्मभ्यं दस्म शं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sakhe sakhayamabhya vavritsvashum na chakram rathyeva ramhyasmabhyam dasma ramhya |
agne mrilikam varune sacha vido marutsu vishvabhanushu |
tokaya tuje shushuchana sham kridhyasmabhyam dasma sham kridhi ||
verses.en:
Do thou, O Friend, turn hither him who is our Friend, swift as a wheel, like two car-steeds in rapid course, Wondrous! to us in rapid course.
O Agni, find thou grace for us with Varuna, with Maruts who illumine all.
Bless us, thou Radiant One, for seed and progeny, yea, bless us, O thou Wondrous God.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने वरुणस्य विद्वान्देवस्य हेळोऽव यासिसीष्ठाः ।
यजिष्ठो वह्नितमः शोशुचानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne varunasya vidvandevasya helo'va yasisishthah |
yajishtho vahnitamah shoshuchano vishva dveshamsi pra mumugdhyasmat ||
verses.en:
Do thou who knowest Varuna, O Agni, put far away from us the God's displeasure.
Best Sacrificer, brightest One, refulgent remove thou far from us all those who hate us.

verses.sa:
स त्वं नो अग्नेऽवमो भवोती नेदिष्ठो अस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ ।
अव यक्ष्व नो वरुणं रराणो वीहि मृळीकं सुहवो न एधि ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam no agne'vamo bhavoti nedishtho asya ushaso vyushtau |
ava yakshva no varunam rarano vihi mrilikam suhavo na edhi ||
verses.en:
Be thou, O Agni, nearest us with succour, our closest Friend while now this Morn is breaking.
Reconcile to us Varuna, be bounteous enjoy the gracious juice; be swift to hear us.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्रेष्ठा सुभगस्य संदृग्देवस्य चित्रतमा मर्त्येषु ।
शुचि घृतं न तप्तमघ्न्याया स्पार्हा देवस्य मंहनेव धेनोः ॥
verses.rom:
asya shreshtha subhagasya samdrigdevasya chitratama martyeshu |
shuchi ghritam na taptamaghnyaya sparha devasya mamhaneva dhenoh ||
verses.en:
Excellent is the glance, of brightest splendour, which the auspicious God bestows on mortals-
The God's glance, longed-for even as the butter, pure, heated, of the cow, the milch-cow's bounty.

verses.sa:
त्रिरस्य ता परमा सन्ति सत्या स्पार्हा देवस्य जनिमान्यग्नेः ।
अनन्ते अन्तः परिवीत आगाच्छुचिः शुक्रो अर्यो रोरुचानः ॥
verses.rom:
trirasya ta parama santi satya sparha devasya janimanyagneh |
anante antah parivita agachchhuchih shukro aryo roruchanah ||
verses.en:
Three are those births, the true, the most exalted, eagerly longed-for, of the God, of Agni.
He came invested in the boundless region, pure, radiant, friendly, mightily resplendent.

verses.sa:
स दूतो विश्वेदभि वष्टि सद्मा होता हिरण्यरथो रंसुजिह्वः ।
रोहिदश्वो वपुष्यो विभावा सदा रण्वः पितुमतीव संसत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa duto vishvedabhi vashti sadma hota hiranyaratho ramsujihvah |
rohidashvo vapushyo vibhava sada ranvah pitumativa samsat ||
verses.en:
This envoy joyeth in all seats of worship, borne on his golden car, sweet-tongued Invoker:
Lovely to look on, with red steeds, effulgent, like a feast rich in food, joyous for ever.

verses.sa:
स चेतयन्मनुषो यज्ञबन्धुः प्र तं मह्या रशनया नयन्ति ।
स क्षेत्यस्य दुर्यासु साधन्देवो मर्तस्य सधनित्वमाप ॥
verses.rom:
sa chetayanmanusho yajnabandhuh pra tam mahya rashanaya nayanti |
sa kshetyasya duryasu sadhandevo martasya sadhanitvamapa ||
verses.en:
Allied by worship, let him give man knowledge: by an extended cord they lead him onward.
He stays, effectual in this mortal's dwelling, and the God wins a share in his possessions.

verses.sa:
स तू नो अग्निर्नयतु प्रजानन्नच्छा रत्नं देवभक्तं यदस्य ।
धिया यद्विश्वे अमृता अकृण्वन्द्यौष्पिता जनिता सत्यमुक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu no agnirnayatu prajanannachchha ratnam devabhaktam yadasya |
dhiya yadvishve amrita akrinvandyaushpita janita satyamukshan ||
verses.en:
Let Agni -for he knows the way- conduct us to all that he enjoys of God-sent riches,
What all the Immortals have prepared with wisdom, Dyaus, Sire, Begetter, raining down true blessings.

verses.sa:
स जायत प्रथमः पस्त्यासु महो बुध्ने रजसो अस्य योनौ ।
अपादशीर्षा गुहमानो अन्तायोयुवानो वृषभस्य नीळे ॥
verses.rom:
sa jayata prathamah pastyasu maho budhne rajaso asya yonau |
apadashirsha guhamano antayoyuvano vrishabhasya nile ||
verses.en:
In houses first he sprang into existence, at great heaven's base, and in this region's bosom;
Footless and headless, both his ends concealing, in his Bull's lair drawing himself together.

verses.sa:
प्र शर्ध आर्त प्रथमं विपन्यँ ऋतस्य योना वृषभस्य नीळे ।
स्पार्हो युवा वपुष्यो विभावा सप्त प्रियासोऽजनयन्त वृष्णे ॥
verses.rom:
pra shardha arta prathamam vipanyan ritasya yona vrishabhasya nile |
sparho yuva vapushyo vibhava sapta priyaso'janayanta vrishne ||
verses.en:
Wondrously first he rose aloft, defiant, in the Bull's lair, the home of holy Order,
Longed-for, young, beautiful, and far-resplendent: and seven dear friends sprang up unto the Mighty.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमत्र पितरो मनुष्या अभि प्र सेदुरृतमाशुषाणाः ।
अश्मव्रजाः सुदुघा वव्रे अन्तरुदुस्रा आजन्नुषसो हुवानाः ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamatra pitaro manushya abhi pra sedurritamashushanah |
ashmavrajah sudugha vavre antarudusra ajannushaso huvanah ||
verses.en:
Here did our human fathers take their places, fain to fulfil the sacred Law of worship.
Forth drave they, with loud call, Dawn's teeming Milch-kine bid in the mountain stable, in the cavern.

verses.sa:
ते मर्मृजत ददृवांसो अद्रिं तदेषामन्ये अभितो वि वोचन् ।
पश्वयन्त्रासो अभि कारमर्चन्विदन्त ज्योतिश्चकृपन्त धीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
te marmrijata dadrivamso adrim tadeshamanye abhito vi vochan |
pashvayantraso abhi karamarchanvidanta jyotishchakripanta dhibhih ||
verses.en:
Splendid were they when they had rent the mountain: others, around, shall tell forth this their exploit.
They sang their song, prepared to free the cattle: they found the light; with holy hymns they worshipped.

verses.sa:
ते गव्यता मनसा दृध्रमुब्धं गा येमानं परि षन्तमद्रिम् ।
दृळ्हं नरो वचसा दैव्येन व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः ॥
verses.rom:
te gavyata manasa dridhramubdham ga yemanam pari shantamadrim |
drilham naro vachasa daivyena vrajam gomantamushijo vi vavruh ||
verses.en:
Eager, with thought intent upon the booty, the men with their celestial speech threw open,
The solid mountain firm, compact, enclosing, confining Cows, the stable full of cattle.

verses.sa:
ते मन्वत प्रथमं नाम धेनोस्त्रिः सप्त मातुः परमाणि विन्दन् ।
तज्जानतीरभ्यनूषत व्रा आविर्भुवदरुणीर्यशसा गोः ॥
verses.rom:
te manvata prathamam nama dhenostrih sapta matuh paramani vindan |
tajjanatirabhyanushata vra avirbhuvadaruniryashasa goh ||
verses.en:
The Milch-cow's earliest name they comprehended: they found the Mother's thrice-seven noblest titles.
This the bands knew, and sent forth acclamation: with the Bull's sheen the Red One was apparent.

verses.sa:
नेशत्तमो दुधितं रोचत द्यौरुद्देव्या उषसो भानुरर्त ।
आ सूर्यो बृहतस्तिष्ठदज्राँ ऋजु मर्तेषु वृजिना च पश्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
neshattamo dudhitam rochata dyauruddevya ushaso bhanurarta |
a suryo brihatastishthadajran riju marteshu vrijina cha pashyan ||
verses.en:
The turbid darkness fled, the heaven was splendid! up rose the bright beam of celestial Morning.
Surya ascended to the wide expanses, beholding deeds of men both good and evil.

verses.sa:
आदित्पश्चा बुबुधाना व्यख्यन्नादिद्रत्नं धारयन्त द्युभक्तम् ।
विश्वे विश्वासु दुर्यासु देवा मित्र धिये वरुण सत्यमस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
aditpashcha bubudhana vyakhyannadidratnam dharayanta dyubhaktam |
vishve vishvasu duryasu deva mitra dhiye varuna satyamastu ||
verses.en:
Then, afterwards they looked around, awakened, when first they held that Heaven allotted treasure.
Now all the Gods abide in all their dwellings. Varuna, Mitra, be the prayer effective.

verses.sa:
अच्छा वोचेय शुशुचानमग्निं होतारं विश्वभरसं यजिष्ठम् ।
शुच्यूधो अतृणन्न गवामन्धो न पूतं परिषिक्तमंशोः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha vocheya shushuchanamagnim hotaram vishvabharasam yajishtham |
shuchyudho atrinanna gavamandho na putam parishiktamamshoh ||
verses.en:
I will call hither brightly-beaming Agni, the Herald, all-supporting, best at worship.
He hath disclosed, like the milch cows' pure udder, the Sorria's juice when cleansed and poured from beakers.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषामदितिर्यज्ञियानां विश्वेषामतिथिर्मानुषाणाम् ।
अग्निर्देवानामव आवृणानः सुमृळीको भवतु जातवेदाः ॥
verses.rom:
vishveshamaditiryajniyanam vishveshamatithirmanushanam |
agnirdevanamava avrinanah sumriliko bhavatu jatavedah ||
verses.en:
The freest God of all who should be worshipped, the guest who is received in all men's houses,
Agni who hath secured the Gods' high favour,-may he be gracious, to us Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
यो मर्त्येष्वमृत ऋतावा देवो देवेष्वरतिर्निधायि ।
होता यजिष्ठो मह्ना शुचध्यै हव्यैरग्निर्मनुष ईरयध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
yo martyeshvamrita ritava devo deveshvaratirnidhayi |
hota yajishtho mahna shuchadhyai havyairagnirmanusha irayadhyai ||
verses.en:
THE, Faithful One, Immortal among mortals, a God among the Gods, appointed envoy,
Priest, best at worship, must shine forth in glory . Agni shall be raised high with man's oblations.

verses.sa:
इह त्वं सूनो सहसो नो अद्य जातो जाताँ उभयाँ अन्तरग्ने ।
दूत ईयसे युयुजान ऋष्व ऋजुमुष्कान्वृषणः शुक्राँश्च ॥
verses.rom:
iha tvam suno sahaso no adya jato jatan ubhayan antaragne |
duta iyase yuyujana rishva rijumushkanvrishanah shukranshcha ||
verses.en:
Born for us here this day, O Son of Vigour, between both races of born beings, Agni,
Thou farest as an envoy, having harnessed, Sublime One! thy strong-muscled radiant stallions.

verses.sa:
अत्या वृधस्नू रोहिता घृतस्नू ऋतस्य मन्ये मनसा जविष्ठा ।
अन्तरीयसे अरुषा युजानो युष्माँश्च देवान्विश आ च मर्तान् ॥
verses.rom:
atya vridhasnu rohita ghritasnu ritasya manye manasa javishtha |
antariyase arusha yujano yushmanshcha devanvisha a cha martan ||
verses.en:
I laud the ruddy steeds who pour down blessing, dropping oil, fleetest through the thoualit of Order.
Yoking red horses to and fro thou goest between you Deities and mortal races.

verses.sa:
अर्यमणं वरुणं मित्रमेषामिन्द्राविष्णू मरुतो अश्विनोत ।
स्वश्वो अग्ने सुरथः सुराधा एदु वह सुहविषे जनाय ॥
verses.rom:
aryamanam varunam mitrameshamindravishnu maruto ashvinota |
svashvo agne surathah suradha edu vaha suhavishe janaya ||
verses.en:
Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna, and Indra with Visnu, of the Gods, Maruts and Asvins-
These, Agni, with good car and steeds, bring hither, most bountiful, to folk with fair oblations.

verses.sa:
गोमाँ अग्नेऽविमाँ अश्वी यज्ञो नृवत्सखा सदमिदप्रमृष्यः ।
इळावाँ एषो असुर प्रजावान्दीर्घो रयिः पृथुबुध्नः सभावान् ॥
verses.rom:
goman agne'viman ashvi yajno nrivatsakha sadamidapramrishyah |
ilavan esho asura prajavandirgho rayih prithubudhnah sabhavan ||
verses.en:
Agni, be this our sacrifice eternal, with brave friends, rich in kine and sheep and horses,
Rich, Asura! in sacred food and children, in full assembly, wealth broad-based and during.

verses.sa:
यस्त इध्मं जभरत्सिष्विदानो मूर्धानं वा ततपते त्वाया ।
भुवस्तस्य स्वतवाँः पायुरग्ने विश्वस्मात्सीमघायत उरुष्य ॥
verses.rom:
yasta idhmam jabharatsishvidano murdhanam va tatapate tvaya |
bhuvastasya svatavanh payuragne vishvasmatsimaghayata urushya ||
verses.en:
The man who, sweating, brings for thee the fuel, and makes his head to ache, thy faithful servant,-
Agni, to him be a self-strong Protector guard him from all who seek to do him mischief.

verses.sa:
यस्ते भरादन्नियते चिदन्नं निशिषन्मन्द्रमतिथिमुदीरत् ।
आ देवयुरिनधते दुरोणे तस्मिन्रयिर्ध्रुवो अस्तु दास्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste bharadanniyate chidannam nishishanmandramatithimudirat |
a devayurinadhate durone tasminrayirdhruvo astu dasvan ||
verses.en:
Who brings thee food, though thou hast food in plenty, welcomes his cheerful guest and speeds him onward,
Who kindles thee devoutly in his dwelling to him be wealth secure and freely giving.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा दोषा य उषसि प्रशंसात्प्रियं वा त्वा कृणवते हविष्मान् ।
अश्वो न स्वे दम आ हेम्यावान्तमंहसः पीपरो दाश्वांसम् ॥
verses.rom:
yastva dosha ya ushasi prashamsatpriyam va tva krinavate havishman |
ashvo na sve dama a hemyavantamamhasah piparo dashvamsam ||
verses.en:
Whoso sings praise to thee at eve or morning, and, with oblation, doth the thing thou lovest,-
In his own home, even as a gold-girt courser, rescue him from distress, the bounteous giver.

verses.sa:
यस्तुभ्यमग्ने अमृताय दाशद्दुवस्त्वे कृणवते यतस्रुक् ।
न स राया शशमानो वि योषन्नैनमंहः परि वरदघायोः ॥
verses.rom:
yastubhyamagne amritaya dashadduvastve krinavate yatasruk |
na sa raya shashamano vi yoshannainamamhah pari varadaghayoh ||
verses.en:
Whoso brings gifts to thee Immortal, Agni, and doth thee service with uplifted ladle,-
Let him not, sorely toiling, lose his riches; let not the sinner's wickedness enclose him.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्वमग्ने अध्वरं जुजोषो देवो मर्तस्य सुधितं रराणः ।
प्रीतेदसद्धोत्रा सा यविष्ठासाम यस्य विधतो वृधासः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tvamagne adhvaram jujosho devo martasya sudhitam raranah |
pritedasaddhotra sa yavishthasama yasya vidhato vridhasah ||
verses.en:
Whose well-wrought worship thou acceptest, Agni, thou God a mortal's gift, thou liberal Giver,-
Dear be his sacrifice to thee, Most Youthful! and may we strengthen him when he adores thee.

verses.sa:
चित्तिमचित्तिं चिनवद्वि विद्वान्पृष्ठेव वीता वृजिना च मर्तान् ।
राये च नः स्वपत्याय देव दितिं च रास्वादितिमुरुष्य ॥
verses.rom:
chittimachittim chinavadvi vidvanprishtheva vita vrijina cha martan |
raye cha nah svapatyaya deva ditim cha rasvaditimurushya ||
verses.en:
May he who knows distinguish sense and folly of men, like straight and crooked backs of horses.
Lead us, O God, to wealth and noble offspring: keep penury afar and grant us plenty.

verses.sa:
कविं शशासुः कवयोऽदब्धा निधारयन्तो दुर्यास्वायोः ।
अतस्त्वं दृश्याँ अग्न एतान्पड्भिः पश्येरद्भुताँ अर्य एवैः ॥
verses.rom:
kavim shashasuh kavayo'dabdha nidharayanto duryasvayoh |
atastvam drishyan agna etanpadbhih pashyeradbhutan arya evaih ||
verses.en:
This Sage the Sages, ne'er deceived, commanded, setting him down in dwellings of the living.
Hence mayst thou, friendly God, with rapid footsteps behold the Gods, wonderful, fair to look on.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वाघते सुप्रणीतिः सुतसोमाय विधते यविष्ठ ।
रत्नं भर शशमानाय घृष्वे पृथु श्चन्द्रमवसे चर्षणिप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vaghate supranitih sutasomaya vidhate yavishtha |
ratnam bhara shashamanaya ghrishve prithu shchandramavase charshaniprah ||
verses.en:
Good guidance hast thou for the priest, O Agni, who, Youngest God! with outpoured Soma serves thee.
Ruler of men, thou joyous God, bring treasure splendid and plentiful to aid the toiler.

verses.sa:
अधा ह यद्वयमग्ने त्वाया पड्भिर्हस्तेभिश्चकृमा तनूभिः ।
रथं न क्रन्तो अपसा भुरिजोरृतं येमुः सुध्य आशुषाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
adha ha yadvayamagne tvaya padbhirhastebhishchakrima tanubhih |
ratham na kranto apasa bhurijorritam yemuh sudhya ashushanah ||
verses.en:
Now all that we, thy faithful servants, Agni, have done with feet, with hands, and with our bodies,
The wise, with toil, the holy rite have guided, as those who frame a car with manual cunning.

verses.sa:
अधा मातुरुषसः सप्त विप्रा जायेमहि प्रथमा वेधसो नॄन् ।
दिवस्पुत्रा अङ्गिरसो भवेमाद्रिं रुजेम धनिनं शुचन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
adha maturushasah sapta vipra jayemahi prathama vedhaso nrin |
divasputra angiraso bhavemadrim rujema dhaninam shuchantah ||
verses.en:
May we, seven sages first in rank, engender, from Dawn the Mother, men to be ordainers.
May we, Angirases, be sons of Heaven, and, radiant, burst the wealth-containing mountain.

verses.sa:
अधा यथा नः पितरः परासः प्रत्नासो अग्न ऋतमाशुषाणाः ।
शुचीदयन्दीधितिमुक्थशासः क्षामा भिन्दन्तो अरुणीरप व्रन् ॥
verses.rom:
adha yatha nah pitarah parasah pratnaso agna ritamashushanah |
shuchidayandidhitimukthashasah kshama bhindanto arunirapa vran ||
verses.en:
As in the days of old our ancient Fathers, speeding the work of holy worship, Agni,
Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises; they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent.

verses.sa:
सुकर्माणः सुरुचो देवयन्तोऽयो न देवा जनिमा धमन्तः ।
शुचन्तो अग्निं ववृधन्त इन्द्रमूर्वं गव्यं परिषदन्तो अग्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
sukarmanah surucho devayanto'yo na deva janima dhamantah |
shuchanto agnim vavridhanta indramurvam gavyam parishadanto agman ||
verses.en:
Gods, doing holy acts, devout, resplendent, smelting like ore their human generations.
Enkindling Agni and exalting Indra, they came encompassing the stall of cattle.

verses.sa:
आ यूथेव क्षुमति पश्वो अख्यद्देवानां यज्जनिमान्त्युग्र ।
मर्तानां चिदुर्वशीरकृप्रन्वृधे चिदर्य उपरस्यायोः ॥
verses.rom:
a yutheva kshumati pashvo akhyaddevanam yajjanimantyugra |
martanam chidurvashirakripranvridhe chidarya uparasyayoh ||
verses.en:
Strong One! he marked them-and the Gods before them-like herds of cattle in a foodful pasture.
There they moaned forth their strong desire for mortals, to aid the True, the nearest One, the Living.

verses.sa:
अकर्म ते स्वपसो अभूम ऋतमवस्रन्नुषसो विभातीः ।
अनूनमग्निं पुरुधा सुश्चन्द्रं देवस्य मर्मृजतश्चारु चक्षुः ॥
verses.rom:
akarma te svapaso abhuma ritamavasrannushaso vibhatih |
anunamagnim purudha sushchandram devasya marmrijatashcharu chakshuh ||
verses.en:
We have worked for thee, we have laboured nobly-bright Dawns have shed their light upon our worship-
Adding a beauty to the perfect Agni, and the God's beauteous eye that shines for ever.

verses.sa:
एता ते अग्न उचथानि वेधोऽवोचाम कवये ता जुषस्व ।
उच्छोचस्व कृणुहि वस्यसो नो महो रायः पुरुवार प्र यन्धि ॥
verses.rom:
eta te agna uchathani vedho'vochama kavaye ta jushasva |
uchchhochasva krinuhi vasyaso no maho rayah puruvara pra yandhi ||
verses.en:
Agni, Disposer, we have sung these praises to thee the Wise: do thou accept them gladly.
Blaze up on high and ever make us richer. Give us great wealth, O thou whose boons are many.

verses.sa:
आ वो राजानमध्वरस्य रुद्रं होतारं सत्ययजं रोदस्योः ।
अग्निं पुरा तनयित्नोरचित्ताद्धिरण्यरूपमवसे कृणुध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vo rajanamadhvarasya rudram hotaram satyayajam rodasyoh |
agnim pura tanayitnorachittaddhiranyarupamavase krinudhvam ||
verses.en:
WIN, to assist you, Rudra, Lord of worship, Priest of both worlds, effectual Sacrificer,
Agni, invested with his golden colours, before the thunder strike and lay you senseless.

verses.sa:
अयं योनिश्चकृमा यं वयं ते जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः ।
अर्वाचीनः परिवीतो नि षीदेमा उ ते स्वपाक प्रतीचीः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yonishchakrima yam vayam te jayeva patya ushati suvasah |
arvachinah parivito ni shidema u te svapaka pratichih ||
verses.en:
This shrine have we made ready for thy coming, as the fond dame attires her for her husband.
Performer of good work, sit down before us, invested while these flames incline to meet thee.

verses.sa:
आशृण्वते अदृपिताय मन्म नृचक्षसे सुमृळीकाय वेधः ।
देवाय शस्तिममृताय शंस ग्रावेव सोता मधुषुद्यमीळे ॥
verses.rom:
ashrinvate adripitaya manma nrichakshase sumrilikaya vedhah |
devaya shastimamritaya shamsa graveva sota madhushudyamile ||
verses.en:
A hymn, O Priest, to him who hears, the gentle, to him who looks on men, exceeding gracious,
A song of praise sing to the God Immortal, whom the stone, presser of the sweet juice, worships.

verses.sa:
त्वं चिन्नः शम्या अग्ने अस्या ऋतस्य बोध्यृतचित्स्वाधीः ।
कदा त उक्था सधमाद्यानि कदा भवन्ति सख्या गृहे ते ॥
verses.rom:
tvam chinnah shamya agne asya ritasya bodhyritachitsvadhih |
kada ta uktha sadhamadyani kada bhavanti sakhya grihe te ||
verses.en:
Even as true knower of the Law, O Agni, to this our solemn rite he thou attentive.
When shall thy songs of festival be sung thee? When is thy friendship shown within our dwelling?

verses.sa:
कथा ह तद्वरुणाय त्वमग्ने कथा दिवे गर्हसे कन्न आगः ।
कथा मित्राय मीळ्हुषे पृथिव्यै ब्रवः कदर्यम्णे कद्भगाय ॥
verses.rom:
katha ha tadvarunaya tvamagne katha dive garhase kanna agah |
katha mitraya milhushe prithivyai bravah kadaryamne kadbhagaya ||
verses.en:
Why this complaint to Varuna, O Agni? And why to Heaven? for what is our transgression?
How wilt thou speak to Earth and bounteous Mitra? What wilt thou say to Aryaman and Bhaga?

verses.sa:
कद्धिष्ण्यासु वृधसानो अग्ने कद्वाताय प्रतवसे शुभंये ।
परिज्मने नासत्याय क्षे ब्रवः कदग्ने रुद्राय नृघ्ने ॥
verses.rom:
kaddhishnyasu vridhasano agne kadvataya pratavase shubhamye |
parijmane nasatyaya kshe bravah kadagne rudraya nrighne ||
verses.en:
What, when thou blazest on the lesser altars, what to the mighty Wind who comes to bless us,
True, circumambient? what to Earth, O Agni, what wilt thou say to man-destroying Rudra?

verses.sa:
कथा महे पुष्टिम्भराय पूष्णे कद्रुद्राय सुमखाय हविर्दे ।
कद्विष्णव उरुगायाय रेतो ब्रवः कदग्ने शरवे बृहत्यै ॥
verses.rom:
katha mahe pushtimbharaya pushne kadrudraya sumakhaya havirde |
kadvishnava urugayaya reto bravah kadagne sharave brihatyai ||
verses.en:
How to great Pusan who promotes our welfare,- to honoured Rudra what, who gives oblations?
What sin of ours to the far-striding Visnu, what, Agni, wilt thou tell the Lofty Arrow.

verses.sa:
कथा शर्धाय मरुतामृताय कथा सूरे बृहते पृच्छ्यमानः ।
प्रति ब्रवोऽदितये तुराय साधा दिवो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
katha shardhaya marutamritaya katha sure brihate prichchhyamanah |
prati bravo'ditaye turaya sadha divo jatavedashchikitvan ||
verses.en:
What wilt thou tell the truthful band of Maruts, how answer the great Sun when thou art questioned?
Before the Free, before the Swift, defend us: fulfil heaven's work, all-knowing Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन ऋतं नियतमीळ आ गोरामा सचा मधुमत्पक्वमग्ने ।
कृष्णा सती रुशता धासिनैषा जामर्येण पयसा पीपाय ॥
verses.rom:
ritena ritam niyatamila a gorama sacha madhumatpakvamagne |
krishna sati rushata dhasinaisha jamaryena payasa pipaya ||
verses.en:
I crave the cow's true gift arranged by Order: though raw, she hath the sweet ripe juice, O Agni.
Though she is black of hue with milk she teemeth, nutritious, brightly shining, all-sustaining.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन हि ष्मा वृषभश्चिदक्तः पुमाँ अग्निः पयसा पृष्ठ्येन ।
अस्पन्दमानो अचरद्वयोधा वृषा शुक्रं दुदुहे पृश्निरूधः ॥
verses.rom:
ritena hi shma vrishabhashchidaktah puman agnih payasa prishthyena |
aspandamano acharadvayodha vrisha shukram duduhe prishnirudhah ||
verses.en:
Agni the Bull, the manly, hath been sprinkled with oil upon his back, by Law eternal.
He who gives vital power goes on unswerving. Prsni the Bull hath milked the pure white udder.

verses.sa:
ऋतेनाद्रिं व्यसन्भिदन्तः समङ्गिरसो नवन्त गोभिः ।
शुनं नरः परि षदन्नुषासमाविः स्वरभवज्जाते अग्नौ ॥
verses.rom:
ritenadrim vyasanbhidantah samangiraso navanta gobhih |
shunam narah pari shadannushasamavih svarabhavajjate agnau ||
verses.en:
By Law the Angirases cleft the rock asunder, and sang their hymns together with the cattle.
Bringing great bliss the men encompassed Morning: light was apparent at the birth of Agni.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन देवीरमृता अमृक्ता अर्णोभिरापो मधुमद्भिरग्ने ।
वाजी न सर्गेषु प्रस्तुभानः प्र सदमित्स्रवितवे दधन्युः ॥
verses.rom:
ritena deviramrita amrikta arnobhirapo madhumadbhiragne |
vaji na sargeshu prastubhanah pra sadamitsravitave dadhanyuh ||
verses.en:
By Law the Immortal Goddesses the Waters, with meath-rich waves, O Agni, and uninjured,
Like a strong courser lauded in his running, sped to flow onward swiftly and for ever.

verses.sa:
मा कस्य यक्षं सदमिद्धुरो गा मा वेशस्य प्रमिनतो मापेः ।
मा भ्रातुरग्ने अनृजोरृणं वेर्मा सख्युर्दक्षं रिपोर्भुजेम ॥
verses.rom:
ma kasya yaksham sadamiddhuro ga ma veshasya praminato mapeh |
ma bhraturagne anrijorrinam verma sakhyurdaksham riporbhujema ||
verses.en:
Go never to the feast of one who harms us, the treacherous neighbour or. unworthy kinsman.
Punish us not for a false brother's trespass. Let us riot feel the might of friend or foeman.

verses.sa:
रक्षा णो अग्ने तव रक्षणेभी रारक्षाणः सुमख प्रीणानः ।
प्रति ष्फुर वि रुज वीड्वंहो जहि रक्षो महि चिद्वावृधानम् ॥
verses.rom:
raksha no agne tava rakshanebhi rarakshanah sumakha prinanah |
prati shphura vi ruja vidvamho jahi raksho mahi chidvavridhanam ||
verses.en:
O Agni, keep us safe with thy protection, loving us, honoured God! and ever guarding.
Beat thou away, destroy severe affliction slay e'en the demon when he waxes mighty.

verses.sa:
एभिर्भव सुमना अग्ने अर्कैरिमान्स्पृश मन्मभिः शूर वाजान् ।
उत ब्रह्माण्यङ्गिरो जुषस्व सं ते शस्तिर्देववाता जरेत ॥
verses.rom:
ebhirbhava sumana agne arkairimansprisha manmabhih shura vajan |
uta brahmanyangiro jushasva sam te shastirdevavata jareta ||
verses.en:
Through these our songs of praise be gracious, Agni; moved by ourprayers, O Hero, touch our viands.
Accept, O Angiras, these our devotions, and let the praise which Gods desire address thee.

verses.sa:
एता विश्वा विदुषे तुभ्यं वेधो नीथान्यग्ने निण्या वचांसि ।
निवचना कवये काव्यान्यशंसिषं मतिभिर्विप्र उक्थैः ॥
verses.rom:
eta vishva vidushe tubhyam vedho nithanyagne ninya vachamsi |
nivachana kavaye kavyanyashamsisham matibhirvipra ukthaih ||
verses.en:
To thee who knowest, Agni, thou Disposer, all these wise secret speeches have I uttered,
Sung to thee, Sage, the charming words of wisdom, to thee, O Singer, with. my thoughts and Praises.

verses.sa:
कृणुष्व पाजः प्रसितिं न पृथ्वीं याहि राजेवामवाँ इभेन ।
तृष्वीमनु प्रसितिं द्रूणानोऽस्तासि विध्य रक्षसस्तपिष्ठैः ॥
verses.rom:
krinushva pajah prasitim na prithvim yahi rajevamavan ibhena |
trishvimanu prasitim drunano'stasi vidhya rakshasastapishthaih ||
verses.en:
PUT forth like a wide-spreading net thy vigour; go like a mighty King with his attendants.
Thou, following thy swift net, shootest arrows: transfix the fiends with darts that burn most fiercely.

verses.sa:
तव भ्रमास आशुया पतन्त्यनु स्पृश धृषता शोशुचानः ।
तपूंष्यग्ने जुह्वा पतंगानसंदितो वि सृज विष्वगुल्काः ॥
verses.rom:
tava bhramasa ashuya patantyanu sprisha dhrishata shoshuchanah |
tapumshyagne juhva patamganasamdito vi srija vishvagulkah ||
verses.en:
Forth go in rapid flight thy whirling weapons: follow them closely, glowing in thy fury.
Spread with thy tongue the winged flames, O Agni; unfettered, cast thy firebrands all around thee.

verses.sa:
प्रति स्पशो वि सृज तूर्णितमो भवा पायुर्विशो अस्या अदब्धः ।
यो नो दूरे अघशंसो यो अन्त्यग्ने माकिष्टे व्यथिरा दधर्षीत् ॥
verses.rom:
prati spasho vi srija turnitamo bhava payurvisho asya adabdhah |
yo no dure aghashamso yo antyagne makishte vyathira dadharshit ||
verses.en:
Send thy spies forward, fleetest in thy motion; be, ne'er deceived, the guardian of this people
From him who, near or far, is bent on evil, and let no trouble sent from thee o'ercome us.

verses.sa:
उदग्ने तिष्ठ प्रत्या तनुष्व न्यमित्राँ ओषतात्तिग्महेते ।
यो नो अरातिं समिधान चक्रे नीचा तं धक्ष्यतसं न शुष्कम् ॥
verses.rom:
udagne tishtha pratya tanushva nyamitran oshatattigmahete |
yo no aratim samidhana chakre nicha tam dhakshyatasam na shushkam ||
verses.en:
Rise up, O Agni, spread thee out before us: burn down our foes, thou who hast sharpened arrows.
Him, blazing Agni! who hath worked us mischief, consume thou utterly like dried-up stubble.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो भव प्रति विध्याध्यस्मदाविष्कृणुष्व दैव्यान्यग्ने ।
अव स्थिरा तनुहि यातुजूनां जामिमजामिं प्र मृणीहि शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo bhava prati vidhyadhyasmadavishkrinushva daivyanyagne |
ava sthira tanuhi yatujunam jamimajamim pra mrinihi shatrun ||
verses.en:
Rise, Agni, drive off those who fight against us: make manifest thine own celestial vigour.
Slacken the strong bows of the demon driven: destroy our foemen whether kin or stranger.

verses.sa:
स ते जानाति सुमतिं यविष्ठ य ईवते ब्रह्मणे गातुमैरत् ।
विश्वान्यस्मै सुदिनानि रायो द्युम्नान्यर्यो वि दुरो अभि द्यौत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa te janati sumatim yavishtha ya ivate brahmane gatumairat |
vishvanyasmai sudinani rayo dyumnanyaryo vi duro abhi dyaut ||
verses.en:
Most Youthful God, he knoweth well thy favour who gave an impulse to this high devotion.
All fair days and magnificence of riches hast thou beamed forth upon the good man's portals.

verses.sa:
सेदग्ने अस्तु सुभगः सुदानुर्यस्त्वा नित्येन हविषा य उक्थैः ।
पिप्रीषति स्व आयुषि दुरोणे विश्वेदस्मै सुदिना सासदिष्टिः ॥
verses.rom:
sedagne astu subhagah sudanuryastva nityena havisha ya ukthaih |
piprishati sva ayushi durone vishvedasmai sudina sasadishtih ||
verses.en:
Blest, Agni, be the man, the liberal giver, who with his lauds and regular oblation
Is fain to please thee for his life and dwelling. May all his days be bright: be this his longing.

verses.sa:
अर्चामि ते सुमतिं घोष्यर्वाक्सं ते वावाता जरतामियं गीः ।
स्वश्वास्त्वा सुरथा मर्जयेमास्मे क्षत्राणि धारयेरनु द्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
archami te sumatim ghoshyarvaksam te vavata jaratamiyam gih |
svashvastva suratha marjayemasme kshatrani dharayeranu dyun ||
verses.en:
I praise thy gracious favour: sing in answer. May this my song sing like a loved one with thee.
Lords of good steeds and cars may we adorn thee, and day by day vouchsafe thou us dominion.

verses.sa:
इह त्वा भूर्या चरेदुप त्मन्दोषावस्तर्दीदिवांसमनु द्यून् ।
क्रीळन्तस्त्वा सुमनसः सपेमाभि द्युम्ना तस्थिवांसो जनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
iha tva bhurya charedupa tmandoshavastardidivamsamanu dyun |
krilantastva sumanasah sapemabhi dyumna tasthivamso jananam ||
verses.en:
Here of free choice let each one serve thee richly, resplendent day by day at eve and morning.
So may we honour thee, content and joyous, passing beyond the glories of the people.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा स्वश्वः सुहिरण्यो अग्न उपयाति वसुमता रथेन ।
तस्य त्राता भवसि तस्य सखा यस्त आतिथ्यमानुषग्जुजोषत् ॥
verses.rom:
yastva svashvah suhiranyo agna upayati vasumata rathena |
tasya trata bhavasi tasya sakha yasta atithyamanushagjujoshat ||
verses.en:
Whoso with good steeds and fine gold, O Agni, comes nigh thee on a car laden with treasure,
His Friend art thou, yea, thou art his Protector whose joy it is to entertain thee duly.

verses.sa:
महो रुजामि बन्धुता वचोभिस्तन्मा पितुर्गोतमादन्वियाय ।
त्वं नो अस्य वचसश्चिकिद्धि होतर्यविष्ठ सुक्रतो दमूनाः ॥
verses.rom:
maho rujami bandhuta vachobhistanma piturgotamadanviyaya |
tvam no asya vachasashchikiddhi hotaryavishtha sukrato damunah ||
verses.en:
Through words and kinship I destroy the mighty: this power I have from Gotama my father.
Mark thou this speech of ours, O thou Most Youthful, Friend of the House, exceeding wise, Invoker.

verses.sa:
अस्वप्नजस्तरणयः सुशेवा अतन्द्रासोऽवृका अश्रमिष्ठाः ।
ते पायवः सध्र्यञ्चो निषद्याग्ने तव नः पान्त्वमूर ॥
verses.rom:
asvapnajastaranayah susheva atandraso'vrika ashramishthah |
te payavah sadhryancho nishadyagne tava nah pantvamura ||
verses.en:
Knowing no slumber, speedy and propitious, alert and ever friendly, most unwearied,
May thy protecting powers, unerring Agni, taking their places here, combined, preserve us.

verses.sa:
ये पायवो मामतेयं ते अग्ने पश्यन्तो अन्धं दुरितादरक्षन् ।
ररक्ष तान्सुकृतो विश्ववेदा दिप्सन्त इद्रिपवो नाह देभुः ॥
verses.rom:
ye payavo mamateyam te agne pashyanto andham duritadarakshan |
raraksha tansukrito vishvaveda dipsanta idripavo naha debhuh ||
verses.en:
Thy guardian rays, O Agni, when they saw him, preserved blind Mamateya from affliction.
Lord of all riches, he preserved the pious: the fees who fain would harm them did no mischief

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं सधन्यस्त्वोतास्तव प्रणीत्यश्याम वाजान् ।
उभा शंसा सूदय सत्यतातेऽनुष्ठुया कृणुह्यह्रयाण ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya vayam sadhanyastvotastava pranityashyama vajan |
ubha shamsa sudaya satyatate'nushthuya krinuhyahrayana ||
verses.en:
Aided by thee with thee may we be wealthy, may we gain strength with thee to guide us onward.
Fulfil the words of both, O Ever Truthful: straightway do this, thou God whom power emboldens.

verses.sa:
अया ते अग्ने समिधा विधेम प्रति स्तोमं शस्यमानं गृभाय ।
दहाशसो रक्षसः पाह्यस्मान्द्रुहो निदो मित्रमहो अवद्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
aya te agne samidha vidhema prati stomam shasyamanam gribhaya |
dahashaso rakshasah pahyasmandruho nido mitramaho avadyat ||
verses.en:
O Agni, with this fuel will we serve thee; accept the laud we sing to thee with favour
Destroy the cursing Raksasas: preserve us, O rich in friends, from guile and scorn and slander.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानराय मीळ्हुषे सजोषाः कथा दाशेमाग्नये बृहद्भाः ।
अनूनेन बृहता वक्षथेनोप स्तभायदुपमिन्न रोधः ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaraya milhushe sajoshah katha dashemagnaye brihadbhah |
anunena brihata vakshathenopa stabhayadupaminna rodhah ||
verses.en:
How shall we give with one accord oblation to Agni, to Vaisvanara the Bounteous?
Great light, with full high growth hath he uplifted, and, as a pillar bears the roof, sustains it.

verses.sa:
मा निन्दत य इमां मह्यं रातिं देवो ददौ मर्त्याय स्वधावान् ।
पाकाय गृत्सो अमृतो विचेता वैश्वानरो नृतमो यह्वो अग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
ma nindata ya imam mahyam ratim devo dadau martyaya svadhavan |
pakaya gritso amrito vicheta vaishvanaro nritamo yahvo agnih ||
verses.en:
Reproach not him who, God and self reliant, vouchsafed this bounty unto me a mortal,-
Deathless, discerner, wise, to me the simple, Vaisvanara most manly, youthful Aini.

verses.sa:
साम द्विबर्हा महि तिग्मभृष्टिः सहस्ररेता वृषभस्तुविष्मान् ।
पदं न गोरपगूळ्हं विविद्वानग्निर्मह्यं प्रेदु वोचन्मनीषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sama dvibarha mahi tigmabhrishtih sahasrareta vrishabhastuvishman |
padam na gorapagulham vividvanagnirmahyam predu vochanmanisham ||
verses.en:
Sharp-pointed, powerful, strong, of boundless vigour, Agni who knows the lofty hymn, kept secret
As the lost milch-cow's track, the doubly Mighty,-he hath declared to me this hidden knowledge.

verses.sa:
प्र ताँ अग्निर्बभसत्तिग्मजम्भस्तपिष्ठेन शोचिषा यः सुराधाः ।
प्र ये मिनन्ति वरुणस्य धाम प्रिया मित्रस्य चेततो ध्रुवाणि ॥
verses.rom:
pra tan agnirbabhasattigmajambhastapishthena shochisha yah suradhah |
pra ye minanti varunasya dhama priya mitrasya chetato dhruvani ||
verses.en:
May he with sharpened teeth, the Bounteous Giver, Agni, consume with flame most fiercely glowing.
Those who regard not Varuna's commandments and the dear steadfast laws of sapient Mitra.

verses.sa:
अभ्रातरो न योषणो व्यन्तः पतिरिपो न जनयो दुरेवाः ।
पापासः सन्तो अनृता असत्या इदं पदमजनता गभीरम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhrataro na yoshano vyantah patiripo na janayo durevah |
papasah santo anrita asatya idam padamajanata gabhiram ||
verses.en:
Like youthful women without brothers, straying, like dames who hate their lords, of evil conduct,
They who are full of sin, untrue, unfaithful, they have engendered this abysmal station.

verses.sa:
इदं मे अग्ने कियते पावकामिनते गुरुं भारं न मन्म ।
बृहद्दधाथ धृषता गभीरं यह्वं पृष्ठं प्रयसा सप्तधातु ॥
verses.rom:
idam me agne kiyate pavakaminate gurum bharam na manma |
brihaddadhatha dhrishata gabhiram yahvam prishtham prayasa saptadhatu ||
verses.en:
To me, weak, innocent, thou, luminous Agni, bast boldly given as 'twere a heavy burthen,
This Prstha hymn, profound and strong and mighty, of seven elements, and with offered dainties.

verses.sa:
तमिन्न्वेव समना समानमभि क्रत्वा पुनती धीतिरश्याः ।
ससस्य चर्मन्नधि चारु पृश्नेरग्रे रुप आरुपितं जबारु ॥
verses.rom:
taminnveva samana samanamabhi kratva punati dhitirashyah |
sasasya charmannadhi charu prishneragre rupa arupitam jabaru ||
verses.en:
So may our song that purifies, through wisdom reach in a moment him the Universal,
Established on the height, on earth's best .station, above the beauteous grassy skin of Prsni.

verses.sa:
प्रवाच्यं वचसः किं मे अस्य गुहा हितमुप निणिग्वदन्ति ।
यदुस्रियाणामप वारिव व्रन्पाति प्रियं रुपो अग्रं पदं वेः ॥
verses.rom:
pravachyam vachasah kim me asya guha hitamupa ninigvadanti |
yadusriyanamapa variva vranpati priyam rupo agram padam veh ||
verses.en:
Of this my speech what shall I utter further? They indicate the milk stored up in secret
When they have thrown as 'twere the cows' stalls open. The Bird protects earths' best and well-loved station.

verses.sa:
इदमु त्यन्महि महामनीकं यदुस्रिया सचत पूर्व्यं गौः ।
ऋतस्य पदे अधि दीद्यानं गुहा रघुष्यद्रघुयद्विवेद ॥
verses.rom:
idamu tyanmahi mahamanikam yadusriya sachata purvyam gauh |
ritasya pade adhi didyanam guha raghushyadraghuyadviveda ||
verses.en:
This is the Great Ones' mighty apparition which from of old the radiant Cow hath followed.
This, shining brightly in the place of Order, swift, hasting on in secret, she discovered.

verses.sa:
अध द्युतानः पित्रोः सचासामनुत गुह्यं चारु पृश्नेः ।
मातुष्पदे परमे अन्ति षद्गोर्वृष्णः शोचिषः प्रयतस्य जिह्वा ॥
verses.rom:
adha dyutanah pitroh sachasamanuta guhyam charu prishneh |
matushpade parame anti shadgorvrishnah shochishah prayatasya jihva ||
verses.en:
He then who shone together with his Parents remembered Prsni's fair and secret treasure,
Which, in the Mother Cow's most lofty station, the Bull's tongue, of the flame bent forward, tasted.

verses.sa:
ऋतं वोचे नमसा पृच्छ्यमानस्तवाशसा जातवेदो यदीदम् ।
त्वमस्य क्षयसि यद्ध विश्वं दिवि यदु द्रविणं यत्पृथिव्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
ritam voche namasa prichchhyamanastavashasa jatavedo yadidam |
tvamasya kshayasi yaddha vishvam divi yadu dravinam yatprithivyam ||
verses.en:
With reverence I declare the Law, O Agni; what is, comes by thine order, Jatavedas.
Of this, whate'er it be, thou art the Sovran, yea, all the wealth that is in earth or heaven.

verses.sa:
किं नो अस्य द्रविणं कद्ध रत्नं वि नो वोचो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ।
गुहाध्वनः परमं यन्नो अस्य रेकु पदं न निदाना अगन्म ॥
verses.rom:
kim no asya dravinam kaddha ratnam vi no vocho jatavedashchikitvan |
guhadhvanah paramam yanno asya reku padam na nidana aganma ||
verses.en:
What is our wealth therefrom, and what our treasure? Tell us O Jatavedas, for thou knowest,
What is our best course in this secret passage: we, unreproached, have reached a t)lace far distant.

verses.sa:
का मर्यादा वयुना कद्ध वाममच्छा गमेम रघवो न वाजम् ।
कदा नो देवीरमृतस्य पत्नीः सूरो वर्णेन ततनन्नुषासः ॥
verses.rom:
ka maryada vayuna kaddha vamamachchha gamema raghavo na vajam |
kada no deviramritasya patnih suro varnena tatanannushasah ||
verses.en:
What is the limit, what the rules, the guerdon? Like fleet-foot coursers speed we to the contest.
When will the Goddesses, the Immortal's Spouses, the Dawns, spread over us the Sun-God's splendour?

verses.sa:
अनिरेण वचसा फल्ग्वेन प्रतीत्येन कृधुनातृपासः ।
अधा ते अग्ने किमिहा वदन्त्यनायुधास आसता सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
anirena vachasa phalgvena pratityena kridhunatripasah |
adha te agne kimiha vadantyanayudhasa asata sachantam ||
verses.en:
Unsatisfied, with speech devoid of vigour, scanty and frivolous and inconclusive,
Wherefore do they address thee here, O Agni? Let these who have no weapons suffer sorrow.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्रिये समिधानस्य वृष्णो वसोरनीकं दम आ रुरोच ।
रुशद्वसानः सुदृशीकरूपः क्षितिर्न राया पुरुवारो अद्यौत् ॥
verses.rom:
asya shriye samidhanasya vrishno vasoranikam dama a rurocha |
rushadvasanah sudrishikarupah kshitirna raya puruvaro adyaut ||
verses.en:
The majesty of him the Good, the Mighty, aflame, hath shone for glory in the dwelling.
He, clothed in light, hath shone most fair to look on, wealthy in boons, as a home shines with riches.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु णो अध्वरस्य होतरग्ने तिष्ठ देवताता यजीयान् ।
त्वं हि विश्वमभ्यसि मन्म प्र वेधसश्चित्तिरसि मनीषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
urdhva u shu no adhvarasya hotaragne tishtha devatata yajiyan |
tvam hi vishvamabhyasi manma pra vedhasashchittirasi manisham ||
verses.en:
PRIEST of our rite, stand up erect, O Agni, in the Gods' service best of sacrificers,
For over every thought thou art the Ruler: thou furtherest e'en the wisdom of the pious.

verses.sa:
अमूरो होता न्यसादि विक्ष्वग्निर्मन्द्रो विदथेषु प्रचेताः ।
ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सवितेवाश्रेन्मेतेव धूमं स्तभायदुप द्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
amuro hota nyasadi vikshvagnirmandro vidatheshu prachetah |
urdhvam bhanum savitevashrenmeteva dhumam stabhayadupa dyam ||
verses.en:
He was set down mid men as Priest unerring, Agni, wise, welcome in our holy synods.
Like Savitar he hath lifted up his splendour, and like a builder raised his smoke to heaven.

verses.sa:
यता सुजूर्णी रातिनी घृताची प्रदक्षिणिद्देवतातिमुराणः ।
उदु स्वरुर्नवजा नाक्रः पश्वो अनक्ति सुधितः सुमेकः ॥
verses.rom:
yata sujurni ratini ghritachi pradakshiniddevatatimuranah |
udu svarurnavaja nakrah pashvo anakti sudhitah sumekah ||
verses.en:
The glowing ladle, filled with oil, is lifted; choosing Gods' service to the right he circles.
Eager he rises like the new-wrought pillar which, firmly set and fixed, anoints the victims.

verses.sa:
स्तीर्णे बर्हिषि समिधाने अग्ना ऊर्ध्वो अध्वर्युर्जुजुषाणो अस्थात् ।
पर्यग्निः पशुपा न होता त्रिविष्ट्येति प्रदिव उराणः ॥
verses.rom:
stirne barhishi samidhane agna urdhvo adhvaryurjujushano asthat |
paryagnih pashupa na hota trivishtyeti pradiva uranah ||
verses.en:
When sacred grass is strewn and Agni kindled, the Adhvaryu rises to, his task rejoicing.
Agni the Priest, like one who tends the cattle, goes three times round, as from of old he wills it.

verses.sa:
परि त्मना मितद्रुरेति होताग्निर्मन्द्रो मधुवचा ऋतावा ।
द्रवन्त्यस्य वाजिनो न शोका भयन्ते विश्वा भुवना यदभ्राट् ॥
verses.rom:
pari tmana mitadrureti hotagnirmandro madhuvacha ritava |
dravantyasya vajino na shoka bhayante vishva bhuvana yadabhrat ||
verses.en:
Agni himself, the Priest, with measured motion, goes round, with sweet speech, cheerful, true to Order.
His fulgent flames run forth like vigorous horses; all creatures are affrighted when he blazes.

verses.sa:
भद्रा ते अग्ने स्वनीक संदृग्घोरस्य सतो विषुणस्य चारुः ।
न यत्ते शोचिस्तमसा वरन्त न ध्वस्मानस्तन्वी रेप आ धुः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadra te agne svanika samdrigghorasya sato vishunasya charuh |
na yatte shochistamasa varanta na dhvasmanastanvi repa a dhuh ||
verses.en:
Beautiful and auspicious is thine aspect, O lovely Agni, terrible when spreading.
Thy splendours are not covered by the darkness: detraction leaves no stain upon thy body.

verses.sa:
न यस्य सातुर्जनितोरवारि न मातरापितरा नू चिदिष्टौ ।
अधा मित्रो न सुधितः पावकोऽग्निर्दीदाय मानुषीषु विक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
na yasya saturjanitoravari na matarapitara nu chidishtau |
adha mitro na sudhitah pavako'gnirdidaya manushishu vikshu ||
verses.en:
Naught hindered his production, Bounteous Giver: his Mother and his Sire were free to send him.
Then as Friend benevolent, refulgent, Agni shone forth in human habitations.

verses.sa:
द्विर्यं पञ्च जीजनन्संवसानाः स्वसारो अग्निं मानुषीषु विक्षु ।
उषर्बुधमथर्यो न दन्तं शुक्रं स्वासं परशुं न तिग्मम् ॥
verses.rom:
dviryam pancha jijanansamvasanah svasaro agnim manushishu vikshu |
usharbudhamatharyo na dantam shukram svasam parashum na tigmam ||
verses.en:
He, Agni, whom the twice-five sisters, dwelling together, in the homes of men engendered,
Bright like a spear's tooth, wakened in the morning, with powerful mouth and like an axe well-sharpened.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये अग्ने हरितो घृतस्ना रोहितास ऋज्वञ्चः स्वञ्चः ।
अरुषासो वृषण ऋजुमुष्का आ देवतातिमह्वन्त दस्माः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tye agne harito ghritasna rohitasa rijvanchah svanchah |
arushaso vrishana rijumushka a devatatimahvanta dasmah ||
verses.en:
These thy Bay Coursers, Agni, dropping fatness, ruddy vigorous, speeding straightly forward,
And red steeds, wonderful, of mighty muscle, are to this service of the Gods invited:

verses.sa:
ये ह त्ये ते सहमाना अयासस्त्वेषासो अग्ने अर्चयश्चरन्ति ।
श्येनासो न दुवसनासो अर्थं तुविष्वणसो मारुतं न शर्धः ॥
verses.rom:
ye ha tye te sahamana ayasastveshaso agne archayashcharanti |
shyenaso na duvasanaso artham tuvishvanaso marutam na shardhah ||
verses.en:
These brightly-shining games of thine, O Agni, that move for ever restless, allsubduing,
Like falcons hasting eagerly to the quarry, roar loudly like the army of the Maruts.

verses.sa:
अकारि ब्रह्म समिधान तुभ्यं शंसात्युक्थं यजते व्यू धाः ।
होतारमग्निं मनुषो नि षेदुर्नमस्यन्त उशिजः शंसमायोः ॥
verses.rom:
akari brahma samidhana tubhyam shamsatyuktham yajate vyu dhah |
hotaramagnim manusho ni shedurnamasyanta ushijah shamsamayoh ||
verses.en:
To thee, O flaming God, hath prayer been offered. Let the priest laud thee: give to him who worships.
Men have established Agni as Invoker, fain to adore the glory of the living.

verses.sa:
अयमिह प्रथमो धायि धातृभिर्होता यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यः ।
यमप्नवानो भृगवो विरुरुचुर्वनेषु चित्रं विभ्वं विशेविशे ॥
verses.rom:
ayamiha prathamo dhayi dhatribhirhota yajishtho adhvareshvidyah |
yamapnavano bhrigavo viruruchurvaneshu chitram vibhvam vishevishe ||
verses.en:
HERE by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites:
Whom Apnavana, and the Bhrgus caused to shine bright-coloured in the wood, spreading from home to home.

verses.sa:
अग्ने कदा त आनुषग्भुवद्देवस्य चेतनम् ।
अधा हि त्वा जगृभ्रिरे मर्तासो विक्ष्वीड्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne kada ta anushagbhuvaddevasya chetanam |
adha hi tva jagribhrire martaso vikshvidyam ||
verses.en:
When shall thy glory as a God, Agni, be suddenly shown forth.
For mortal men have held thee fast, adorable in all their homes,

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं विचेतसं पश्यन्तो द्यामिव स्तृभिः ।
विश्वेषामध्वराणां हस्कर्तारं दमेदमे ॥
verses.rom:
ritavanam vichetasam pashyanto dyamiva stribhih |
vishveshamadhvaranam haskartaram damedame ||
verses.en:
Seeing thee faithful to the Law, most sapient, like the starry heaven,
Illumining with cheerful ray each solemn rite in every house.

verses.sa:
आशुं दूतं विवस्वतो विश्वा यश्चर्षणीरभि ।
आ जभ्रुः केतुमायवो भृगवाणं विशेविशे ॥
verses.rom:
ashum dutam vivasvato vishva yashcharshanirabhi |
a jabhruh ketumayavo bhrigavanam vishevishe ||
verses.en:
Vivasvan's envoy living men have taken as their ensign, swift,
The ruler over all mankind, moving like Bhrgu in each home.

verses.sa:
तमीं होतारमानुषक्चिकित्वांसं नि षेदिरे ।
रण्वं पावकशोचिषं यजिष्ठं सप्त धामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tamim hotaramanushakchikitvamsam ni shedire |
ranvam pavakashochisham yajishtham sapta dhamabhih ||
verses.en:
Him the intelligent have they placed duly as Invoking Priest,
Welcome, with sanctifying flame, best worshipper, with sevenfold might;

verses.sa:
तं शश्वतीषु मातृषु वन आ वीतमश्रितम् ।
चित्रं सन्तं गुहा हितं सुवेदं कूचिदर्थिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam shashvatishu matrishu vana a vitamashritam |
chitram santam guha hitam suvedam kuchidarthinam ||
verses.en:
In his Eternal Mothers, in the wood, concealed and unapproached,
Kept secret though his flames are bright seeking on all sides, quickly found.

verses.sa:
ससस्य यद्वियुता सस्मिन्नूधन्नृतस्य धामन्रणयन्त देवाः ।
महाँ अग्निर्नमसा रातहव्यो वेरध्वराय सदमिदृतावा ॥
verses.rom:
sasasya yadviyuta sasminnudhannritasya dhamanranayanta devah |
mahan agnirnamasa ratahavyo veradhvaraya sadamidritava ||
verses.en:
That as food spreads forth in this earthly udder, Gods may rejoice them in the home of Order,
Great Agni, served with reverence and oblation, flies ever to the sacrifice, the Faithful.

verses.sa:
वेरध्वरस्य दूत्यानि विद्वानुभे अन्ता रोदसी संचिकित्वान् ।
दूत ईयसे प्रदिव उराणो विदुष्टरो दिव आरोधनानि ॥
verses.rom:
veradhvarasya dutyani vidvanubhe anta rodasi samchikitvan |
duta iyase pradiva urano vidushtaro diva arodhanani ||
verses.en:
Bird of each rite, skilled in an envoy's duties, knowing both worlds and that which lies between them,
Thou goest from of old a willing Herald, knowing full well heaven's innermost recesses.

verses.sa:
कृष्णं त एम रुशतः पुरो भाश्चरिष्ण्वर्चिर्वपुषामिदेकम् ।
यदप्रवीता दधते ह गर्भं सद्यश्चिज्जातो भवसीदु दूतः ॥
verses.rom:
krishnam ta ema rushatah puro bhashcharishnvarchirvapushamidekam |
yadapravita dadhate ha garbham sadyashchijjato bhavasidu dutah ||
verses.en:
Bright God, thy path is black: light is before thee: thy moving splendour is the chief of wonders.
When she, yet unimpregnate, hath conceived thee, even when newly born thou art an envoy.

verses.sa:
सद्यो जातस्य ददृशानमोजो यदस्य वातो अनुवाति शोचिः ।
वृणक्ति तिग्मामतसेषु जिह्वां स्थिरा चिदन्ना दयते वि जम्भैः ॥
verses.rom:
sadyo jatasya dadrishanamojo yadasya vato anuvati shochih |
vrinakti tigmamataseshu jihvam sthira chidanna dayate vi jambhaih ||
verses.en:
Yet newly born, his vigour is apparent when the wind blows upon his fiery splendour,
His sharpened tongue he layeth on the brushwood, and with his teeth e'en solid food consumeth.

verses.sa:
तृषु यदन्ना तृषुणा ववक्ष तृषुं दूतं कृणुते यह्वो अग्निः ।
वातस्य मेळिं सचते निजूर्वन्नाशुं न वाजयते हिन्वे अर्वा ॥
verses.rom:
trishu yadanna trishuna vavaksha trishum dutam krinute yahvo agnih |
vatasya melim sachate nijurvannashum na vajayate hinve arva ||
verses.en:
When he hath borne off food with swift flame swiftly, strong Agni makes himself a speedy envoy,
Follows the rustling of the wind, consuming, and courser-like, speeds, drives the swift horse onward.

verses.sa:
दूतं वो विश्ववेदसं हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् ।
यजिष्ठमृञ्जसे गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
dutam vo vishvavedasam havyavahamamartyam |
yajishthamrinjase gira ||
verses.en:
YOUR envoy who possesses all, Immortal, bearer of your gifts,
Best worshipper, I woo with song.

verses.sa:
स हि वेदा वसुधितिं महाँ आरोधनं दिवः ।
स देवाँ एह वक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi veda vasudhitim mahan arodhanam divah |
sa devan eha vakshati ||
verses.en:
He, Mighty, knows the gift of wealth, he knows the deep recess of heaven:
He shall bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sa:
स वेद देव आनमं देवाँ ऋतायते दमे ।
दाति प्रियाणि चिद्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
sa veda deva anamam devan ritayate dame |
dati priyani chidvasu ||
verses.en:
He knows, a God himself, to guide Gods to the righteous in his home:
He gives e'en treasures that we love.

verses.sa:
स होता सेदु दूत्यं चिकित्वाँ अन्तरीयते ।
विद्वाँ आरोधनं दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
sa hota sedu dutyam chikitvan antariyate |
vidvan arodhanam divah ||
verses.en:
He is the Herald: well-informed, he doth his errand to and fro,
Knowing the deep recess of heaven.

verses.sa:
ते स्याम ये अग्नये ददाशुर्हव्यदातिभिः ।
य ईं पुष्यन्त इन्धते ॥
verses.rom:
te syama ye agnaye dadashurhavyadatibhih |
ya im pushyanta indhate ||
verses.en:
May we be they who gratify Agni with sacrificial gifts,
Who cherish and enkindle him.

verses.sa:
ते राया ते सुवीर्यैः ससवांसो वि शृण्विरे ।
ये अग्ना दधिरे दुवः ॥
verses.rom:
te raya te suviryaih sasavamso vi shrinvire |
ye agna dadhire duvah ||
verses.en:
Illustrious for wealth are they, and hero deeds, victorious,
Who have served Agni reverently.

verses.sa:
अस्मे रायो दिवेदिवे सं चरन्तु पुरुस्पृहः ।
अस्मे वाजास ईरताम् ॥
verses.rom:
asme rayo divedive sam charantu purusprihah |
asme vajasa iratam ||
verses.en:
So unto us, day after day, may riches craved by many come,
And power and might spring up for us.

verses.sa:
स विप्रश्चर्षणीनां शवसा मानुषाणाम् ।
अति क्षिप्रेव विध्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sa viprashcharshaninam shavasa manushanam |
ati kshipreva vidhyati ||
verses.en:
That holy Singer in his strength shoots forth his arrows swifter than
The swift shafts of the tribes of men.

verses.sa:
अग्ने मृळ महाँ असि य ईमा देवयुं जनम् ।
इयेथ बर्हिरासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne mrila mahan asi ya ima devayum janam |
iyetha barhirasadam ||
verses.en:
AGNI, show favour: great art thou who to this pious man art come,
To seat thee on the sacred grass.

verses.sa:
स मानुषीषु दूळभो विक्षु प्रावीरमर्त्यः ।
दूतो विश्वेषां भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa manushishu dulabho vikshu praviramartyah |
duto vishvesham bhuvat ||
verses.en:
May he the Immortal, Helper, bard to be deceived among mankind,
Become the messenger of all.

verses.sa:
स सद्म परि णीयते होता मन्द्रो दिविष्टिषु ।
उत पोता नि षीदति ॥
verses.rom:
sa sadma pari niyate hota mandro divishtishu |
uta pota ni shidati ||
verses.en:
Around the altar is he led, welcome Chief Priest at solemn rites,
Or as the Potar sits him down.

verses.sa:
उत ग्ना अग्निरध्वर उतो गृहपतिर्दमे ।
उत ब्रह्मा नि षीदति ॥
verses.rom:
uta gna agniradhvara uto grihapatirdame |
uta brahma ni shidati ||
verses.en:
Agni in fire at sacrifice, and in the house as Lord thereof,
And as a Brahman takes his seat.

verses.sa:
वेषि ह्यध्वरीयतामुपवक्ता जनानाम् ।
हव्या च मानुषाणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
veshi hyadhvariyatamupavakta jananam |
havya cha manushanam ||
verses.en:
Thou comest as the guide of folk who celebrate a sacrifice,
And to oblations brought by men.

verses.sa:
वेषीद्वस्य दूत्यं यस्य जुजोषो अध्वरम् ।
हव्यं मर्तस्य वोळ्हवे ॥
verses.rom:
veshidvasya dutyam yasya jujosho adhvaram |
havyam martasya volhave ||
verses.en:
Thou servest as his messenger whose sacrifice thou lovest well,
To bear the mortal's gifts to heaven.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं जोष्यध्वरमस्माकं यज्ञमङ्गिरः ।
अस्माकं शृणुधी हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmakam joshyadhvaramasmakam yajnamangirah |
asmakam shrinudhi havam ||
verses.en:
Accept our solemn rite; be pleased, Angiras, with our sacrifice:
Give ear and listen to our call.

verses.sa:
परि ते दूळभो रथोऽस्माँ अश्नोतु विश्वतः ।
येन रक्षसि दाशुषः ॥
verses.rom:
pari te dulabho ratho'sman ashnotu vishvatah |
yena rakshasi dashushah ||
verses.en:
May thine inviolable car, wherewith thou guardest those who give,
Come near to us from every side.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तमद्याश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रं हृदिस्पृशम् ।
ऋध्यामा त ओहैः ॥
verses.rom:
agne tamadyashvam na stomaih kratum na bhadram hridisprisham |
ridhyama ta ohaih ||
verses.en:
This day with praises, Agni, we bring thee that which thou lovest.
Right judgment, like a horse, with our devotions.

verses.sa:
अधा ह्यग्ने क्रतोर्भद्रस्य दक्षस्य साधोः ।
रथीरृतस्य बृहतो बभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
adha hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakshasya sadhoh |
rathirritasya brihato babhutha ||
verses.en:
For thou hast ever been the Car-driver, Agni, of noble
Strength, lofty sacrifice, and rightful judgment.

verses.sa:
एभिर्नो अर्कैर्भवा नो अर्वाङ्स्वर्ण ज्योतिः ।
अग्ने विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः ॥
verses.rom:
ebhirno arkairbhava no arvansvarna jyotih |
agne vishvebhih sumana anikaih ||
verses.en:
Through these our praises come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight,
O Agni, well disposed, with all thine aspects.

verses.sa:
आभिष्टे अद्य गीर्भिर्गृणन्तोऽग्ने दाशेम ।
प्र ते दिवो न स्तनयन्ति शुष्माः ॥
verses.rom:
abhishte adya girbhirgrinanto'gne dashema |
pra te divo na stanayanti shushmah ||
verses.en:
Now may we serve thee singing these lauds this day to thee, Agni.
Loud as the voice of Heaven thy blasts are roaring.

verses.sa:
तव स्वादिष्ठाग्ने संदृष्टिरिदा चिदह्न इदा चिदक्तोः ।
श्रिये रुक्मो न रोचत उपाके ॥
verses.rom:
tava svadishthagne samdrishtirida chidahna ida chidaktoh |
shriye rukmo na rochata upake ||
verses.en:
just at this time of the day and the night thy look is the sweetest .
It shineth near us even as gold for glory.

verses.sa:
घृतं न पूतं तनूररेपाः शुचि हिरण्यम् ।
तत्ते रुक्मो न रोचत स्वधावः ॥
verses.rom:
ghritam na putam tanurarepah shuchi hiranyam |
tatte rukmo na rochata svadhavah ||
verses.en:
Spotless thy body, brilliant as gold, like clarified butter:
This gleams like gold on thee, O Self. dependent.

verses.sa:
कृतं चिद्धि ष्मा सनेमि द्वेषोऽग्न इनोषि मर्तात् ।
इत्था यजमानादृतावः ॥
verses.rom:
kritam chiddhi shma sanemi dvesho'gna inoshi martat |
ittha yajamanadritavah ||
verses.en:
All hate and mischief, yea, if committed, Agni, thou turnest,
Holy One, from the man who rightly worships.

verses.sa:
शिवा नः सख्या सन्तु भ्रात्राग्ने देवेषु युष्मे ।
सा नो नाभिः सदने सस्मिन्नूधन् ॥
verses.rom:
shiva nah sakhya santu bhratragne deveshu yushme |
sa no nabhih sadane sasminnudhan ||
verses.en:
Agni, with you Gods, prosperous be our friendships and kinships.
Be this our bond here by this place, thine altar.

verses.sa:
भद्रं ते अग्ने सहसिन्ननीकमुपाक आ रोचते सूर्यस्य ।
रुशद्दृशे ददृशे नक्तया चिदरूक्षितं दृश आ रूपे अन्नम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhadram te agne sahasinnanikamupaka a rochate suryasya |
rushaddrishe dadrishe naktaya chidarukshitam drisha a rupe annam ||
verses.en:
THY blessed majesty, victorious Agni, shines brightly in the neighbourhood of Surya.
Splendid to see, it shows even at nighttime, and food is fair to look on in thy beauty.

verses.sa:
वि षाह्यग्ने गृणते मनीषां खं वेपसा तुविजात स्तवानः ।
विश्वेभिर्यद्वावनः शुक्र देवैस्तन्नो रास्व सुमहो भूरि मन्म ॥
verses.rom:
vi shahyagne grinate manisham kham vepasa tuvijata stavanah |
vishvebhiryadvavanah shukra devaistanno rasva sumaho bhuri manma ||
verses.en:
Agni, disclose his thought for him who singeth, the well, Strong God! while thou art praised with fervour.
Vouchsafe to us that powerful hymn, O Mighty, which, Radiant One! with all the Gods thou lovest.

verses.sa:
त्वदग्ने काव्या त्वन्मनीषास्त्वदुक्था जायन्ते राध्यानि ।
त्वदेति द्रविणं वीरपेशा इत्थाधिये दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
verses.rom:
tvadagne kavya tvanmanishastvaduktha jayante radhyani |
tvadeti dravinam virapesha itthadhiye dashushe martyaya ||
verses.en:
From thee, O Agni, springs poetic wisdom, from thee come thoughts and hymns of praise that prosper;
From thee flows wealth, with heroes to adorn it, to the true-hearted man who gives oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वद्वाजी वाजम्भरो विहाया अभिष्टिकृज्जायते सत्यशुष्मः ।
त्वद्रयिर्देवजूतो मयोभुस्त्वदाशुर्जूजुवाँ अग्ने अर्वा ॥
verses.rom:
tvadvaji vajambharo vihaya abhishtikrijjayate satyashushmah |
tvadrayirdevajuto mayobhustvadashurjujuvan agne arva ||
verses.en:
From thee the hero springs who wins the booty, bringer of help, mighty, of real courage.
From thee comes wealth, sent by the Gods, bliss-giving; Agni, from thee the fleet impetuous charger.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने प्रथमं देवयन्तो देवं मर्ता अमृत मन्द्रजिह्वम् ।
द्वेषोयुतमा विवासन्ति धीभिर्दमूनसं गृहपतिममूरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne prathamam devayanto devam marta amrita mandrajihvam |
dveshoyutama vivasanti dhibhirdamunasam grihapatimamuram ||
verses.en:
Immortal Agni, thee whose voice is pleasant, as first in rank, as God, religious mortals
Invite with hymns; thee who removest hatred, Friend of the Home, the household's Lord, unerring.

verses.sa:
आरे अस्मदमतिमारे अंह आरे विश्वां दुर्मतिं यन्निपासि ।
दोषा शिवः सहसः सूनो अग्ने यं देव आ चित्सचसे स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
are asmadamatimare amha are vishvam durmatim yannipasi |
dosha shivah sahasah suno agne yam deva a chitsachase svasti ||
verses.en:
Far from us thou removest want and sorrow, far from us all ill-will when thou protectest.
Son of Strength, Agni, blest is he at evening, whom thou as God attendest for his welfare.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वामग्न इनधते यतस्रुक्त्रिस्ते अन्नं कृणवत्सस्मिन्नहन् ।
स सु द्युम्नैरभ्यस्तु प्रसक्षत्तव क्रत्वा जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
yastvamagna inadhate yatasruktriste annam krinavatsasminnahan |
sa su dyumnairabhyastu prasakshattava kratva jatavedashchikitvan ||
verses.en:
WHOSO enkindles thee, with lifted ladle, and thrice this day offiers thee food, O Agni,
May he excel, triumphant through thy splendours, wise through thy mental power, O Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
इध्मं यस्ते जभरच्छश्रमाणो महो अग्ने अनीकमा सपर्यन् ।
स इधानः प्रति दोषामुषासं पुष्यन्रयिं सचते घ्नन्नमित्रान् ॥
verses.rom:
idhmam yaste jabharachchhashramano maho agne anikama saparyan |
sa idhanah prati doshamushasam pushyanrayim sachate ghnannamitran ||
verses.en:
Whoso with toil and trouble brings thee fuel, serving the majesty of mighty Agni,
He, kindling thee at evening and at morning, prospers, and comes to wealth, and slays his foemen.

verses.sa:
अग्निरीशे बृहतः क्षत्रियस्याग्निर्वाजस्य परमस्य रायः ।
दधाति रत्नं विधते यविष्ठो व्यानुषङ्मर्त्याय स्वधावान् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirishe brihatah kshatriyasyagnirvajasya paramasya rayah |
dadhati ratnam vidhate yavishtho vyanushanmartyaya svadhavan ||
verses.en:
Agni is Master of sublime dominion, Agni is Lord of strength and lofty riches.
Straightway the self-reliant God, Most Youthful, gives treasures to the mortal who adores him.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि ते पुरुषत्रा यविष्ठाचित्तिभिश्चकृमा कच्चिदागः ।
कृधी ष्वस्माँ अदितेरनागान्व्येनांसि शिश्रथो विष्वगग्ने ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi te purushatra yavishthachittibhishchakrima kachchidagah |
kridhi shvasman aditeranaganvyenamsi shishratho vishvagagne ||
verses.en:
Most Youthful God, whatever sin, through folly, we here, as human beings, have committed,
In sight of Aditi make thou us sinless remit, entirely, Agni, our offences.

verses.sa:
महश्चिदग्न एनसो अभीक ऊर्वाद्देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् ।
मा ते सखायः सदमिद्रिषाम यच्छा तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ॥
verses.rom:
mahashchidagna enaso abhika urvaddevanamuta martyanam |
ma te sakhayah sadamidrishama yachchha tokaya tanayaya sham yoh ||
verses.en:
Even in the presence of great sin, O Agni, free us from prison of the Gods or mortals.
Never may we who are thy friends be injured: grant health and strength unto our seed and offspring.

verses.sa:
यथा ह त्यद्वसवो गौर्यं चित्पदि षिताममुञ्चता यजत्राः ।
एवो ष्वस्मन्मुञ्चता व्यंहः प्र तार्यग्ने प्रतरं न आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha ha tyadvasavo gauryam chitpadi shitamamunchata yajatrah |
evo shvasmanmunchata vyamhah pra taryagne prataram na ayuh ||
verses.en:
Even as ye here, Gods Excellent and Holy, have loosed the cow that by the foot was tethered,
So also set us free from this affliction long let our life, O Agni, be extended.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यद्विभातीनां सुमना रत्नधेयम् ।
यातमश्विना सुकृतो दुरोणमुत्सूर्यो ज्योतिषा देव एति ॥
verses.rom:
pratyagnirushasamagramakhyadvibhatinam sumana ratnadheyam |
yatamashvina sukrito duronamutsuryo jyotisha deva eti ||
verses.en:
AGNI hath looked, benevolently-minded, on the wealth-giving spring of radiant Mornings.
Come, Asvins, to the dwelling of the pious: Surya the God is rising with his splendour.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सविता देवो अश्रेद्द्रप्सं दविध्वद्गविषो न सत्वा ।
अनु व्रतं वरुणो यन्ति मित्रो यत्सूर्यं दिव्यारोहयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvam bhanum savita devo ashreddrapsam davidhvadgavisho na satva |
anu vratam varuno yanti mitro yatsuryam divyarohayanti ||
verses.en:
Savitar, God, hath spread on high his lustre, waving his flag like a spoil-seeking hero.
Their stablished way go Varuna and Mitra, what time they make the Sun ascend the heaven.

verses.sa:
यं सीमकृण्वन्तमसे विपृचे ध्रुवक्षेमा अनवस्यन्तो अर्थम् ।
तं सूर्यं हरितः सप्त यह्वी स्पशं विश्वस्य जगतो वहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
yam simakrinvantamase vipriche dhruvakshema anavasyanto artham |
tam suryam haritah sapta yahvi spasham vishvasya jagato vahanti ||
verses.en:
Him whom they made to drive away the darkness, Lords of sure mansions, constant to their object,
Him who beholds the universe, the Sun-God, seven strong and youthful Coursers carry onward.

verses.sa:
वहिष्ठेभिर्विहरन्यासि तन्तुमवव्ययन्नसितं देव वस्म ।
दविध्वतो रश्मयः सूर्यस्य चर्मेवावाधुस्तमो अप्स्वन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
vahishthebhirviharanyasi tantumavavyayannasitam deva vasma |
davidhvato rashmayah suryasya charmevavadhustamo apsvantah ||
verses.en:
Spreading thy web with mightiest Steeds thou comest, rending apart, thou God, the black-hued mantle.
The rays of Surya tremulously shining sink, like a hide, the darkness in the waters.

verses.sa:
अनायतो अनिबद्धः कथायं न्यङ्ङुत्तानोऽव पद्यते न ।
कया याति स्वधया को ददर्श दिवः स्कम्भः समृतः पाति नाकम् ॥
verses.rom:
anayato anibaddhah kathayam nyannuttano'va padyate na |
kaya yati svadhaya ko dadarsha divah skambhah samritah pati nakam ||
verses.en:
How is it that, unbound and not supported, he falleth not although directed downward?
By what self power moves he? Who hath seen it? He guards the vault of heaven, a close-set pillar.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसो जातवेदा अख्यद्देवो रोचमाना महोभिः ।
आ नासत्योरुगाया रथेनेमं यज्ञमुप नो यातमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
pratyagnirushaso jataveda akhyaddevo rochamana mahobhih |
a nasatyorugaya rathenemam yajnamupa no yatamachchha ||
verses.en:
THE God hath looked, even Agni Jatavedas, to meet the Dawns refulgent in their glories.
Come on your chariot, ye who travel widely, come to this sacrifice of ours, Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं केतुं सविता देवो अश्रेज्ज्योतिर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय कृण्वन् ।
आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं वि सूर्यो रश्मिभिश्चेकितानः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvam ketum savita devo ashrejjyotirvishvasmai bhuvanaya krinvan |
apra dyavaprithivi antariksham vi suryo rashmibhishchekitanah ||
verses.en:
Producing light for all the world of creatures, God Savitar hath raised aloft his banner.
Making his presence known by sunbeams, Surya hath filled the firmament and earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
आवहन्त्यरुणीर्ज्योतिषागान्मही चित्रा रश्मिभिश्चेकिताना ।
प्रबोधयन्ती सुविताय देव्युषा ईयते सुयुजा रथेन ॥
verses.rom:
avahantyarunirjyotishaganmahi chitra rashmibhishchekitana |
prabodhayanti suvitaya devyusha iyate suyuja rathena ||
verses.en:
Red Dawn.is come, riding with brightness onward, distinguished by her beams, gay-hued and mighty.
Dawn on her nobly-harnessed car, the Goddess, awaking men to happiness, approacheth.

verses.sa:
आ वां वहिष्ठा इह ते वहन्तु रथा अश्वास उषसो व्युष्टौ ।
इमे हि वां मधुपेयाय सोमा अस्मिन्यज्ञे वृषणा मादयेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vam vahishtha iha te vahantu ratha ashvasa ushaso vyushtau |
ime hi vam madhupeyaya soma asminyajne vrishana madayetham ||
verses.en:
May those most powerful steeds and chariot bring you, O Asvins, hither at the break of morning.
Here for your draught of meath are Soma juices: at this our sacrifice rejoice, ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
अनायतो अनिबद्धः कथायं न्यङ्ङुत्तानोऽव पद्यते न ।
कया याति स्वधया को ददर्श दिव स्कम्भः समृतः पाति नाकम् ॥
verses.rom:
anayato anibaddhah kathayam nyannuttano'va padyate na |
kaya yati svadhaya ko dadarsha diva skambhah samritah pati nakam ||
verses.en:
How is it that, unbound and unsupported, he falleth not although directed downward?
By what self-power moves he? Who hath seen it? He guards the vault of heaven, a close-set pillar?

verses.sa:
अग्निर्होता नो अध्वरे वाजी सन्परि णीयते ।
देवो देवेषु यज्ञियः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhota no adhvare vaji sanpari niyate |
devo deveshu yajniyah ||
verses.en:
AGNI the Herald, like a horse, is led forth at our solemn rite,
God among Gods adorable.

verses.sa:
परि त्रिविष्ट्यध्वरं यात्यग्नी रथीरिव ।
आ देवेषु प्रयो दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
pari trivishtyadhvaram yatyagni rathiriva |
a deveshu prayo dadhat ||
verses.en:
Three times unto our solemn rite comes Agni like a charioteer,
Bearing the viands to the Gods.

verses.sa:
परि वाजपतिः कविरग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत् ।
दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
pari vajapatih kaviragnirhavyanyakramit |
dadhadratnani dashushe ||
verses.en:
Round the oblations hath he paced, Agni the Wise, the Lord of Strength,
Giving the offerer precious boons.

verses.sa:
अयं यः सृञ्जये पुरो दैववाते समिध्यते ।
द्युमाँ अमित्रदम्भनः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yah srinjaye puro daivavate samidhyate |
dyuman amitradambhanah ||
verses.en:
He who is kindled eastward for Srnjaya, Devavata's son,
Resplendent, tamer of the foe.

verses.sa:
अस्य घा वीर ईवतोऽग्नेरीशीत मर्त्यः ।
तिग्मजम्भस्य मीळ्हुषः ॥
verses.rom:
asya gha vira ivato'gnerishita martyah |
tigmajambhasya milhushah ||
verses.en:
So mighty be the Agni whom the mortal hero shall command,
With sharpened teeth and bountiful.

verses.sa:
तमर्वन्तं न सानसिमरुषं न दिवः शिशुम् ।
मर्मृज्यन्ते दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
tamarvantam na sanasimarusham na divah shishum |
marmrijyante divedive ||
verses.en:
Day after day they dress him, as they clean a horse who wins the prize.
Dress the red Scion of the Sky.

verses.sa:
बोधद्यन्मा हरिभ्यां कुमारः साहदेव्यः ।
अच्छा न हूत उदरम् ॥
verses.rom:
bodhadyanma haribhyam kumarah sahadevyah |
achchha na huta udaram ||
verses.en:
When Sahadeva's princely son with two bay horses thought of me,
Summoned by him I drew not back.

verses.sa:
उत त्या यजता हरी कुमारात्साहदेव्यात् ।
प्रयता सद्य आ ददे ॥
verses.rom:
uta tya yajata hari kumaratsahadevyat |
prayata sadya a dade ||
verses.en:
And truly those two noble bays I straightway took when offered me,
From Sahadeva's princely son.

verses.sa:
एष वां देवावश्विना कुमारः साहदेव्यः ।
दीर्घायुरस्तु सोमकः ॥
verses.rom:
esha vam devavashvina kumarah sahadevyah |
dirghayurastu somakah ||
verses.en:
Long, O ye Asvins, may he live, your care, ye Gods, the princely son.
Of Sahadeva, Somaka.

verses.sa:
तं युवं देवावश्विना कुमारं साहदेव्यम् ।
दीर्घायुषं कृणोतन ॥
verses.rom:
tam yuvam devavashvina kumaram sahadevyam |
dirghayusham krinotana ||
verses.en:
Cause him the youthful prince, the son of Sahadeva, to enjoy
Long life, O Asvins, O ye Gods.

verses.sa:
आ सत्यो यातु मघवाँ ऋजीषी द्रवन्त्वस्य हरय उप नः ।
तस्मा इदन्धः सुषुमा सुदक्षमिहाभिपित्वं करते गृणानः ॥
verses.rom:
a satyo yatu maghavan rijishi dravantvasya haraya upa nah |
tasma idandhah sushuma sudakshamihabhipitvam karate grinanah ||
verses.en:
IMPETUOUS, true, let Maghavan come hither, and let his Tawny Coursers speed to reach us.
For him have we pressed juice exceeding potent: here, praised with song, let him effect his visit.

verses.sa:
अव स्य शूराध्वनो नान्तेऽस्मिन्नो अद्य सवने मन्दध्यै ।
शंसात्युक्थमुशनेव वेधाश्चिकितुषे असुर्याय मन्म ॥
verses.rom:
ava sya shuradhvano nante'sminno adya savane mandadhyai |
shamsatyukthamushaneva vedhashchikitushe asuryaya manma ||
verses.en:
Unyoke, as at thy journey's end, O Hero, to gladden thee today at this libation.
Like Usana, the priest a laud shall utter, a hymn to thee, the Lord Divine, who markest.

verses.sa:
कविर्न निण्यं विदथानि साधन्वृषा यत्सेकं विपिपानो अर्चात् ।
दिव इत्था जीजनत्सप्त कारूनह्ना चिच्चक्रुर्वयुना गृणन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
kavirna ninyam vidathani sadhanvrisha yatsekam vipipano archat |
diva ittha jijanatsapta karunahna chichchakrurvayuna grinantah ||
verses.en:
When the Bull, quaffing, praises our libation, as a sage paying holy rites in secret,
Seven singers here from heaven hath he begotten, who e'en by day have wrought their works while singing.

verses.sa:
स्वर्यद्वेदि सुदृशीकमर्कैर्महि ज्योती रुरुचुर्यद्ध वस्तोः ।
अन्धा तमांसि दुधिता विचक्षे नृभ्यश्चकार नृतमो अभिष्टौ ॥
verses.rom:
svaryadvedi sudrishikamarkairmahi jyoti ruruchuryaddha vastoh |
andha tamamsi dudhita vichakshe nribhyashchakara nritamo abhishtau ||
verses.en:
When heaven's fair light by hymns was made apparent (they made great splendour shine at break of morning),
He with his succour, best of Heroes, scattered the blinding darkness so that men saw clearly.

verses.sa:
ववक्ष इन्द्रो अमितमृजीष्युभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा ।
अतश्चिदस्य महिमा वि रेच्यभि यो विश्वा भुवना बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
vavaksha indro amitamrijishyubhe a paprau rodasi mahitva |
atashchidasya mahima vi rechyabhi yo vishva bhuvana babhuva ||
verses.en:
Indra, Impetuous One, hath waxed immensely: he with his vastness hath filled earth and heaven.
E'en beyond this his majesty extendeth who hath exceeded all the worlds in greatness.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि शक्रो नर्याणि विद्वानपो रिरेच सखिभिर्निकामैः ।
अश्मानं चिद्ये बिभिदुर्वचोभिर्व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvani shakro naryani vidvanapo rirecha sakhibhirnikamaih |
ashmanam chidye bibhidurvachobhirvrajam gomantamushijo vi vavruh ||
verses.en:
Sakra who knoweth well all human actions hath with his eager Friends let loose the waters.
They with their songs cleft e'en the mountain open and willingly disclosed the stall of cattle.

verses.sa:
अपो वृत्रं वव्रिवांसं पराहन्प्रावत्ते वज्रं पृथिवी सचेताः ।
प्रार्णांसि समुद्रियाण्यैनोः पतिर्भवञ्छवसा शूर धृष्णो ॥
verses.rom:
apo vritram vavrivamsam parahanpravatte vajram prithivi sachetah |
prarnamsi samudriyanyainoh patirbhavanchhavasa shura dhrishno ||
verses.en:
He smote away the floods' obstructer, Vrtra; Earth, conscious, lent her aid to speed thy thunder.
Thou sentest forth the waters of the ocean, as Lord through power and might, O daring Hero.

verses.sa:
अपो यदद्रिं पुरुहूत दर्दराविर्भुवत्सरमा पूर्व्यं ते ।
स नो नेता वाजमा दर्षि भूरिं गोत्रा रुजन्नङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानः ॥
verses.rom:
apo yadadrim puruhuta dardaravirbhuvatsarama purvyam te |
sa no neta vajama darshi bhurim gotra rujannangirobhirgrinanah ||
verses.en:
When, Much-invoked! the water's rock thou cleftest, Sarama showed herself and went before thee.
Hymned by Angirases, bursting the cowstalls, much strength thou foundest for us as our leader.

verses.sa:
अच्छा कविं नृमणो गा अभिष्टौ स्वर्षाता मघवन्नाधमानम् ।
ऊतिभिस्तमिषणो द्युम्नहूतौ नि मायावानब्रह्मा दस्युरर्त ॥
verses.rom:
achchha kavim nrimano ga abhishtau svarshata maghavannadhamanam |
utibhistamishano dyumnahutau ni mayavanabrahma dasyurarta ||
verses.en:
Come, Maghavan, Friend of Man, to aid the singer imploring thee in battle for the sunlight.
Speed him with help in his inspired invokings: down sink the sorcerer, the prayerless Dasyu.

verses.sa:
आ दस्युघ्ना मनसा याह्यस्तं भुवत्ते कुत्सः सख्ये निकामः ।
स्वे योनौ नि षदतं सरूपा वि वां चिकित्सदृतचिद्ध नारी ॥
verses.rom:
a dasyughna manasa yahyastam bhuvatte kutsah sakhye nikamah |
sve yonau ni shadatam sarupa vi vam chikitsadritachiddha nari ||
verses.en:
Come to our home resolved to slay the Dasyu: Kutsa longed eagerly to win thy friendship.
Alike in form ye both sate in his dwelling the faithful Lady was in doubt between you.

verses.sa:
यासि कुत्सेन सरथमवस्युस्तोदो वातस्य हर्योरीशानः ।
ऋज्रा वाजं न गध्यं युयूषन्कविर्यदहन्पार्याय भूषात् ॥
verses.rom:
yasi kutsena sarathamavasyustodo vatasya haryorishanah |
rijra vajam na gadhyam yuyushankaviryadahanparyaya bhushat ||
verses.en:
Thou comest, fain to succour him, with Kutsa,-a goad that masters both the Wind-God's horses,
That, holding the brown steeds like spoil for capture, the sage may on the final day be present.

verses.sa:
कुत्साय शुष्णमशुषं नि बर्हीः प्रपित्वे अह्नः कुयवं सहस्रा ।
सद्यो दस्यून्प्र मृण कुत्स्येन प्र सूरश्चक्रं वृहतादभीके ॥
verses.rom:
kutsaya shushnamashusham ni barhih prapitve ahnah kuyavam sahasra |
sadyo dasyunpra mrina kutsyena pra surashchakram vrihatadabhike ||
verses.en:
For Kutsa, with thy thousand, thou at day-break didst hurl down greedy Susna, foe of harvest.
Quickly with Kutsa's friend destroy the Dasyus, and roll the chariot-wheel of Sarya near us.

verses.sa:
त्वं पिप्रुं मृगयं शूशुवांसमृजिश्वने वैदथिनाय रन्धीः ।
पञ्चाशत्कृष्णा नि वपः सहस्रात्कं न पुरो जरिमा वि दर्दः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam piprum mrigayam shushuvamsamrijishvane vaidathinaya randhih |
panchashatkrishna ni vapah sahasratkam na puro jarima vi dardah ||
verses.en:
Thou to the son of Vidathin, Rjisvan, gavest up mighty Mrgaya and Pipru.
Thou smotest down the swarthy fifty thousand, and rentest forts as age consumes a garment.

verses.sa:
सूर उपाके तन्वं दधानो वि यत्ते चेत्यमृतस्य वर्पः ।
मृगो न हस्ती तविषीमुषाणः सिंहो न भीम आयुधानि बिभ्रत् ॥
verses.rom:
sura upake tanvam dadhano vi yatte chetyamritasya varpah |
mrigo na hasti tavishimushanah simho na bhima ayudhani bibhrat ||
verses.en:
What time thou settest near the Sun thy body, thy form, Immortal One, is seen expanding:
Thou a wild elephant with might invested. like a dread lion as thou wieldest weapons.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं कामा वसूयन्तो अग्मन्स्वर्मीळ्हे न सवने चकानाः ।
श्रवस्यवः शशमानास उक्थैरोको न रण्वा सुदृशीव पुष्टिः ॥
verses.rom:
indram kama vasuyanto agmansvarmilhe na savane chakanah |
shravasyavah shashamanasa ukthairoko na ranva sudrishiva pushtih ||
verses.en:
Wishes for wealth have gone to Indra, longing for him in war for light and at libation,
Eager for glory, labouring with praisesongs: he is like home, like sweet and fair nutrition.

verses.sa:
तमिद्व इन्द्रं सुहवं हुवेम यस्ता चकार नर्या पुरूणि ।
यो मावते जरित्रे गध्यं चिन्मक्षू वाजं भरति स्पार्हराधाः ॥
verses.rom:
tamidva indram suhavam huvema yasta chakara narya puruni |
yo mavate jaritre gadhyam chinmakshu vajam bharati sparharadhah ||
verses.en:
Call we for you that Indra, prompt to listen, him who hath done so much for men's advantage;
Who, Lord of envied bounty, to a singer like me brings quickly booty worth the capture.

verses.sa:
तिग्मा यदन्तरशनिः पताति कस्मिञ्चिच्छूर मुहुके जनानाम् ।
घोरा यदर्य समृतिर्भवात्यध स्मा नस्तन्वो बोधि गोपाः ॥
verses.rom:
tigma yadantarashanih patati kasminchichchhura muhuke jananam |
ghora yadarya samritirbhavatyadha sma nastanvo bodhi gopah ||
verses.en:
When the sharp-pointed arrow, O thou Hero, flieth mid any conflict of the people,
When, Faithful One, the dread encounter cometh, then be thou the Protector of our body.

verses.sa:
भुवोऽविता वामदेवस्य धीनां भुवः सखावृको वाजसातौ ।
त्वामनु प्रमतिमा जगन्मोरुशंसो जरित्रे विश्वध स्याः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvo'vita vamadevasya dhinam bhuvah sakhavriko vajasatau |
tvamanu pramatima jaganmorushamso jaritre vishvadha syah ||
verses.en:
Further the holy thoughts of Vamadeva be thou a guileless Friend in fight for booty.
We come to thee whose providence protects us: wide be thy sway for ever for thy singer.

verses.sa:
एभिर्नृभिरिन्द्र त्वायुभिष्ट्वा मघवद्भिर्मघवन्विश्व आजौ ।
द्यावो न द्युम्नैरभि सन्तो अर्यः क्षपो मदेम शरदश्च पूर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
ebhirnribhirindra tvayubhishtva maghavadbhirmaghavanvishva ajau |
dyavo na dyumnairabhi santo aryah kshapo madema sharadashcha purvih ||
verses.en:
O Indra, with these men who love thee truly, free givers, Maghavan, in every battle,
May we rejoice through many autumns, quelling our foes, as days subdue the nights with splendour.

verses.sa:
एवेदिन्द्राय वृषभाय वृष्णे ब्रह्माकर्म भृगवो न रथम् ।
नू चिद्यथा नः सख्या वियोषदसन्न उग्रोऽविता तनूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
evedindraya vrishabhaya vrishne brahmakarma bhrigavo na ratham |
nu chidyatha nah sakhya viyoshadasanna ugro'vita tanupah ||
verses.en:
Now, as the Bhrgus wrought a car, for Indra the Strong, the Mighty, we our prayer have fashioned,
That he may, ne'er withdraw from us his friendship, but be our bodies' guard and strong defender.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu shtuta indra nu grinana isham jaritre nadyo na pipeh |
akari te harivo brahma navyam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let power swell. high like rivers for the singer.
For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays, is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
त्वं महाँ इन्द्र तुभ्यं ह क्षा अनु क्षत्रं मंहना मन्यत द्यौः ।
त्वं वृत्रं शवसा जघन्वान्त्सृजः सिन्धूँरहिना जग्रसानान् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam mahan indra tubhyam ha ksha anu kshatram mamhana manyata dyauh |
tvam vritram shavasa jaghanvantsrijah sindhunrahina jagrasanan ||
verses.en:
GREAT art thou, Indra; yea, the earth, with gladness, and heaven confess to thee thine high dominion.
Thou in thy vigour having slaughtered Vrtra didst free the floods arrested by the Dragon.

verses.sa:
तव त्विषो जनिमन्रेजत द्यौ रेजद्भूमिर्भियसा स्वस्य मन्योः ।
ऋघायन्त सुभ्वः पर्वतास आर्दन्धन्वानि सरयन्त आपः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tvisho janimanrejata dyau rejadbhumirbhiyasa svasya manyoh |
righayanta subhvah parvatasa ardandhanvani sarayanta apah ||
verses.en:
Heaven trembled at the birth of thine effulgence; Earth trembled at the fear of thy displeasure.
The stedfast mountains shook in agitation . the waters flowed, and desert spots were flooded.

verses.sa:
भिनद्गिरिं शवसा वज्रमिष्णन्नाविष्कृण्वानः सहसान ओजः ।
वधीद्वृत्रं वज्रेण मन्दसानः सरन्नापो जवसा हतवृष्णीः ॥
verses.rom:
bhinadgirim shavasa vajramishnannavishkrinvanah sahasana ojah |
vadhidvritram vajrena mandasanah sarannapo javasa hatavrishnih ||
verses.en:
Hurling his bolt with might he cleft the mountain, while, putting forth his strength, he showed his vigour.
He slaughtered Vrtra with his bolt, exulting, and, their lord slain, forth flowed the waters swiftly.

verses.sa:
सुवीरस्ते जनिता मन्यत द्यौरिन्द्रस्य कर्ता स्वपस्तमो भूत् ।
य ईं जजान स्वर्यं सुवज्रमनपच्युतं सदसो न भूम ॥
verses.rom:
suviraste janita manyata dyaurindrasya karta svapastamo bhut |
ya im jajana svaryam suvajramanapachyutam sadaso na bhuma ||
verses.en:
Thy Father Dyaus esteemed himself a hero: most noble was the work of Indra's Maker,
His who begat the strong bolt's Lord who roareth, immovable like earth from her foundation.

verses.sa:
य एक इच्च्यावयति प्र भूमा राजा कृष्टीनां पुरुहूत इन्द्रः ।
सत्यमेनमनु विश्वे मदन्ति रातिं देवस्य गृणतो मघोनः ॥
verses.rom:
ya eka ichchyavayati pra bhuma raja krishtinam puruhuta indrah |
satyamenamanu vishve madanti ratim devasya grinato maghonah ||
verses.en:
