He who alone o'erthrows the world of creatures, Indra the peoples' King, invoked of many-
Verily all rejoice in him, extolling the boons which Maghavan the God hath sent them.

verses.sa:
सत्रा सोमा अभवन्नस्य विश्वे सत्रा मदासो बृहतो मदिष्ठाः ।
सत्राभवो वसुपतिर्वसूनां दत्रे विश्वा अधिथा इन्द्र कृष्टीः ॥
verses.rom:
satra soma abhavannasya vishve satra madaso brihato madishthah |
satrabhavo vasupatirvasunam datre vishva adhitha indra krishtih ||
verses.en:
All Soma juices are his own for ever, most gladdening draughts are ever his, the Mighty,
Thou ever wast the Treasure-Lord of treasures: Indra, thou lettest all folk share thy bounty.

verses.sa:
त्वमध प्रथमं जायमानोऽमे विश्वा अधिथा इन्द्र कृष्टीः ।
त्वं प्रति प्रवत आशयानमहिं वज्रेण मघवन्वि वृश्चः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamadha prathamam jayamano'me vishva adhitha indra krishtih |
tvam prati pravata ashayanamahim vajrena maghavanvi vrishchah ||
verses.en:
Moreover, when thou first wast born, O Indra, thou struckest terror into all the people.
Thou, Maghavan, rentest with thy bolt the Dragon who lay against the waterfloods of heaven.

verses.sa:
सत्राहणं दाधृषिं तुम्रमिन्द्रं महामपारं वृषभं सुवज्रम् ।
हन्ता यो वृत्रं सनितोत वाजं दाता मघानि मघवा सुराधाः ॥
verses.rom:
satrahanam dadhrishim tumramindram mahamaparam vrishabham suvajram |
hanta yo vritram sanitota vajam data maghani maghava suradhah ||
verses.en:
The ever-slaying, bold and furious Indra, the bright bolt's Lord, infinite, strong and mighty,
Who slayeth Vrtra and acquireth booty, giver of blessings, Maghavan the bounteous:

verses.sa:
अयं वृतश्चातयते समीचीर्य आजिषु मघवा शृण्व एकः ।
अयं वाजं भरति यं सनोत्यस्य प्रियासः सख्ये स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vritashchatayate samichirya ajishu maghava shrinva ekah |
ayam vajam bharati yam sanotyasya priyasah sakhye syama ||
verses.en:
Alone renowned as Maghavan in battles, he frighteneth away assembled armies.
He bringeth us the booty that he winneth may we, well-loved, continue in his friendship.

verses.sa:
अयं शृण्वे अध जयन्नुत घ्नन्नयमुत प्र कृणुते युधा गाः ।
यदा सत्यं कृणुते मन्युमिन्द्रो विश्वं दृळ्हं भयत एजदस्मात् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam shrinve adha jayannuta ghnannayamuta pra krinute yudha gah |
yada satyam krinute manyumindro vishvam drilham bhayata ejadasmat ||
verses.en:
Renowned is he when conquering and when slaying: 'fis he who winneth cattle in the combat.
When Indra hardeneth his indignation all that is fixed and all that moveth fear him.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रो गा अजयत्सं हिरण्या समश्विया मघवा यो ह पूर्वीः ।
एभिर्नृभिर्नृतमो अस्य शाकै रायो विभक्ता सम्भरश्च वस्वः ॥
verses.rom:
samindro ga ajayatsam hiranya samashviya maghava yo ha purvih |
ebhirnribhirnritamo asya shakai rayo vibhakta sambharashcha vasvah ||
verses.en:
Indra hath won all kine, all gold, all horses, Maghavan, he who breaketh forts in pieces;
Most manly with these men of his who help him, dealing out wealth and gathering the treasure.

verses.sa:
कियत्स्विदिन्द्रो अध्येति मातुः कियत्पितुर्जनितुर्यो जजान ।
यो अस्य शुष्मं मुहुकैरियर्ति वातो न जूत स्तनयद्भिरभ्रैः ॥
verses.rom:
kiyatsvidindro adhyeti matuh kiyatpiturjanituryo jajana |
yo asya shushmam muhukairiyarti vato na juta stanayadbhirabhraih ||
verses.en:
What is the care of Indra for his Mother, what cares he for the Father who begat him?
His care is that which speeds his might in conflicts, like wind borne onward by the clouds that thunder.

verses.sa:
क्षियन्तं त्वमक्षियन्तं कृणोतीयर्ति रेणुं मघवा समोहम् ।
विभञ्जनुरशनिमाँ इव द्यौरुत स्तोतारं मघवा वसौ धात् ॥
verses.rom:
kshiyantam tvamakshiyantam krinotiyarti renum maghava samoham |
vibhanjanurashaniman iva dyauruta stotaram maghava vasau dhat ||
verses.en:
Maghavan makes the settled man unsettled: he scatters dust that he hath swept together,
Breaking in pieces like Heaven armed with lightning: Maghavan shall enrich the man who lauds h;m.

verses.sa:
अयं चक्रमिषणत्सूर्यस्य न्येतशं रीरमत्ससृमाणम् ।
आ कृष्ण ईं जुहुराणो जिघर्ति त्वचो बुध्ने रजसो अस्य योनौ ॥
verses.rom:
ayam chakramishanatsuryasya nyetasham riramatsasrimanam |
a krishna im juhurano jigharti tvacho budhne rajaso asya yonau ||
verses.en:
He urged the chariot-wheel of Surya forward: Etasa, speeding on his way, he rested.
Him the black undulating cloud bedeweth, in this mid-air's depth, at the base of darkness,

verses.sa: असिक्न्यां यजमानो न होता ॥
verses.rom: asiknyam yajamano na hota ||
verses.en: As in the night the sacrificing priest.

verses.sa:
गव्यन्त इन्द्रं सख्याय विप्रा अश्वायन्तो वृषणं वाजयन्तः ।
जनीयन्तो जनिदामक्षितोतिमा च्यावयामोऽवते न कोशम् ॥
verses.rom:
gavyanta indram sakhyaya vipra ashvayanto vrishanam vajayantah |
janiyanto janidamakshitotima chyavayamo'vate na kosham ||
verses.en:
Eager for booty, craving strength and horses, we-singers stir Indra, the strong, for friendship,
Who gives the wives we seek, whose succour fails not, to hasten, like a pitcher to the fountain.

verses.sa:
त्राता नो बोधि ददृशान आपिरभिख्याता मर्डिता सोम्यानाम् ।
सखा पिता पितृतमः पितॄणां कर्तेमु लोकमुशते वयोधाः ॥
verses.rom:
trata no bodhi dadrishana apirabhikhyata mardita somyanam |
sakha pita pitritamah pitrinam kartemu lokamushate vayodhah ||
verses.en:
Be thou our guardian, show thyself our kinsman, watching and blessing those who pour the Soma;
As Friend, as Sire, most fatherly of fathers giving the suppliant vital strength and freedom.

verses.sa:
सखीयतामविता बोधि सखा गृणान इन्द्र स्तुवते वयो धाः ।
वयं ह्या ते चकृमा सबाध आभिः शमीभिर्महयन्त इन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
sakhiyatamavita bodhi sakha grinana indra stuvate vayo dhah |
vayam hya te chakrima sabadha abhih shamibhirmahayanta indra ||
verses.en:
Be helping Friend of those who seek thy friendship . give life, when lauded, Indra, to the singer.
For, Indra, we the priests have paid thee worship, exalting thee with these our sacrifices.

verses.sa:
स्तुत इन्द्रो मघवा यद्ध वृत्रा भूरीण्येको अप्रतीनि हन्ति ।
अस्य प्रियो जरिता यस्य शर्मन्नकिर्देवा वारयन्ते न मर्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
stuta indro maghava yaddha vritra bhurinyeko apratini hanti |
asya priyo jarita yasya sharmannakirdeva varayante na martah ||
verses.en:
Alone, when Indra Maghavan is lauded, he slayeth many ne'er-resisted Vrtras.
Him in whose keeping is the well-loved singer never do Gods or mortals stay or hinder.

verses.sa:
एवा न इन्द्रो मघवा विरप्शी करत्सत्या चर्षणीधृदनर्वा ।
त्वं राजा जनुषां धेह्यस्मे अधि श्रवो माहिनं यज्जरित्रे ॥
verses.rom:
eva na indro maghava virapshi karatsatya charshanidhridanarva |
tvam raja janusham dhehyasme adhi shravo mahinam yajjaritre ||
verses.en:
E’en so let Maghavan, the loud-voiced Indra, give us true blessings, foeless, men's upholder.
King of all creatures, give us glory amply, exalted glory due to him who lauds thee.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu shtuta indra nu grinana isham jaritre nadyo na pipeh |
akari te harivo brahma navyam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let power swell high like rivers for the singer.
For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays! is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
अयं पन्था अनुवित्तः पुराणो यतो देवा उदजायन्त विश्वे ।
अतश्चिदा जनिषीष्ट प्रवृद्धो मा मातरममुया पत्तवे कः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam pantha anuvittah purano yato deva udajayanta vishve |
atashchida janishishta pravriddho ma mataramamuya pattave kah ||
verses.en:
THIS is the ancient and accepted pathway by which all Gods have come into existence.
Hereby could one be born though waxen mighty. Let him not, otherwise, destroy his Mother.

verses.sa:
नाहमतो निरया दुर्गहैतत्तिरश्चता पार्श्वान्निर्गमाणि ।
बहूनि मे अकृता कर्त्वानि युध्यै त्वेन सं त्वेन पृच्छै ॥
verses.rom:
nahamato niraya durgahaitattirashchata parshvannirgamani |
bahuni me akrita kartvani yudhyai tvena sam tvena prichchhai ||
verses.en:
Not this way go I forth: hard is the passage. Forth from the side obliquely will I issue.
Much that is yet undone must I accomplish; one must I combat and the other question.

verses.sa:
परायतीं मातरमन्वचष्ट न नानु गान्यनु नू गमानि ।
त्वष्टुर्गृहे अपिबत्सोममिन्द्रः शतधन्यं चम्वोः सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
parayatim mataramanvachashta na nanu ganyanu nu gamani |
tvashturgrihe apibatsomamindrah shatadhanyam chamvoh sutasya ||
verses.en:
He bent his eye upon the dying Mother: My word I now withdraw. That way I follow.
In Tvastar's dwelling India drank the Soma, a hundredworth of juice pressed from the mortar.

verses.sa:
किं स ऋधक्कृणवद्यं सहस्रं मासो जभार शरदश्च पूर्वीः ।
नही न्वस्य प्रतिमानमस्त्यन्तर्जातेषूत ये जनित्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
kim sa ridhakkrinavadyam sahasram maso jabhara sharadashcha purvih |
nahi nvasya pratimanamastyantarjateshuta ye janitvah ||
verses.en:
What strange act shall he do, he whom his Mother bore for a thousand months and many autumns?
No peer hath he among those born already, nor among those who shall be born hereafter.

verses.sa:
अवद्यमिव मन्यमाना गुहाकरिन्द्रं माता वीर्येणा न्यृष्टम् ।
अथोदस्थात्स्वयमत्कं वसान आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः ॥
verses.rom:
avadyamiva manyamana guhakarindram mata viryena nyrishtam |
athodasthatsvayamatkam vasana a rodasi aprinajjayamanah ||
verses.en:
Deeming him a reproach, his mother hid him, Indra, endowed with all heroic valour.
Then up he sprang himself, assumed his vesture, and filled, as soon as born, the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
एता अर्षन्त्यललाभवन्तीरृतावरीरिव संक्रोशमानाः ।
एता वि पृच्छ किमिदं भनन्ति कमापो अद्रिं परिधिं रुजन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
eta arshantyalalabhavantirritavaririva samkroshamanah |
eta vi prichchha kimidam bhananti kamapo adrim paridhim rujanti ||
verses.en:
With lively motion onward flow these waters, the Holy Ones, shouting, as 'twere, together.
Ask them to. tell thee what the floods are saying, what girdling rock the waters burst asunder.

verses.sa:
किमु ष्विदस्मै निविदो भनन्तेन्द्रस्यावद्यं दिधिषन्त आपः ।
ममैतान्पुत्रो महता वधेन वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजद्वि सिन्धून् ॥
verses.rom:
kimu shvidasmai nivido bhanantendrasyavadyam didhishanta apah |
mamaitanputro mahata vadhena vritram jaghanvan asrijadvi sindhun ||
verses.en:
Are they addressing him with words of welcome? Will the floods take on them the shame of Indra?
With his great thunderbolt my Son hath slaughtered Vrtra, and set these rivers free to wander.

verses.sa:
ममच्चन त्वा युवतिः परास ममच्चन त्वा कुषवा जगार ।
ममच्चिदापः शिशवे ममृड्युर्ममच्चिदिन्द्रः सहसोदतिष्ठत् ॥
verses.rom:
mamachchana tva yuvatih parasa mamachchana tva kushava jagara |
mamachchidapah shishave mamridyurmamachchidindrah sahasodatishthat ||
verses.en:
I cast thee from me, mine,-thy youthful mother: thee, mine own offspring, Kusava hath swallowed.
To him, mine infant, were the waters gracious. Indra, my Son, rose up in conquering vigour.

verses.sa:
ममच्चन ते मघवन्व्यंसो निविविध्वाँ अप हनू जघान ।
अधा निविद्ध उत्तरो बभूवाञ्छिरो दासस्य सं पिणग्वधेन ॥
verses.rom:
mamachchana te maghavanvyamso nivividhvan apa hanu jaghana |
adha nividdha uttaro babhuvanchhiro dasasya sam pinagvadhena ||
verses.en:
Thou art mine own, O Maghavan, whom Vyamsa struck to the ground and smote thy jaws in pieces.
But, smitten through, the mastery thou wonnest, and with thy bolt the Dasa's head thou crushedst.

verses.sa:
गृष्टिः ससूव स्थविरं तवागामनाधृष्यं वृषभं तुम्रमिन्द्रम् ।
अरीळ्हं वत्सं चरथाय माता स्वयं गातुं तन्व इच्छमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
grishtih sasuva sthaviram tavagamanadhrishyam vrishabham tumramindram |
arilham vatsam charathaya mata svayam gatum tanva ichchhamanam ||
verses.en:
The Heifer hath brought forth the Strong, the Mighty, the unconquerable Bull, the furious Indra.
The Mother left her unlicked Calf to wander, seeking himself, the path that he would follow.

verses.sa:
उत माता महिषमन्ववेनदमी त्वा जहति पुत्र देवाः ।
अथाब्रवीद्वृत्रमिन्द्रो हनिष्यन्सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व ॥
verses.rom:
uta mata mahishamanvavenadami tva jahati putra devah |
athabravidvritramindro hanishyansakhe vishno vitaram vi kramasva ||
verses.en:
Then to her mighty Child the Mother turned her, saying, My son, these Deities forsake thee.
Then Indra said, about to slaughter Vrtra, O my friend Vrtra, stride full boldly forward.

verses.sa:
कस्ते मातरं विधवामचक्रच्छयुं कस्त्वामजिघांसच्चरन्तम् ।
कस्ते देवो अधि मार्डीक आसीद्यत्प्राक्षिणाः पितरं पादगृह्य ॥
verses.rom:
kaste mataram vidhavamachakrachchhayum kastvamajighamsachcharantam |
kaste devo adhi mardika asidyatprakshinah pitaram padagrihya ||
verses.en:
Who was he then who made thy Mother widow? Who sought to stay thee lying still or moving?
What God, when by the foot thy Sire thou tookest and slewest, was at hand to give thee comfort?

verses.sa:
अवर्त्या शुन आन्त्राणि पेचे न देवेषु विविदे मर्डितारम् ।
अपश्यं जायाममहीयमानामधा मे श्येनो मध्वा जभार ॥
verses.rom:
avartya shuna antrani peche na deveshu vivide marditaram |
apashyam jayamamahiyamanamadha me shyeno madhva jabhara ||
verses.en:
In deep distress I cooked a dog's intestines. Among the Gods I found not one to comfort.
My consort I beheld in degradation. The Falcon then brought me the pleasant Soma.

verses.sa:
एवा त्वामिन्द्र वज्रिन्नत्र विश्वे देवासः सुहवास ऊमाः ।
महामुभे रोदसी वृद्धमृष्वं निरेकमिद्वृणते वृत्रहत्ये ॥
verses.rom:
eva tvamindra vajrinnatra vishve devasah suhavasa umah |
mahamubhe rodasi vriddhamrishvam nirekamidvrinate vritrahatye ||
verses.en:
THEE, verily, O Thunder-wielding Indra, all the Gods here, the Helpers swift to listen,
And both the worlds elected, thee the Mighty, High, waxen strong, alone to slaughter Vrtra.

verses.sa:
अवासृजन्त जिव्रयो न देवा भुवः सम्राळिन्द्र सत्ययोनिः ।
अहन्नहिं परिशयानमर्णः प्र वर्तनीररदो विश्वधेनाः ॥
verses.rom:
avasrijanta jivrayo na deva bhuvah samralindra satyayonih |
ahannahim parishayanamarnah pra vartanirarado vishvadhenah ||
verses.en:
The Gods, as worn witheld, relaxed their efforts: thou, Indra, born of truth, wast Sovran Ruler.
Thou slewest Ahi who besieged the waters, and duggest out their all-supporting channels.

verses.sa:
अतृप्णुवन्तं वियतमबुध्यमबुध्यमानं सुषुपाणमिन्द्र ।
सप्त प्रति प्रवत आशयानमहिं वज्रेण वि रिणा अपर्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
atripnuvantam viyatamabudhyamabudhyamanam sushupanamindra |
sapta prati pravata ashayanamahim vajrena vi rina aparvan ||
verses.en:
The insatiate one, extended, hard to waken, who slumbered in perpetual sleep, O Indra,
The Dragon stretched against the seven prone rivers, where no joint was, thou rentest with thy thunder.

verses.sa:
अक्षोदयच्छवसा क्षाम बुध्नं वार्ण वातस्तविषीभिरिन्द्रः ।
दृळ्हान्यौभ्नादुशमान ओजोऽवाभिनत्ककुभः पर्वतानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
akshodayachchhavasa kshama budhnam varna vatastavishibhirindrah |
drilhanyaubhnadushamana ojo'vabhinatkakubhah parvatanam ||
verses.en:
Indra with might shook earth and her foundation as the wind stirs the water with its fury.
Striving, with strength he burst the firm asunder, and tore away the summits of the mountains.

verses.sa:
अभि प्र दद्रुर्जनयो न गर्भं रथा इव प्र ययुः साकमद्रयः ।
अतर्पयो विसृत उब्ज ऊर्मीन्त्वं वृताँ अरिणा इन्द्र सिन्धून् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pra dadrurjanayo na garbham ratha iva pra yayuh sakamadrayah |
atarpayo visrita ubja urmintvam vritan arina indra sindhun ||
verses.en:
They ran to thee as mothers to their offspring: the clouds, like chariots, hastened forth together.
Thou didst refresh the streams and force the billows: thou, Indra, settest free obstructed rivers.

verses.sa:
त्वं महीमवनिं विश्वधेनां तुर्वीतये वय्याय क्षरन्तीम् ।
अरमयो नमसैजदर्णः सुतरणाँ अकृणोरिन्द्र सिन्धून् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam mahimavanim vishvadhenam turvitaye vayyaya ksharantim |
aramayo namasaijadarnah sutaranan akrinorindra sindhun ||
verses.en:
Thou for the sake of Vayya and Turviti didst stay the great stream, flowing, allsustaining:
Yea, at their prayer didst check the rushing river and make the floods easy to cross, O Indra.

verses.sa:
प्राग्रुवो नभन्वो न वक्वा ध्वस्रा अपिन्वद्युवतीरृतज्ञाः ।
धन्वान्यज्राँ अपृणक्तृषाणाँ अधोगिन्द्र स्तर्यो दंसुपत्नीः ॥
verses.rom:
pragruvo nabhanvo na vakva dhvasra apinvadyuvatirritajnah |
dhanvanyajran aprinaktrishanan adhogindra staryo damsupatnih ||
verses.en:
He let the young Maids skilled in Law, unwedded, like fountains, bubbling, flow forth streaming onward.
He inundated thirsty plains and deserts, and milked the dry Cows of the mighty master.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीरुषसः शरदश्च गूर्ता वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजद्वि सिन्धून् ।
परिष्ठिता अतृणद्बद्बधानाः सीरा इन्द्रः स्रवितवे पृथिव्या ॥
verses.rom:
purvirushasah sharadashcha gurta vritram jaghanvan asrijadvi sindhun |
parishthita atrinadbadbadhanah sira indrah sravitave prithivya ||
verses.en:
Through many a morn and many a lovely autumn, having slain Vrtra, lie set free the rivers.
Indra hath set at liberty to wander on earth the streams encompassed pressed together.

verses.sa:
वम्रीभिः पुत्रमग्रुवो अदानं निवेशनाद्धरिव आ जभर्थ ।
व्यन्धो अख्यदहिमाददानो निर्भूदुखच्छित्समरन्त पर्व ॥
verses.rom:
vamribhih putramagruvo adanam niveshanaddhariva a jabhartha |
vyandho akhyadahimadadano nirbhudukhachchhitsamaranta parva ||
verses.en:
Lord of Bay Steeds, thou broughtest from the ant-hill the unwedded damsel's son whom ants were eating.
The blind saw clearly, as he grasped the serpent, rose, brake the jar: his joints again united.

verses.sa:
प्र ते पूर्वाणि करणानि विप्राविद्वाँ आह विदुषे करांसि ।
यथायथा वृष्ण्यानि स्वगूर्तापांसि राजन्नर्याविवेषीः ॥
verses.rom:
pra te purvani karanani vipravidvan aha vidushe karamsi |
yathayatha vrishnyani svagurtapamsi rajannaryaviveshih ||
verses.en:
To the wise man, O Sage and Sovran Ruler, the man who knoweth all thine ancient exploits.
Hath told these deeds of might as thou hast wrought them, great acts, spontaneous, and to man's advantage.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu shtuta indra nu grinana isham jaritre nadyo na pipeh |
akari te harivo brahma navyam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let powers swell high, like rivers, for the singer.
For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays! is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्द्रो दूरादा न आसादभिष्टिकृदवसे यासदुग्रः ।
ओजिष्ठेभिर्नृपतिर्वज्रबाहुः संगे समत्सु तुर्वणिः पृतन्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
a na indro durada na asadabhishtikridavase yasadugrah |
ojishthebhirnripatirvajrabahuh samge samatsu turvanih pritanyun ||
verses.en:
FROM near or far away may mighty Indra giver of succour, come for our protection
Lord of men, armed with thunder, with the Strongest, slaying his foes in conflict, in the battles.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्द्रो हरिभिर्यात्वच्छार्वाचीनोऽवसे राधसे च ।
तिष्ठाति वज्री मघवा विरप्शीमं यज्ञमनु नो वाजसातौ ॥
verses.rom:
a na indro haribhiryatvachchharvachino'vase radhase cha |
tishthati vajri maghava virapshimam yajnamanu no vajasatau ||
verses.en:
May Indra come to us with Tawny Coursers, inclined to us, to favour and enrich us.
May Maghavan, loud-voiced and wielding thunder, stand by us at this sacrifice, in combat.

verses.sa:
इमं यज्ञं त्वमस्माकमिन्द्र पुरो दधत्सनिष्यसि क्रतुं नः ।
श्वघ्नीव वज्रिन्सनये धनानां त्वया वयमर्य आजिं जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
imam yajnam tvamasmakamindra puro dadhatsanishyasi kratum nah |
shvaghniva vajrinsanaye dhananam tvaya vayamarya ajim jayema ||
verses.en:
Thou, honouring this our sacrifice, O Indra, shalt give us strength and fill us full of courage.
To win the booty, Thunder-armed! like hunters may we with thee subdue in fight our foemen.

verses.sa:
उशन्नु षु णः सुमना उपाके सोमस्य नु सुषुतस्य स्वधावः ।
पा इन्द्र प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वः समन्धसा ममदः पृष्ठ्येन ॥
verses.rom:
ushannu shu nah sumana upake somasya nu sushutasya svadhavah |
pa indra pratibhritasya madhvah samandhasa mamadah prishthyena ||
verses.en:
Loving us well, benevolent, close beside us, drink, Godlike Indra, of the well pressed Soma.
Drink of the meath we offer, and delight thee with food that cometh from the mountain ridges.

verses.sa:
वि यो ररप्श ऋषिभिर्नवेभिर्वृक्षो न पक्वः सृण्यो न जेता ।
मर्यो न योषामभि मन्यमानोऽच्छा विवक्मि पुरुहूतमिन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi yo rarapsha rishibhirnavebhirvriksho na pakvah srinyo na jeta |
maryo na yoshamabhi manyamano'chchha vivakmi puruhutamindram ||
verses.en:
Him who is sung aloud by recent sages, like a ripe-fruited tree, a scythe-armed victor,-
I, like a bridegroom thinking of his consort, call hither Indra, him invoked of many;

verses.sa:
गिरिर्न यः स्वतवाँ ऋष्व इन्द्रः सनादेव सहसे जात उग्रः ।
आदर्ता वज्रं स्थविरं न भीम उद्नेव कोशं वसुना न्यृष्टम् ॥
verses.rom:
girirna yah svatavan rishva indrah sanadeva sahase jata ugrah |
adarta vajram sthaviram na bhima udneva kosham vasuna nyrishtam ||
verses.en:
Him who in native strength is like a mountain, the lofty Indra born or old for conquest,
Terrific wielder of the ancient thunder. filled full with splendour as a jar with water.

verses.sa:
न यस्य वर्ता जनुषा न्वस्ति न राधस आमरीता मघस्य ।
उद्वावृषाणस्तविषीव उग्रास्मभ्यं दद्धि पुरुहूत रायः ॥
verses.rom:
na yasya varta janusha nvasti na radhasa amarita maghasya |
udvavrishanastavishiva ugrasmabhyam daddhi puruhuta rayah ||
verses.en:
Whom from of old there is not one to hinder, none to curtail the riches of his bounty.
Pouring forth freely, O thou Strong and Mighty, vouchsafe us riches, God invoked of many!

verses.sa:
ईक्षे रायः क्षयस्य चर्षणीनामुत व्रजमपवर्तासि गोनाम् ।
शिक्षानरः समिथेषु प्रहावान्वस्वो राशिमभिनेतासि भूरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
ikshe rayah kshayasya charshaninamuta vrajamapavartasi gonam |
shikshanarah samitheshu prahavanvasvo rashimabhinetasi bhurim ||
verses.en:
Of wealth and homes of men thou art the ruler, and opener of the stable of the cattle.
Helper of men, winner of spoil in combats, thou leadest to an ample heap of riches.

verses.sa:
कया तच्छृण्वे शच्या शचिष्ठो यया कृणोति मुहु का चिदृष्वः ।
पुरु दाशुषे विचयिष्ठो अंहोऽथा दधाति द्रविणं जरित्रे ॥
verses.rom:
kaya tachchhrinve shachya shachishtho yaya krinoti muhu ka chidrishvah |
puru dashushe vichayishtho amho'tha dadhati dravinam jaritre ||
verses.en:
By what great might is he renowned as strongest, wherewith the Lofty One stirs up wild battles?
Best soother of the worshipper's great sorrow, he gives possessions to the man who lauds him.

verses.sa:
मा नो मर्धीरा भरा दद्धि तन्नः प्र दाशुषे दातवे भूरि यत्ते ।
नव्ये देष्णे शस्ते अस्मिन्त उक्थे प्र ब्रवाम वयमिन्द्र स्तुवन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no mardhira bhara daddhi tannah pra dashushe datave bhuri yatte |
navye deshne shaste asminta ukthe pra bravama vayamindra stuvantah ||
verses.en:
Slay us not; bring, bestow onus the ample gift which thou hast to give to him who offers.
At this new gift, with this laud sung before thee, extolling thee, we, Indra, will declare it.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu shtuta indra nu grinana isham jaritre nadyo na pipeh |
akari te harivo brahma navyam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let power swell high, like rivers, for the singer.
A new hymn, Lord of Bays! for thee is fashioned. May we, car-born, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
आ यात्विन्द्रोऽवस उप न इह स्तुतः सधमादस्तु शूरः ।
वावृधानस्तविषीर्यस्य पूर्वीर्द्यौर्न क्षत्रमभिभूति पुष्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
a yatvindro'vasa upa na iha stutah sadhamadastu shurah |
vavridhanastavishiryasya purvirdyaurna kshatramabhibhuti pushyat ||
verses.en:
MAY Indra come to us for our protection; here be the Hero, praised, our feast-companion.
May he whose powers are many, waxen mighty, cherish, like Dyaus, his own supreme dominion.

verses.sa:
तस्येदिह स्तवथ वृष्ण्यानि तुविद्युम्नस्य तुविराधसो नॄन् ।
यस्य क्रतुर्विदथ्यो न सम्राट् साह्वान्तरुत्रो अभ्यस्ति कृष्टीः ॥
verses.rom:
tasyediha stavatha vrishnyani tuvidyumnasya tuviradhaso nrin |
yasya kraturvidathyo na samrat sahvantarutro abhyasti krishtih ||
verses.en:
Here magnify his great heroic exploits, most glorious One, enriching men with bounties,
Whose will is like a Sovran in assembly, who rules the people, Conqueror, all-surpassing.

verses.sa:
आ यात्विन्द्रो दिव आ पृथिव्या मक्षू समुद्रादुत वा पुरीषात् ।
स्वर्णरादवसे नो मरुत्वान्परावतो वा सदनादृतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
a yatvindro diva a prithivya makshu samudraduta va purishat |
svarnaradavase no marutvanparavato va sadanadritasya ||
verses.en:
Hither let Indra come from earth or heaven, hither with speech from firmament or ocean;
With Maruts, from the realm of light to aid us, or from a distance, from the seat of Order.

verses.sa:
स्थूरस्य रायो बृहतो य ईशे तमु ष्टवाम विदथेष्विन्द्रम् ।
यो वायुना जयति गोमतीषु प्र धृष्णुया नयति वस्यो अच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
sthurasya rayo brihato ya ishe tamu shtavama vidatheshvindram |
yo vayuna jayati gomatishu pra dhrishnuya nayati vasyo achchha ||
verses.en:
That Indra will we laud in our assemblies, him who is Lord of great and lasting riches,
Victor with Vayu where the herds are gathered, who leads with boldness on to higher fortune.

verses.sa:
उप यो नमो नमसि स्तभायन्नियर्ति वाचं जनयन्यजध्यै ।
ऋञ्जसानः पुरुवार उक्थैरेन्द्रं कृण्वीत सदनेषु होता ॥
verses.rom:
upa yo namo namasi stabhayanniyarti vacham janayanyajadhyai |
rinjasanah puruvara ukthairendram krinvita sadaneshu hota ||
verses.en:
May the Priest, Lord of many blessings, striving,-who fixing reverence on reverence, giving
Vent to his voice, inciteth men to worship with lauds bring Indra hither to our dwellings.

verses.sa:
धिषा यदि धिषण्यन्तः सरण्यान्सदन्तो अद्रिमौशिजस्य गोहे ।
आ दुरोषाः पास्त्यस्य होता यो नो महान्संवरणेषु वह्निः ॥
verses.rom:
dhisha yadi dhishanyantah saranyansadanto adrimaushijasya gohe |
a duroshah pastyasya hota yo no mahansamvaraneshu vahnih ||
verses.en:
When sitting pondering in deep devotion in Ausija's abode they ply the press-stone,
May he whose wrath is fierce, the mighty bearer, come as the house-lord's priest within our chambers.

verses.sa:
सत्रा यदीं भार्वरस्य वृष्णः सिषक्ति शुष्म स्तुवते भराय ।
गुहा यदीमौशिजस्य गोहे प्र यद्धिये प्रायसे मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
satra yadim bharvarasya vrishnah sishakti shushma stuvate bharaya |
guha yadimaushijasya gohe pra yaddhiye prayase madaya ||
verses.en:
Surely the power of Bharvara the mighty for ever helpeth to support the singer;
That which in Ausija's abode lies hidden, to come forth for delight and for devotion.

verses.sa:
वि यद्वरांसि पर्वतस्य वृण्वे पयोभिर्जिन्वे अपां जवांसि ।
विदद्गौरस्य गवयस्य गोहे यदी वाजाय सुध्यो वहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
vi yadvaramsi parvatasya vrinve payobhirjinve apam javamsi |
vidadgaurasya gavayasya gohe yadi vajaya sudhyo vahanti ||
verses.en:
When he unbars the spaces of the mountains, and quickens with his floods the water-torrents,
He finds in lair the buffalo and wild-ox when the wise lead him on to vigorous exploit.

verses.sa:
भद्रा ते हस्ता सुकृतोत पाणी प्रयन्तारा स्तुवते राध इन्द्र ।
का ते निषत्तिः किमु नो ममत्सि किं नोदुदु हर्षसे दातवा उ ॥
verses.rom:
bhadra te hasta sukritota pani prayantara stuvate radha indra |
ka te nishattih kimu no mamatsi kim nodudu harshase datava u ||
verses.en:
Auspicious are thy hands, thine arms well fashioned which proffer bounty, Indra, to thy praiser.
What sloth is this? Why dost thou not rejoice thee? Why dost thou not delight thyself with giving?

verses.sa:
एवा वस्व इन्द्रः सत्यः सम्राड्ढन्ता वृत्रं वरिवः पूरवे कः ।
पुरुष्टुत क्रत्वा नः शग्धि रायो भक्षीय तेऽवसो दैव्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
eva vasva indrah satyah samraddhanta vritram varivah purave kah |
purushtuta kratva nah shagdhi rayo bhakshiya te'vaso daivyasya ||
verses.en:
So Indra is the truthful Lord of treasure. Freedom he gave to man by slaying Vrtra.
Much-lauded! help us with thy power to riches: may I be sharer of thy Godlike favour.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu shtuta indra nu grinana isham jaritre nadyo na pipeh |
akari te harivo brahma navyam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let power swell high, like rivers, for,the singer.
For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays! is fashioned. May we, care-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
यन्न इन्द्रो जुजुषे यच्च वष्टि तन्नो महान्करति शुष्म्या चित् ।
ब्रह्म स्तोमं मघवा सोममुक्था यो अश्मानं शवसा बिभ्रदेति ॥
verses.rom:
yanna indro jujushe yachcha vashti tanno mahankarati shushmya chit |
brahma stomam maghava somamuktha yo ashmanam shavasa bibhradeti ||
verses.en:
THAT gift of ours which Indra loves and welcomes, even that he makes for us, the Great and Strong One.
He who comes wielding in his might the thunder, Maghavan, gives prayer, praise, and laud, and Soma.

verses.sa:
वृषा वृषन्धिं चतुरश्रिमस्यन्नुग्रो बाहुभ्यां नृतमः शचीवान् ।
श्रिये परुष्णीमुषमाण ऊर्णां यस्याः पर्वाणि सख्याय विव्ये ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha vrishandhim chaturashrimasyannugro bahubhyam nritamah shachivan |
shriye parushnimushamana urnam yasyah parvani sakhyaya vivye ||
verses.en:
Bull, hurler of the four-edged rain-producer with both his arms, strong, mighty, most heroic;
Wearing as wool Parusni for adornment, whose joints for sake of friendship he hath covered.

verses.sa:
यो देवो देवतमो जायमानो महो वाजेभिर्महद्भिश्च शुष्मैः ।
दधानो वज्रं बाह्वोरुशन्तं द्याममेन रेजयत्प्र भूम ॥
verses.rom:
yo devo devatamo jayamano maho vajebhirmahadbhishcha shushmaih |
dadhano vajram bahvorushantam dyamamena rejayatpra bhuma ||
verses.en:
God who of all the Gods was born divinest, endowed with ample strength and mighty powers,
And bearing in his arms the yearning thunder, with violent rush caused heaven and earth to tremble.

verses.sa:
विश्वा रोधांसि प्रवतश्च पूर्वीर्द्यौरृष्वाज्जनिमन्रेजत क्षाः ।
आ मातरा भरति शुष्म्या गोर्नृवत्परिज्मन्नोनुवन्त वाताः ॥
verses.rom:
vishva rodhamsi pravatashcha purvirdyaurrishvajjanimanrejata kshah |
a matara bharati shushmya gornrivatparijmannonuvanta vatah ||
verses.en:
Before the High God, at his birth, heaven trembled, earth, many floods and all the precipices.
The Strong One bringeth nigh the Bull's two Parents: loud sing the winds, like men, in air's mid-region.

verses.sa:
ता तू त इन्द्र महतो महानि विश्वेष्वित्सवनेषु प्रवाच्या ।
यच्छूर धृष्णो धृषता दधृष्वानहिं वज्रेण शवसाविवेषीः ॥
verses.rom:
ta tu ta indra mahato mahani vishveshvitsavaneshu pravachya |
yachchhura dhrishno dhrishata dadhrishvanahim vajrena shavasaviveshih ||
verses.en:
These are thy great deeds, Indra, thine, the Mighty, deeds to be told aloud at all libations,
That thou, O Hero, bold and boldly daring, didst with thy bolt, by strength, destroy the Dragon.

verses.sa:
ता तू ते सत्या तुविनृम्ण विश्वा प्र धेनवः सिस्रते वृष्ण ऊध्नः ।
अधा ह त्वद्वृषमणो भियानाः प्र सिन्धवो जवसा चक्रमन्त ॥
verses.rom:
ta tu te satya tuvinrimna vishva pra dhenavah sisrate vrishna udhnah |
adha ha tvadvrishamano bhiyanah pra sindhavo javasa chakramanta ||
verses.en:
True are all these thy deeds, O Most Heroic. The Milch-kine issued from the streaming udder.
In fear of thee, O thou of manly spirit, the rivers swiftly set themselves in motion.

verses.sa:
अत्राह ते हरिवस्ता उ देवीरवोभिरिन्द्र स्तवन्त स्वसारः ।
यत्सीमनु प्र मुचो बद्बधाना दीर्घामनु प्रसितिं स्यन्दयध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
atraha te harivasta u deviravobhirindra stavanta svasarah |
yatsimanu pra mucho badbadhana dirghamanu prasitim syandayadhyai ||
verses.en:
With joy, O Indra, Lord of Tawny Coursers, the Sisters then, these Goddesses, extolled thee,
When thou didst give the prisoned ones their freedom to wander at their will in long succession.

verses.sa:
पिपीळे अंशुर्मद्यो न सिन्धुरा त्वा शमी शशमानस्य शक्तिः ।
अस्मद्र्यक्छुशुचानस्य यम्या आशुर्न रश्मिं तुव्योजसं गोः ॥
verses.rom:
pipile amshurmadyo na sindhura tva shami shashamanasya shaktih |
asmadryakchhushuchanasya yamya ashurna rashmim tuvyojasam goh ||
verses.en:
Pressed is the gladdening stalk as 'twere a river: so let the rite, the toiler's power, attract thee
To us-ward, of the Bright One, as the courser strains his. exceedingly strong leather bridle.

verses.sa:
अस्मे वर्षिष्ठा कृणुहि ज्येष्ठा नृम्णानि सत्रा सहुरे सहांसि ।
अस्मभ्यं वृत्रा सुहनानि रन्धि जहि वधर्वनुषो मर्त्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
asme varshishtha krinuhi jyeshtha nrimnani satra sahure sahamsi |
asmabhyam vritra suhanani randhi jahi vadharvanusho martyasya ||
verses.en:
Ever by us perform thy most heroic, thine highest, best victorious deeds, O Victor.
For us make Vrtras easy to be conquered: destroy the weapon of our mortal foeman.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमित्सु शृणुहि त्वमिन्द्रास्मभ्यं चित्राँ उप माहि वाजान् ।
अस्मभ्यं विश्वा इषणः पुरंधीरस्माकं सु मघवन्बोधि गोदाः ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamitsu shrinuhi tvamindrasmabhyam chitran upa mahi vajan |
asmabhyam vishva ishanah puramdhirasmakam su maghavanbodhi godah ||
verses.en:
Graciously listen to our prayer, O Indra, and strength of varied sort bestow thou on us.
Send to us all intelligence arid wisdom O Maghavan, be he who gives us cattle.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu shtuta indra nu grinana isham jaritre nadyo na pipeh |
akari te harivo brahma navyam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let wealth swell high like rivers to the singer.
For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays, is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
कथा महामवृधत्कस्य होतुर्यज्ञं जुषाणो अभि सोममूधः ।
पिबन्नुशानो जुषमाणो अन्धो ववक्ष ऋष्वः शुचते धनाय ॥
verses.rom:
katha mahamavridhatkasya hoturyajnam jushano abhi somamudhah |
pibannushano jushamano andho vavaksha rishvah shuchate dhanaya ||
verses.en:
How, what priest's sacrifice hath he made mighty, rejoicing in the Soma and its fountain?
Delighting in juice, eagerly drinking, the Lofty One hath waxed for splendid riches.

verses.sa:
को अस्य वीरः सधमादमाप समानंश सुमतिभिः को अस्य ।
कदस्य चित्रं चिकिते कदूती वृधे भुवच्छशमानस्य यज्योः ॥
verses.rom:
ko asya virah sadhamadamapa samanamsha sumatibhih ko asya |
kadasya chitram chikite kaduti vridhe bhuvachchhashamanasya yajyoh ||
verses.en:
What hero hath been made his feast-companion? Who hath been partner in his loving-kindness?
What know we of his wondrous acts? How often comes he to aid and speed the pious toiler?

verses.sa:
कथा शृणोति हूयमानमिन्द्रः कथा शृण्वन्नवसामस्य वेद ।
का अस्य पूर्वीरुपमातयो ह कथैनमाहुः पपुरिं जरित्रे ॥
verses.rom:
katha shrinoti huyamanamindrah katha shrinvannavasamasya veda |
ka asya purvirupamatayo ha kathainamahuh papurim jaritre ||
verses.en:
How heareth Indra offered invocation? How, hearing, marketh he the invoker's wishes?
What are his ancient acts of bounty? Wherefore call they him One who filleth full the singer?

verses.sa:
कथा सबाधः शशमानो अस्य नशदभि द्रविणं दीध्यानः ।
देवो भुवन्नवेदा म ऋतानां नमो जगृभ्वाँ अभि यज्जुजोषत् ॥
verses.rom:
katha sabadhah shashamano asya nashadabhi dravinam didhyanah |
devo bhuvannaveda ma ritanam namo jagribhvan abhi yajjujoshat ||
verses.en:
How doth the priest who laboureth, ever longing, win for himself the wealth which he possesseth?
May he, the God, mark well my truthful praises, having received the homage which he loveth.

verses.sa:
कथा कदस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ देवो मर्तस्य सख्यं जुजोष ।
कथा कदस्य सख्यं सखिभ्यो ये अस्मिन्कामं सुयुजं ततस्रे ॥
verses.rom:
katha kadasya ushaso vyushtau devo martasya sakhyam jujosha |
katha kadasya sakhyam sakhibhyo ye asminkamam suyujam tatasre ||
verses.en:
How, and what bond of friendship with a mortal hath the God chosen as this morn is breaking?
How, and what love hath he for those who love him, who have entwined in him their firm affection?

verses.sa:
किमादमत्रं सख्यं सखिभ्यः कदा नु ते भ्रात्रं प्र ब्रवाम ।
श्रिये सुदृशो वपुरस्य सर्गाः स्वर्ण चित्रतममिष आ गोः ॥
verses.rom:
kimadamatram sakhyam sakhibhyah kada nu te bhratram pra bravama |
shriye sudrisho vapurasya sargah svarna chitratamamisha a goh ||
verses.en:
Is then thy friendship with thy friends most mighty? Thy brotherhood with us, -when may we tell it?
The streams of milk move, as most wondrous sunlight, the beauty of the Lovely One for glory.

verses.sa:
द्रुहं जिघांसन्ध्वरसमनिन्द्रां तेतिक्ते तिग्मा तुजसे अनीका ।
ऋणा चिद्यत्र ऋणया न उग्रो दूरे अज्ञाता उषसो बबाधे ॥
verses.rom:
druham jighamsandhvarasamanindram tetikte tigma tujase anika |
rina chidyatra rinaya na ugro dure ajnata ushaso babadhe ||
verses.en:
About to stay the Indra-less destructive spirit he sharpens his keen arms to strike her.
Whereby the Strong, although our debts' exactor, drives in the distant mornings that we know not.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि शुरुधः सन्ति पूर्वीरृतस्य धीतिर्वृजिनानि हन्ति ।
ऋतस्य श्लोको बधिरा ततर्द कर्णा बुधानः शुचमान आयोः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya hi shurudhah santi purvirritasya dhitirvrijinani hanti |
ritasya shloko badhira tatarda karna budhanah shuchamana ayoh ||
verses.en:
Eternal Law hath varied food that strengthens; thought of eternal Law, removes transgressions.
The praise-hymn of eternal Law, arousing, glowing, hath opened the deaf ears of the living.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य दृळ्हा धरुणानि सन्ति पुरूणि चन्द्रा वपुषे वपूंषि ।
ऋतेन दीर्घमिषणन्त पृक्ष ऋतेन गाव ऋतमा विवेशुः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya drilha dharunani santi puruni chandra vapushe vapumshi |
ritena dirghamishananta priksha ritena gava ritama viveshuh ||
verses.en:
Firm-seated are eternal Law's foundations in its fair form are many splendid beauties.
By holy Law long lasting food they bring us; by holy Law have cows come to our worship.

verses.sa:
ऋतं येमान ऋतमिद्वनोत्यृतस्य शुष्मस्तुरया उ गव्युः ।
ऋताय पृथ्वी बहुले गभीरे ऋताय धेनू परमे दुहाते ॥
verses.rom:
ritam yemana ritamidvanotyritasya shushmasturaya u gavyuh |
ritaya prithvi bahule gabhire ritaya dhenu parame duhate ||
verses.en:
Fixing eternal Law he, too, upholds it swift moves the might of Law and wins the booty.
To Law belong the vast deep Earth and Heaven: Milch-kine supreme, to Law their milk they render.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu shtuta indra nu grinana isham jaritre nadyo na pipeh |
akari te harivo brahma navyam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
Now, Indra! lauded,- glorified with praises, let power swell high like rivers to the singer.
For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays, is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
का सुष्टुतिः शवसः सूनुमिन्द्रमर्वाचीनं राधस आ ववर्तत् ।
ददिर्हि वीरो गृणते वसूनि स गोपतिर्निष्षिधां नो जनासः ॥
verses.rom:
ka sushtutih shavasah sunumindramarvachinam radhasa a vavartat |
dadirhi viro grinate vasuni sa gopatirnishshidham no janasah ||
verses.en:
WHAT worthy praise will bring before us Indra, the Son of Strength, that he may grant us riches;
For he the Hero, gives the singer treasures: he is the Lord who sends us gifts, ye people.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहत्ये हव्यः स ईड्यः स सुष्टुत इन्द्रः सत्यराधाः ।
स यामन्ना मघवा मर्त्याय ब्रह्मण्यते सुष्वये वरिवो धात् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vritrahatye havyah sa idyah sa sushtuta indrah satyaradhah |
sa yamanna maghava martyaya brahmanyate sushvaye varivo dhat ||
verses.en:
To be invoked and hymned in fight with Vrtra, that well-praised Indra gives us real bounties.
That Maghavan brings comfort in the foray to the religious man who pours libations.

verses.sa:
तमिन्नरो वि ह्वयन्ते समीके रिरिक्वांसस्तन्वः कृण्वत त्राम् ।
मिथो यत्त्यागमुभयासो अग्मन्नरस्तोकस्य तनयस्य सातौ ॥
verses.rom:
taminnaro vi hvayante samike ririkvamsastanvah krinvata tram |
mitho yattyagamubhayaso agmannarastokasya tanayasya satau ||
verses.en:
Him, verily, the men invoke in combat; risking their lives they make him their protector,
When heroes, foe to foe, give up their bodies, fighting, each side, for children and their offspring.

verses.sa:
क्रतूयन्ति क्षितयो योग उग्राशुषाणासो मिथो अर्णसातौ ।
सं यद्विशोऽववृत्रन्त युध्मा आदिन्नेम इन्द्रयन्ते अभीके ॥
verses.rom:
kratuyanti kshitayo yoga ugrashushanaso mitho arnasatau |
sam yadvisho'vavritranta yudhma adinnema indrayante abhike ||
verses.en:
Strong God! the folk at need put forth their vigour, striving together in the whirl of battle.
When warrior bands encounter one another some in the grapple quit themselves like Indra.

verses.sa:
आदिद्ध नेम इन्द्रियं यजन्त आदित्पक्तिः पुरोळाशं रिरिच्यात् ।
आदित्सोमो वि पपृच्यादसुष्वीनादिज्जुजोष वृषभं यजध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
adiddha nema indriyam yajanta aditpaktih purolasham ririchyat |
aditsomo vi paprichyadasushvinadijjujosha vrishabham yajadhyai ||
verses.en:
Hence many a one worships the might of Indra: hence let the brew succeed the meal-oblation.
Hence let the Soma banish those who pour not: even hence I joy to pay the Strong One worship.

verses.sa:
कृणोत्यस्मै वरिवो य इत्थेन्द्राय सोममुशते सुनोति ।
सध्रीचीनेन मनसाविवेनन्तमित्सखायं कृणुते समत्सु ॥
verses.rom:
krinotyasmai varivo ya itthendraya somamushate sunoti |
sadhrichinena manasavivenantamitsakhayam krinute samatsu ||
verses.en:
Indra gives comfort to the man who truly presses, for him who longs for it, the Soma,
Not disaffected, with devoted spirit this man he takes to be his friend in battles.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्राय सुनवत्सोममद्य पचात्पक्तीरुत भृज्जाति धानाः ।
प्रति मनायोरुचथानि हर्यन्तस्मिन्दधद्वृषणं शुष्ममिन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
ya indraya sunavatsomamadya pachatpaktiruta bhrijjati dhanah |
prati manayoruchathani haryantasmindadhadvrishanam shushmamindrah ||
verses.en:
He who this day for Indra presses Soma, prepares the brew and fries the grains of barley-
Loving the hymns of that devoted servant, to him may Indra give heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
यदा समर्यं व्यचेदृघावा दीर्घं यदाजिमभ्यख्यदर्यः ।
अचिक्रदद्वृषणं पत्न्यच्छा दुरोण आ निशितं सोमसुद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
yada samaryam vyachedrighava dirgham yadajimabhyakhyadaryah |
achikradadvrishanam patnyachchha durona a nishitam somasudbhih ||
verses.en:
When the impetuous chief hath sought the conflict, and the lord looked upon the long-drawn battle,
The matron calls to the Strong God whom pressers of Soma have encouraged into the dwelling.

verses.sa:
भूयसा वस्नमचरत्कनीयोऽविक्रीतो अकानिषं पुनर्यन् ।
स भूयसा कनीयो नारिरेचीद्दीना दक्षा वि दुहन्ति प्र वाणम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhuyasa vasnamacharatkaniyo'vikrito akanisham punaryan |
sa bhuyasa kaniyo narirechiddina daksha vi duhanti pra vanam ||
verses.en:
He bid a small price for a thing of value: I was content, returning, still unpurchased.
He heightened not his insufficient offer. Simple and clever, both milk out the udder.

verses.sa:
क इमं दशभिर्ममेन्द्रं क्रीणाति धेनुभिः ।
यदा वृत्राणि जङ्घनदथैनं मे पुनर्ददत् ॥
verses.rom:
ka imam dashabhirmamendram krinati dhenubhih |
yada vritrani janghanadathainam me punardadat ||
verses.en:
Who for ten milch-kine purchaseth from me this Indra who is mine?
When he hath slain the Vrtras let the buyer give him back to me.

verses.sa:
नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः ।
अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu shtuta indra nu grinana isham jaritre nadyo na pipeh |
akari te harivo brahma navyam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
Now, Indra! lauded, glorified with praises, let wealth swell high like rivers for the singer.
For thee a new hymn, Lord of Bays, is fashioned. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
को अद्य नर्यो देवकाम उशन्निन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुजोष ।
को वा महेऽवसे पार्याय समिद्धे अग्नौ सुतसोम ईट्टे ॥
verses.rom:
ko adya naryo devakama ushannindrasya sakhyam jujosha |
ko va mahe'vase paryaya samiddhe agnau sutasoma itte ||
verses.en:
WHAT friend of man, God-loving, hath delighted, yearning therefor, this day in Indra's friendship?
Who with enkindled flame and flowing Soma laudeth him for his great protecting favour?

verses.sa:
को नानाम वचसा सोम्याय मनायुर्वा भवति वस्त उस्राः ।
क इन्द्रस्य युज्यं कः सखित्वं को भ्रात्रं वष्टि कवये क ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
ko nanama vachasa somyaya manayurva bhavati vasta usrah |
ka indrasya yujyam kah sakhitvam ko bhratram vashti kavaye ka uti ||
verses.en:
Who hath with prayer bowed to the Soma-lover? What pious man endues the beams of morning?
Who seeks bond, friendship, brotherhood with Indra? Who hath recourse unto the Sage for succour?

verses.sa:
को देवानामवो अद्या वृणीते क आदित्याँ अदितिं ज्योतिरीट्टे ।
कस्याश्विनाविन्द्रो अग्निः सुतस्यांशोः पिबन्ति मनसाविवेनम् ॥
verses.rom:
ko devanamavo adya vrinite ka adityan aditim jyotiritte |
kasyashvinavindro agnih sutasyamshoh pibanti manasavivenam ||
verses.en:
Who claims to-day the Deities' protection, asks Aditi for light, or the Adityas?
Of whose pressed stalk of Soma drink the Asvins, Indra, and Agni, well-inclined in spirit?

verses.sa:
तस्मा अग्निर्भारतः शर्म यंसज्ज्योक्पश्यात्सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ।
य इन्द्राय सुनवामेत्याह नरे नर्याय नृतमाय नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasma agnirbharatah sharma yamsajjyokpashyatsuryamuchcharantam |
ya indraya sunavametyaha nare naryaya nritamaya nrinam ||
verses.en:
To him shall Agni Bharata give shelter: long shall he look upon the Sun up-rising,
Who sayeth, Let us press the juice for Indra, man's Friend, the Hero manliest of heroes.

verses.sa:
न तं जिनन्ति बहवो न दभ्रा उर्वस्मा अदितिः शर्म यंसत् ।
प्रियः सुकृत्प्रिय इन्द्रे मनायुः प्रियः सुप्रावीः प्रियो अस्य सोमी ॥
verses.rom:
na tam jinanti bahavo na dabhra urvasma aditih sharma yamsat |
priyah sukritpriya indre manayuh priyah supravih priyo asya somi ||
verses.en:
Him neither few men overcome, nor many to him shall Aditi give spacious shelter.
Dear is the pious, the devout, to Indra dear is the zealous, dear the Soma-bringer.

verses.sa:
सुप्राव्यः प्राशुषाळेष वीरः सुष्वेः पक्तिं कृणुते केवलेन्द्रः ।
नासुष्वेरापिर्न सखा न जामिर्दुष्प्राव्योऽवहन्तेदवाचः ॥
verses.rom:
supravyah prashushalesha virah sushveh paktim krinute kevalendrah |
nasushverapirna sakha na jamirdushpravyo'vahantedavachah ||
verses.en:
This Hero curbs the mighty for the zealous: the presser's brew Indra possesses solely:
No brother, kin, or friend to him who pours not, destroyer of the dumb who would resist him.

verses.sa:
न रेवता पणिना सख्यमिन्द्रोऽसुन्वता सुतपाः सं गृणीते ।
आस्य वेदः खिदति हन्ति नग्नं वि सुष्वये पक्तये केवलो भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
na revata panina sakhyamindro'sunvata sutapah sam grinite |
asya vedah khidati hanti nagnam vi sushvaye paktaye kevalo bhut ||
verses.en:
Not with the wealthy churl who pours no Soma doth Indra, Soma-drinker, bind alliance.
He draws away his wealth and slays him naked, own Friend to him who offers, for oblation.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं परेऽवरे मध्यमास इन्द्रं यान्तोऽवसितास इन्द्रम् ।
इन्द्रं क्षियन्त उत युध्यमाना इन्द्रं नरो वाजयन्तो हवन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
indram pare'vare madhyamasa indram yanto'vasitasa indram |
indram kshiyanta uta yudhyamana indram naro vajayanto havante ||
verses.en:
Highest and lowest, men who stand between diem, going, returning, dwelling in contentment,
Those who show forth their strength when urged to battle-these are the men who call for aid on Indra.

verses.sa:
अहं मनुरभवं सूर्यश्चाहं कक्षीवाँ ऋषिरस्मि विप्रः ।
अहं कुत्समार्जुनेयं न्यृञ्जेऽहं कविरुशना पश्यता मा ॥
verses.rom:
aham manurabhavam suryashchaham kakshivan rishirasmi viprah |
aham kutsamarjuneyam nyrinje'ham kavirushana pashyata ma ||
verses.en:
I WAS aforetime Manu, I was Surya: I am the sage Kaksivan, holy singer.
Kutsa the son of Arjuni I master. I am the sapient Usana behold me.

verses.sa:
अहं भूमिमददामार्यायाहं वृष्टिं दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
अहमपो अनयं वावशाना मम देवासो अनु केतमायन् ॥
verses.rom:
aham bhumimadadamaryayaham vrishtim dashushe martyaya |
ahamapo anayam vavashana mama devaso anu ketamayan ||
verses.en:
I have bestowed the earth upon the Arya, and rain upon the man who brings oblation.
I guided forth the loudly-roaring waters, and the Gods moved according to my pleasure.

verses.sa:
अहं पुरो मन्दसानो व्यैरं नव साकं नवतीः शम्बरस्य ।
शततमं वेश्यं सर्वताता दिवोदासमतिथिग्वं यदावम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham puro mandasano vyairam nava sakam navatih shambarasya |
shatatamam veshyam sarvatata divodasamatithigvam yadavam ||
verses.en:
In the wild joy of Soma I demolished Sambara's forts, ninety-and-nine, together;
And, utterly, the hundredth habitation, when helping Divodasa Atithigva.

verses.sa:
प्र सु ष विभ्यो मरुतो विरस्तु प्र श्येनः श्येनेभ्य आशुपत्वा ।
अचक्रया यत्स्वधया सुपर्णो हव्यं भरन्मनवे देवजुष्टम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra su sha vibhyo maruto virastu pra shyenah shyenebhya ashupatva |
achakraya yatsvadhaya suparno havyam bharanmanave devajushtam ||
verses.en:
Before all birds be ranked this Bird, O Maruts; supreme of falcons be this fleet-winged Falcon,
Because, strong- pinioned, with no car to bear him, he brought to Manu the God loved oblation.

verses.sa:
भरद्यदि विरतो वेविजानः पथोरुणा मनोजवा असर्जि ।
तूयं ययौ मधुना सोम्येनोत श्रवो विविदे श्येनो अत्र ॥
verses.rom:
bharadyadi virato vevijanah pathoruna manojava asarji |
tuyam yayau madhuna somyenota shravo vivide shyeno atra ||
verses.en:
When the Bird brought it, hence in rapid motion sent on the wide path fleet as thought he hurried.
Swift he returned with sweetness of the Soma, and hence the Falcon hath acquired his glory.

verses.sa:
ऋजीपी श्येनो ददमानो अंशुं परावतः शकुनो मन्द्रं मदम् ।
सोमं भरद्दादृहाणो देवावान्दिवो अमुष्मादुत्तरादादाय ॥
verses.rom:
rijipi shyeno dadamano amshum paravatah shakuno mandram madam |
somam bharaddadrihano devavandivo amushmaduttaradadaya ||
verses.en:
Bearing the stalk, the Falcon speeding onward, Bird bringing from afar the draught that gladdens,
Friend of the Gods, brought, grasping fast, the Soma which be bad taken from yon loftiest heaven.

verses.sa:
आदाय श्येनो अभरत्सोमं सहस्रं सवाँ अयुतं च साकम् ।
अत्रा पुरंधिरजहादरातीर्मदे सोमस्य मूरा अमूरः ॥
verses.rom:
adaya shyeno abharatsomam sahasram savan ayutam cha sakam |
atra puramdhirajahadaratirmade somasya mura amurah ||
verses.en:
The Falcon took and brought the Soma, bearing thousand libations with him, yea, ten thousand.
The Bold One left malignities behind him, wise, in wild joy of Soma, left the foolish.

verses.sa:
गर्भे नु सन्नन्वेषामवेदमहं देवानां जनिमानि विश्वा ।
शतं मा पुर आयसीररक्षन्नध श्येनो जवसा निरदीयम् ॥
verses.rom:
garbhe nu sannanveshamavedamaham devanam janimani vishva |
shatam ma pura ayasirarakshannadha shyeno javasa niradiyam ||
verses.en:
I, As I lay within the womb, considered all generations of these Gods in order.
A hundred iron fortresses confined me, but forth I flew with rapid speed a Falcon,

verses.sa:
न घा स मामप जोषं जभाराभीमास त्वक्षसा वीर्येण ।
ईर्मा पुरंधिरजहादरातीरुत वाताँ अतरच्छूशुवानः ॥
verses.rom:
na gha sa mamapa josham jabharabhimasa tvakshasa viryena |
irma puramdhirajahadaratiruta vatan atarachchhushuvanah ||
verses.en:
Not at his own free pleasure did he bear me: he conquered with his strength and manly courage.
Straightway the Bold One left the fiends behind him and passed the winds as he grew yet more mighty.

verses.sa:
अव यच्छ्येनो अस्वनीदध द्योर्वि यद्यदि वात ऊहुः पुरंधिम् ।
सृजद्यदस्मा अव ह क्षिपज्ज्यां कृशानुरस्ता मनसा भुरण्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
ava yachchhyeno asvanidadha dyorvi yadyadi vata uhuh puramdhim |
srijadyadasma ava ha kshipajjyam krishanurasta manasa bhuranyan ||
verses.en:
When with loud cry from heaven down sped the Falcon, thence hasting like the wind he bore the Bold One,
Then, wildly raging in his mind, the archer Kṛiṣânu aimed and loosed the string to strike him.

verses.sa:
ऋजिप्य ईमिन्द्रावतो न भुज्युं श्येनो जभार बृहतो अधि ष्णोः ।
अन्तः पतत्पतत्र्यस्य पर्णमध यामनि प्रसितस्य तद्वेः ॥
verses.rom:
rijipya imindravato na bhujyum shyeno jabhara brihato adhi shnoh |
antah patatpatatryasya parnamadha yamani prasitasya tadveh ||
verses.en:
The Falcon bore him from heaven's lofty summit as the swift car of Indra's Friend bore Bhujyu.
Then downward hither fell a flying feather of the Bird hasting forward in his journey.

verses.sa:
अध श्वेतं कलशं गोभिरक्तमापिप्यानं मघवा शुक्रमन्धः ।
अध्वर्युभिः प्रयतं मध्वो अग्रमिन्द्रो मदाय प्रति धत्पिबध्यै शूरो मदाय प्रति धत्पिबध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
adha shvetam kalasham gobhiraktamapipyanam maghava shukramandhah |
adhvaryubhih prayatam madhvo agramindro madaya prati dhatpibadhyai shuro madaya prati dhatpibadhyai ||
verses.en:
And now let Maghavan accept the beaker, white, filled with milk, filled with the shining liquid;
The best of sweet meath which the priests have offered: that Indra to his joy may drink, the Hero, that he may take and drink it to his rapture.

verses.sa:
त्वा युजा तव तत्सोम सख्य इन्द्रो अपो मनवे सस्रुतस्कः ।
अहन्नहिमरिणात्सप्त सिन्धूनपावृणोदपिहितेव खानि ॥
verses.rom:
tva yuja tava tatsoma sakhya indro apo manave sasrutaskah |
ahannahimarinatsapta sindhunapavrinodapihiteva khani ||
verses.en:
ALLIED with thee, in this thy friendship, Soma, Indra for man made waters flow together,
Slew Ahi, and sent forth the Seven Rivers, and opened as it were obstructed fountains.

verses.sa:
त्वा युजा नि खिदत्सूर्यस्येन्द्रश्चक्रं सहसा सद्य इन्दो ।
अधि ष्णुना बृहता वर्तमानं महो द्रुहो अप विश्वायु धायि ॥
verses.rom:
tva yuja ni khidatsuryasyendrashchakram sahasa sadya indo |
adhi shnuna brihata vartamanam maho druho apa vishvayu dhayi ||
verses.en:
Indu, with thee for his confederate, Indra swiftly with might pressed down the wheel of Surya.
What rolled, all life's support, on heaven's high summit was separated from the great oppressor.

verses.sa:
अहन्निन्द्रो अदहदग्निरिन्दो पुरा दस्यून्मध्यंदिनादभीके ।
दुर्गे दुरोणे क्रत्वा न यातां पुरू सहस्रा शर्वा नि बर्हीत् ॥
verses.rom:
ahannindro adahadagnirindo pura dasyunmadhyamdinadabhike |
durge durone kratva na yatam puru sahasra sharva ni barhit ||
verses.en:
Indra smote down, Agni consumed, O Indu, the Dasyus ere the noontide in the conflict.
Of those who gladly sought a hard-won dwelling he cast down many a thousand with his arrow.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्मात्सीमधमाँ इन्द्र दस्यून्विशो दासीरकृणोरप्रशस्ताः ।
अबाधेथाममृणतं नि शत्रूनविन्देथामपचितिं वधत्रैः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasmatsimadhaman indra dasyunvisho dasirakrinoraprashastah |
abadhethamamrinatam ni shatrunavindethamapachitim vadhatraih ||
verses.en:
Lower than all besides hast thou, O Indra, cast down the Dasyus, abject tribes of Dasas.
Ye drave away, ye put to death the foemen, and took great vengeance with your murdering weapons.

verses.sa:
एवा सत्यं मघवाना युवं तदिन्द्रश्च सोमोर्वमश्व्यं गोः ।
आदर्दृतमपिहितान्यश्ना रिरिचथुः क्षाश्चित्ततृदाना ॥
verses.rom:
eva satyam maghavana yuvam tadindrashcha somorvamashvyam goh |
adardritamapihitanyashna ririchathuh kshashchittatridana ||
verses.en:
So, of a truth, Indra and Soma, Heroes, ye burst the stable of the kine and horses,
The stable which the bar or stone obstructed; and piercing through set free the habitations.

verses.sa:
आ न स्तुत उप वाजेभिरूती इन्द्र याहि हरिभिर्मन्दसानः ।
तिरश्चिदर्यः सवना पुरूण्याङ्गूषेभिर्गृणानः सत्यराधाः ॥
verses.rom:
a na stuta upa vajebhiruti indra yahi haribhirmandasanah |
tirashchidaryah savana purunyangushebhirgrinanah satyaradhah ||
verses.en:
COME, lauded, unto us with powers and succours, O Indra, with thy Tawny Steeds; exulting,
Past even the foeman's manifold libations, glorified with our hymns, true Wealth-bestower.

verses.sa:
आ हि ष्मा याति नर्यश्चिकित्वान्हूयमानः सोतृभिरुप यज्ञम् ।
स्वश्वो यो अभीरुर्मन्यमानः सुष्वाणेभिर्मदति सं ह वीरैः ॥
verses.rom:
a hi shma yati naryashchikitvanhuyamanah sotribhirupa yajnam |
svashvo yo abhirurmanyamanah sushvanebhirmadati sam ha viraih ||
verses.en:
Man's Friend, to this our sacrifice he cometh marking how he is called by Soma-pressers.
Fearless, and conscious that his Steeds are noble, he joyeth with the Soma-pouring heroes.

verses.sa:
श्रावयेदस्य कर्णा वाजयध्यै जुष्टामनु प्र दिशं मन्दयध्यै ।
उद्वावृषाणो राधसे तुविष्मान्करन्न इन्द्रः सुतीर्थाभयं च ॥
verses.rom:
shravayedasya karna vajayadhyai jushtamanu pra disham mandayadhyai |
udvavrishano radhase tuvishmankaranna indrah sutirthabhayam cha ||
verses.en:
Make his cars hear, that he may show his vigour and may be joyful in the way he loveth.
May mighty Indra pouring forth in bounty bestow on us good roads and perfect safety;

verses.sa:
अच्छा यो गन्ता नाधमानमूती इत्था विप्रं हवमानं गृणन्तम् ।
उप त्मनि दधानो धुर्याशून्सहस्राणि शतानि वज्रबाहुः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha yo ganta nadhamanamuti ittha vipram havamanam grinantam |
upa tmani dadhano dhuryashunsahasrani shatani vajrabahuh ||
verses.en:
He who with succour comes to his implorer, the singer here who with his song invites him;
He who himself sets to the pole swift Coursers, he who hath hundreds, thousands, Thunder-wielder.

verses.sa:
त्वोतासो मघवन्निन्द्र विप्रा वयं ते स्याम सूरयो गृणन्तः ।
भेजानासो बृहद्दिवस्य राय आकाय्यस्य दावने पुरुक्षोः ॥
verses.rom:
tvotaso maghavannindra vipra vayam te syama surayo grinantah |
bhejanaso brihaddivasya raya akayyasya davane purukshoh ||
verses.en:
O Indra Maghavan, by thee protected may we be thine, princes and priests and singers,
Sharing the riches sent from lofty heaven which yields much food, and all desire its bounty.

verses.sa:
नकिरिन्द्र त्वदुत्तरो न ज्यायाँ अस्ति वृत्रहन् ।
नकिरेवा यथा त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
nakirindra tvaduttaro na jyayan asti vritrahan |
nakireva yatha tvam ||
verses.en:
O INDRA, Vrtra-slayer, none is better, mightier than thou:
Verily there is none like thee.

verses.sa:
सत्रा ते अनु कृष्टयो विश्वा चक्रेव वावृतुः ।
सत्रा महाँ असि श्रुतः ॥
verses.rom:
satra te anu krishtayo vishva chakreva vavrituh |
satra mahan asi shrutah ||
verses.en:
Like chariot-wheels these people all together follow after thee:
Thou ever art renowned as Great.

verses.sa:
विश्वे चनेदना त्वा देवास इन्द्र युयुधुः ।
यदहा नक्तमातिरः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve chanedana tva devasa indra yuyudhuh |
yadaha naktamatirah ||
verses.en:
Not even all the gathered Gods conquered thee, Indra, in the war,
When thou didst lengthen days by night.

verses.sa:
यत्रोत बाधितेभ्यश्चक्रं कुत्साय युध्यते ।
मुषाय इन्द्र सूर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatrota badhitebhyashchakram kutsaya yudhyate |
mushaya indra suryam ||
verses.en:
When for the sake of those oppressed, and Kutsa as he battled,
Thou stolest away the Sun's car-wheel.

verses.sa:
यत्र देवाँ ऋघायतो विश्वाँ अयुध्य एक इत् ।
त्वमिन्द्र वनूँरहन् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra devan righayato vishvan ayudhya eka it |
tvamindra vanunrahan ||
verses.en:
When, fighting singly, Indra. thou o'ercamest all the furious Gods,
Thou slewest those who strove with thee.

verses.sa:
यत्रोत मर्त्याय कमरिणा इन्द्र सूर्यम् ।
प्रावः शचीभिरेतशम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatrota martyaya kamarina indra suryam |
pravah shachibhiretasham ||
verses.en:
When also for a mortal man, Indra, thou speddest forth the Sun,
And holpest Etasa with might.

verses.sa:
किमादुतासि वृत्रहन्मघवन्मन्युमत्तमः ।
अत्राह दानुमातिरः ॥
verses.rom:
kimadutasi vritrahanmaghavanmanyumattamah |
atraha danumatirah ||
verses.en:
What? Vrtra-slayer, art not thou, Maghavan, fiercest in thy wrath?
So hast thou quelled the demon too.

verses.sa:
एतद्घेदुत वीर्यमिन्द्र चकर्थ पौंस्यम् ।
स्त्रियं यद्दुर्हणायुवं वधीर्दुहितरं दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
etadgheduta viryamindra chakartha paumsyam |
striyam yaddurhanayuvam vadhirduhitaram divah ||
verses.en:
And this heroic deed of might thou, Indra, also hast achieved,
That thou didst smite to death the Dame, Heaven's Daughter, meditating ill.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चिद्घा दुहितरं महान्महीयमानाम् ।
उषासमिन्द्र सं पिणक् ॥
verses.rom:
divashchidgha duhitaram mahanmahiyamanam |
ushasamindra sam pinak ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, Mighty One, didst crush Usas, though Daughter of the Sky.
When lifting up herself in pride.

verses.sa:
अपोषा अनसः सरत्सम्पिष्टादह बिभ्युषी ।
नि यत्सीं शिश्नथद्वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
aposha anasah saratsampishtadaha bibhyushi |
ni yatsim shishnathadvrisha ||
verses.en:
Then from her chariot Usas fled, affrighted, from her ruined car.
When the strong God had shattered it.

verses.sa:
एतदस्या अनः शये सुसम्पिष्टं विपाश्या ।
ससार सीं परावतः ॥
verses.rom:
etadasya anah shaye susampishtam vipashya |
sasara sim paravatah ||
verses.en:
So there this car of Usas lay, broken to pieces, in Vipas,
And she herself fled far away.

verses.sa:
उत सिन्धुं विबाल्यं वितस्थानामधि क्षमि ।
परि ष्ठा इन्द्र मायया ॥
verses.rom:
uta sindhum vibalyam vitasthanamadhi kshami |
pari shtha indra mayaya ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, didst. with magic power resist the overflowing stream
Who spread her waters o'er the land.

verses.sa:
उत शुष्णस्य धृष्णुया प्र मृक्षो अभि वेदनम् ।
पुरो यदस्य सम्पिणक् ॥
verses.rom:
uta shushnasya dhrishnuya pra mriksho abhi vedanam |
puro yadasya sampinak ||
verses.en:
Valiantly didst thou seize and take the store which Susna had amassed,
When thou didst crush his fortresses.

verses.sa:
उत दासं कौलितरं बृहतः पर्वतादधि ।
अवाहन्निन्द्र शम्बरम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta dasam kaulitaram brihatah parvatadadhi |
avahannindra shambaram ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, also smotest down Kulitara's son Sambara,
The Dasa, from the lofty hill.

verses.sa:
उत दासस्य वर्चिनः सहस्राणि शतावधीः ।
अधि पञ्च प्रधीँरिव ॥
verses.rom:
uta dasasya varchinah sahasrani shatavadhih |
adhi pancha pradhinriva ||
verses.en:
Of Dasa Varcin's thou didst slay the hundred thousand and the five,
Crushed like the fellies, of a car.

verses.sa:
उत त्यं पुत्रमग्रुवः परावृक्तं शतक्रतुः ।
उक्थेष्विन्द्र आभजत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tyam putramagruvah paravriktam shatakratuh |
uktheshvindra abhajat ||
verses.en:
So Indra, Lord of Heroes, Powers, caused the unwedded damsel's son,
The castaway, to share the lauds.

verses.sa:
उत त्या तुर्वशायदू अस्नातारा शचीपतिः ।
इन्द्रो विद्वाँ अपारयत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tya turvashayadu asnatara shachipatih |
indro vidvan aparayat ||
verses.en:
So sapient Indra, Lord of Might, brought Turvaga and Yadu, those
Who feared the flood, in safely o'er.

verses.sa:
उत त्या सद्य आर्या सरयोरिन्द्र पारतः ।
अर्णाचित्ररथावधीः ॥
verses.rom:
uta tya sadya arya sarayorindra paratah |
arnachitrarathavadhih ||
verses.en:
Arpa and Citraratha, both Aryas, thou, Indra, slewest swift,
On yonder side of Sarayu,

verses.sa:
अनु द्वा जहिता नयोऽन्धं श्रोणं च वृत्रहन् ।
न तत्ते सुम्नमष्टवे ॥
verses.rom:
anu dva jahita nayo'ndham shronam cha vritrahan |
na tatte sumnamashtave ||
verses.en:
Thou, Vrtra-slayer, didst conduct those two forlorn, the blind, the lame.
None may attain this bliss of thine.

verses.sa:
शतमश्मन्मयीनां पुरामिन्द्रो व्यास्यत् ।
दिवोदासाय दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
shatamashmanmayinam puramindro vyasyat |
divodasaya dashushe ||
verses.en:
For Divodasa, him who brought oblation, 1ndra overthrew
A hundred fortresses of stone.

verses.sa:
अस्वापयद्दभीतये सहस्रा त्रिंशतं हथैः ।
दासानामिन्द्रो मायया ॥
verses.rom:
asvapayaddabhitaye sahasra trimshatam hathaih |
dasanamindro mayaya ||
verses.en:
The thirty thousand Disas he with magic power and weapons sent
To slumber, for Dabhiti's sake.

verses.sa:
स घेदुतासि वृत्रहन्समान इन्द्र गोपतिः ।
यस्ता विश्वानि चिच्युषे ॥
verses.rom:
sa ghedutasi vritrahansamana indra gopatih |
yasta vishvani chichyushe ||
verses.en:
As such, O Vrtra-slayer, thou art general Lord of kine for all,
Thou Shaker of all things that be.

verses.sa:
उत नूनं यदिन्द्रियं करिष्या इन्द्र पौंस्यम् ।
अद्या नकिष्टदा मिनत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta nunam yadindriyam karishya indra paumsyam |
adya nakishtada minat ||
verses.en:
Indra, whatever deed of might thou hast this day to execute,
None be there now to hinder it.

verses.sa:
वामंवामं त आदुरे देवो ददात्वर्यमा ।
वामं पूषा वामं भगो वामं देवः करूळती ॥
verses.rom:
vamamvamam ta adure devo dadatvaryama |
vamam pusha vamam bhago vamam devah karulati ||
verses.en:
O Watchful One, may Aryaman the God give thee all goodly things.
May Risan, Bhaga, and the God Karulati give all things fair.

verses.sa:
कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा ।
कया शचिष्ठया वृता ॥
verses.rom:
kaya nashchitra a bhuvaduti sadavridhah sakha |
kaya shachishthaya vrita ||
verses.en:
WITH what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing Friend;
With what most mighty company?

verses.sa:
कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः ।
दृळ्हा चिदारुजे वसु ॥
verses.rom:
kastva satyo madanam mamhishtho matsadandhasah |
drilha chidaruje vasu ||
verses.en:
What genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst
Open e'en strongly-guarded wealth?

verses.sa:
अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम् ।
शतं भवास्यूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi shu nah sakhinamavita jaritrinam |
shatam bhavasyutibhih ||
verses.en:
Do thou who art Protector of us thy friends who praise thee
With hundred aids approach us.

verses.sa:
अभी न आ ववृत्स्व चक्रं न वृत्तमर्वतः ।
नियुद्भिश्चर्षणीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi na a vavritsva chakram na vrittamarvatah |
niyudbhishcharshaninam ||
verses.en:
Like as a courser's circling wheel, so turn thee hitherward to us,
Attracted by the hymns of men.

verses.sa:
प्रवता हि क्रतूनामा हा पदेव गच्छसि ।
अभक्षि सूर्ये सचा ॥
verses.rom:
pravata hi kratunama ha padeva gachchhasi |
abhakshi surye sacha ||
verses.en:
Thou seekest as it were thine own stations with swift descent of powers:
I share thee even with the Sun.

verses.sa:
सं यत्त इन्द्र मन्यवः सं चक्राणि दधन्विरे ।
अध त्वे अध सूर्ये ॥
verses.rom:
sam yatta indra manyavah sam chakrani dadhanvire |
adha tve adha surye ||
verses.en:
What time thy courage and his wheels together, Indra, run their course
With thee and with the Sun alike,

verses.sa:
उत स्मा हि त्वामाहुरिन्मघवानं शचीपते ।
दातारमविदीधयुम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta sma hi tvamahurinmaghavanam shachipate |
dataramavididhayum ||
verses.en:
So even, Lord of Power and Might, the people call thee Maghavan,
Giver, who pauses not to think.

verses.sa:
उत स्मा सद्य इत्परि शशमानाय सुन्वते ।
पुरू चिन्मंहसे वसु ॥
verses.rom:
uta sma sadya itpari shashamanaya sunvate |
puru chinmamhase vasu ||
verses.en:
And verily to him who toils and presses Soma juice for thee
Thou quickly givest ample wealth.

verses.sa:
नहि ष्मा ते शतं चन राधो वरन्त आमुरः ।
न च्यौत्नानि करिष्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
nahi shma te shatam chana radho varanta amurah |
na chyautnani karishyatah ||
verses.en:
No, not a hundred hinderers can check thy gracious bounty's flow,
Nor thy great deeds when thou wilt act.

verses.sa:
अस्माँ अवन्तु ते शतमस्मान्सहस्रमूतयः ।
अस्मान्विश्वा अभिष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
asman avantu te shatamasmansahasramutayah |
asmanvishva abhishtayah ||
verses.en:
May thine assistance keep us safe, thy hundred and thy thousand aids:
May all thy favours strengthen us.

verses.sa:
अस्माँ इहा वृणीष्व सख्याय स्वस्तये ।
महो राये दिवित्मते ॥
verses.rom:
asman iha vrinishva sakhyaya svastaye |
maho raye divitmate ||
verses.en:
Do thou elect us this place for friendship and prosperity,
And great celestial opulence.

verses.sa:
अस्माँ अविड्ढि विश्वहेन्द्र राया परीणसा ।
अस्मान्विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
asman aviddhi vishvahendra raya parinasa |
asmanvishvabhirutibhih ||
verses.en:
Favour us, Indra, evermore with overflowing store of wealth:
With all thy succours aid thou us.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं ताँ अपा वृधि व्रजाँ अस्तेव गोमतः ।
नवाभिरिन्द्रोतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyam tan apa vridhi vrajan asteva gomatah |
navabhirindrotibhih ||
verses.en:
With new protections, Indra, like an archer, open thou for us
The stables that are filled with kine.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं धृष्णुया रथो द्युमाँ इन्द्रानपच्युतः ।
गव्युरश्वयुरीयते ॥
verses.rom:
asmakam dhrishnuya ratho dyuman indranapachyutah |
gavyurashvayuriyate ||
verses.en:
Our chariot, Indra, boldly moves endued with splendour, ne'er repulsed,
Winning for us both kine and steeds.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमुत्तमं कृधि श्रवो देवेषु सूर्य ।
वर्षिष्ठं द्यामिवोपरि ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamuttamam kridhi shravo deveshu surya |
varshishtham dyamivopari ||
verses.en:
O Surya, make our fame to be most excellent among the Gods,
Most lofty as the heaven on high.

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि ।
महान्महीभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a tu na indra vritrahannasmakamardhama gahi |
mahanmahibhirutibhih ||
verses.en:
O THOU who slewest Vrtra, come, O Indra, hither to our side,
Mighty One with thy mighty aids.

verses.sa:
भृमिश्चिद्घासि तूतुजिरा चित्र चित्रिणीष्वा ।
चित्रं कृणोष्यूतये ॥
verses.rom:
bhrimishchidghasi tutujira chitra chitrinishva |
chitram krinoshyutaye ||
verses.en:
Swift and impetuous art thou, wondrous amid the well-dressed folk:
Thou doest marvels for our help.

verses.sa:
दभ्रेभिश्चिच्छशीयांसं हंसि व्राधन्तमोजसा ।
सखिभिर्ये त्वे सचा ॥
verses.rom:
dabhrebhishchichchhashiyamsam hamsi vradhantamojasa |
sakhibhirye tve sacha ||
verses.en:
Even with the weak thou smitest down him who is stronger, with thy strength
The mighty, with the Friends thou hast.

verses.sa:
वयमिन्द्र त्वे सचा वयं त्वाभि नोनुमः ।
अस्माँअस्माँ इदुदव ॥
verses.rom:
vayamindra tve sacha vayam tvabhi nonumah |
asmanasman idudava ||
verses.en:
O Indra, we are close to thee; to thee we sing aloud our songs:
Help and defend us, even us.

verses.sa:
स नश्चित्राभिरद्रिवोऽनवद्याभिरूतिभिः ।
अनाधृष्टाभिरा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
sa nashchitrabhiradrivo'navadyabhirutibhih |
anadhrishtabhira gahi ||
verses.en:
As such, O Caster of the Stone, come with thy succours wonderful,
Blameless, and irresistible.

verses.sa:
भूयामो षु त्वावतः सखाय इन्द्र गोमतः ।
युजो वाजाय घृष्वये ॥
verses.rom:
bhuyamo shu tvavatah sakhaya indra gomatah |
yujo vajaya ghrishvaye ||
verses.en:
May we be friends of one like thee, O Indra, with the wealth of kine,
Comrades for lively energy.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्येक ईशिष इन्द्र वाजस्य गोमतः ।
स नो यन्धि महीमिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyeka ishisha indra vajasya gomatah |
sa no yandhi mahimisham ||
verses.en:
For thou, O Indra, art alone the Lord of strength that comes from kine
So grant thou us abundant food.

verses.sa:
न त्वा वरन्ते अन्यथा यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम् ।
स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
verses.rom:
na tva varante anyatha yadditsasi stuto magham |
stotribhya indra girvanah ||
verses.en:
They turn thee not another way, when, lauded, Lover of the Song,
Thou wilt give wealth to those who praise.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा गोतमा गिरानूषत प्र दावने ।
इन्द्र वाजाय घृष्वये ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva gotama giranushata pra davane |
indra vajaya ghrishvaye ||
verses.en:
The Gotamas have sung their song of praise to thee that thou mayst give,
Indra, for lively energy.

verses.sa:
प्र ते वोचाम वीर्या या मन्दसान आरुजः ।
पुरो दासीरभीत्य ॥
verses.rom:
pra te vochama virya ya mandasana arujah |
puro dasirabhitya ||
verses.en:
We will declare thy hero deeds, what Disa forts thou brakest down,
Attacking them in rapturous joy.

verses.sa:
ता ते गृणन्ति वेधसो यानि चकर्थ पौंस्या ।
सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
verses.rom:
ta te grinanti vedhaso yani chakartha paumsya |
suteshvindra girvanah ||
verses.en:
The sages sing those manly deeds which, Indra, Lover of the Song,
Thou wroughtest when the Soma flowed.

verses.sa:
अवीवृधन्त गोतमा इन्द्र त्वे स्तोमवाहसः ।
ऐषु धा वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.rom:
avivridhanta gotama indra tve stomavahasah |
aishu dha viravadyashah ||
verses.en:
Indra, the Gotamas who bring thee praises have grown strong by thee.
Give them renown with hero sons.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि शश्वतामसीन्द्र साधारणस्त्वम् ।
तं त्वा वयं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi shashvatamasindra sadharanastvam |
tam tva vayam havamahe ||
verses.en:
For, Indra, verily thou art the general treasure even of all .
Thee, therefore, do we invocate.

verses.sa:
अर्वाचीनो वसो भवास्मे सु मत्स्वान्धसः ।
सोमानामिन्द्र सोमपाः ॥
verses.rom:
arvachino vaso bhavasme su matsvandhasah |
somanamindra somapah ||
verses.en:
Excellent Indra, turn to us: glad thee among us with the juice
Of Somas, Soma-drinker thou.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं त्वा मतीनामा स्तोम इन्द्र यच्छतु ।
अर्वागा वर्तया हरी ॥
verses.rom:
asmakam tva matinama stoma indra yachchhatu |
arvaga vartaya hari ||
verses.en:
May praise from us who think on thee, O Indra, bring thee near to us.
Turn thy two Bay Steeds hitherward.

verses.sa:
पुरोळाशं च नो घसो जोषयासे गिरश्च नः ।
वधूयुरिव योषणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
purolasham cha no ghaso joshayase girashcha nah |
vadhuyuriva yoshanam ||
verses.en:
Eat of our sacrificial cake: rejoice thee in the songs we sing.
Even as a lover in his bride.

verses.sa:
सहस्रं व्यतीनां युक्तानामिन्द्रमीमहे ।
शतं सोमस्य खार्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasram vyatinam yuktanamindramimahe |
shatam somasya kharyah ||
verses.en:
To India for a thousand steeds well-trained and fleet of foot we pray,
And hundred jars of Soma juice.

verses.sa:
सहस्रा ते शता वयं गवामा च्यावयामसि ।
अस्मत्रा राध एतु ते ॥
verses.rom:
sahasra te shata vayam gavama chyavayamasi |
asmatra radha etu te ||
verses.en:
We make a hundred of thy kine, yea, and a thousand, hasten nigh:
So let thy bounty come to us.

verses.sa:
दश ते कलशानां हिरण्यानामधीमहि ।
भूरिदा असि वृत्रहन् ॥
verses.rom:
dasha te kalashanam hiranyanamadhimahi |
bhurida asi vritrahan ||
verses.en:
We have obtained, a gift from thee, ten water-ewers wrought of gold:
Thou, Vrtra-slayer, givest much.

verses.sa:
भूरिदा भूरि देहि नो मा दभ्रं भूर्या भर ।
भूरि घेदिन्द्र दित्ससि ॥
verses.rom:
bhurida bhuri dehi no ma dabhram bhurya bhara |
bhuri ghedindra ditsasi ||
verses.en:
A bounteous Giver, give us much, bring much and not a trifling gift:
Much, Indra, wilt thou fain bestow.

verses.sa:
भूरिदा ह्यसि श्रुतः पुरुत्रा शूर वृत्रहन् ।
आ नो भजस्व राधसि ॥
verses.rom:
bhurida hyasi shrutah purutra shura vritrahan |
a no bhajasva radhasi ||
verses.en:
O Vrtra-slayer, thou art famed in many a place as bountiful
Hero, thy bounty let us share.

verses.sa:
प्र ते बभ्रू विचक्षण शंसामि गोषणो नपात् ।
माभ्यां गा अनु शिश्रथः ॥
verses.rom:
pra te babhru vichakshana shamsami goshano napat |
mabhyam ga anu shishrathah ||
verses.en:
I praise thy pair of Tawny Steeds, wise Son of him who giveth kine
Terrify not the cows with these.

verses.sa:
कनीनकेव विद्रधे नवे द्रुपदे अर्भके ।
बभ्रू यामेषु शोभेते ॥
verses.rom:
kaninakeva vidradhe nave drupade arbhake |
babhru yameshu shobhete ||
verses.en:
Like two slight images of girls, unrobed, upon a new-wrought post,
So shine the Bay Steeds in their course.

verses.sa:
अरं म उस्रयाम्णेऽरमनुस्रयाम्णे ।
बभ्रू यामेष्वस्रिधा ॥
verses.rom:
aram ma usrayamne'ramanusrayamne |
babhru yameshvasridha ||
verses.en: For me the Bays are ready when I start, or start not, with the dawn, Innocuous in the ways they take.

verses.sa:
प्र ऋभुभ्यो दूतमिव वाचमिष्य उपस्तिरे श्वैतरीं धेनुमीळे ।
ये वातजूतास्तरणिभिरेवैः परि द्यां सद्यो अपसो बभूवुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ribhubhyo dutamiva vachamishya upastire shvaitarim dhenumile |
ye vatajutastaranibhirevaih pari dyam sadyo apaso babhuvuh ||
verses.en:
I SEND my voice as herald to the Rbhus; I crave the white cow for the overspreading.
Wind-sped, the Skillful Ones in rapid motion have in an instant compassed round the heaven.

verses.sa:
यदारमक्रन्नृभवः पितृभ्यां परिविष्टी वेषणा दंसनाभिः ।
आदिद्देवानामुप सख्यमायन्धीरासः पुष्टिमवहन्मनायै ॥
verses.rom:
yadaramakrannribhavah pitribhyam parivishti veshana damsanabhih |
adiddevanamupa sakhyamayandhirasah pushtimavahanmanayai ||
verses.en:
What time the Rbus had with care and marvels done proper service to assist their Parents,
They won the friendship of the Gods; the Sages carried away the fruit of their devotion.

verses.sa:
पुनर्ये चक्रुः पितरा युवाना सना यूपेव जरणा शयाना ।
ते वाजो विभ्वाँ ऋभुरिन्द्रवन्तो मधुप्सरसो नोऽवन्तु यज्ञम् ॥
verses.rom:
punarye chakruh pitara yuvana sana yupeva jarana shayana |
te vajo vibhvan ribhurindravanto madhupsaraso no'vantu yajnam ||
verses.en:
May they who made their Parents, who were lying like posts that moulder, young again for ever,-
May Vaja, Vibhvan, Rbhu, joined with Indra , protect our sacrifice, the Soma-lovers.

verses.sa:
यत्संवत्समृभवो गामरक्षन्यत्संवत्समृभवो मा अपिंशन् ।
यत्संवत्समभरन्भासो अस्यास्ताभिः शमीभिरमृतत्वमाशुः ॥
verses.rom:
yatsamvatsamribhavo gamarakshanyatsamvatsamribhavo ma apimshan |
yatsamvatsamabharanbhaso asyastabhih shamibhiramritatvamashuh ||
verses.en:
As for a year the Rbhus kept the Milch-cow, throughout a year fashioned and formed her body,
And through a year's space still sustained her brightness, through these their labours they were made immortal.

verses.sa:
ज्येष्ठ आह चमसा द्वा करेति कनीयान्त्रीन्कृणवामेत्याह ।
कनिष्ठ आह चतुरस्करेति त्वष्ट ऋभवस्तत्पनयद्वचो वः ॥
verses.rom:
jyeshtha aha chamasa dva kareti kaniyantrinkrinavametyaha |
kanishtha aha chaturaskareti tvashta ribhavastatpanayadvacho vah ||
verses.en:
Two beakers let us make,- thus said the eldest. Let us make three,- this was the younger's sentence.
Four beakers let us make,- thus spoke the youngest. Tvastar approved this rede of yours, O Rbhus.

verses.sa:
सत्यमूचुर्नर एवा हि चक्रुरनु स्वधामृभवो जग्मुरेताम् ।
विभ्राजमानाँश्चमसाँ अहेवावेनत्त्वष्टा चतुरो ददृश्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
satyamuchurnara eva hi chakruranu svadhamribhavo jagmuretam |
vibhrajamananshchamasan ahevavenattvashta chaturo dadrishvan ||
verses.en:
The men spake truth and even so they acted: this Godlike way of theirs the Rbhus followed.
And Tvastar, when he looked on the four beakers resplendent as the day, was moved with envy.

verses.sa:
द्वादश द्यून्यदगोह्यस्यातिथ्ये रणन्नृभवः ससन्तः ।
सुक्षेत्राकृण्वन्ननयन्त सिन्धून्धन्वातिष्ठन्नोषधीर्निम्नमापः ॥
verses.rom:
dvadasha dyunyadagohyasyatithye ranannribhavah sasantah |
sukshetrakrinvannanayanta sindhundhanvatishthannoshadhirnimnamapah ||
verses.en:
When for twelve days the Rbhus joyed reposing as guests of him who never may be hidden,
Valley made fair fertile fields, they brought the rivers. Plants spread o'er deserts, waters filled the hollows.

verses.sa:
रथं ये चक्रुः सुवृतं नरेष्ठां ये धेनुं विश्वजुवं विश्वरूपाम् ।
त आ तक्षन्त्वृभवो रयिं नः स्ववसः स्वपसः सुहस्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
ratham ye chakruh suvritam nareshtham ye dhenum vishvajuvam vishvarupam |
ta a takshantvribhavo rayim nah svavasah svapasah suhastah ||
verses.en:
May they who formed the swift car, bearing Heroes, and the Cow omniform and all-impelling,
Even may they form wealth for us,-the Rbhus, dexterous-handed, deft in work and gracious.

verses.sa:
अपो ह्येषामजुषन्त देवा अभि क्रत्वा मनसा दीध्यानाः ।
वाजो देवानामभवत्सुकर्मेन्द्रस्य ऋभुक्षा वरुणस्य विभ्वा ॥
verses.rom:
apo hyeshamajushanta deva abhi kratva manasa didhyanah |
vajo devanamabhavatsukarmendrasya ribhuksha varunasya vibhva ||
verses.en:
So in their work the Gods had satisfaction, pondering it with thought and mental insight.
The Gods' expert artificer was Vaja, Indra's Rbhuksan, Varuna's was Vibhvan.

verses.sa:
ये हरी मेधयोक्था मदन्त इन्द्राय चक्रुः सुयुजा ये अश्वा ।
ते रायस्पोषं द्रविणान्यस्मे धत्त ऋभवः क्षेमयन्तो न मित्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye hari medhayoktha madanta indraya chakruh suyuja ye ashva |
te rayasposham dravinanyasme dhatta ribhavah kshemayanto na mitram ||
verses.en:
They whole made glad with sacrifice and praises, wrought the two Bays, his docile Steeds, for Indra,-
Rbhus, as those who wish a friend to prosper, bestow upon us gear and growth of riches.

verses.sa:
इदाह्नः पीतिमुत वो मदं धुर्न ऋते श्रान्तस्य सख्याय देवाः ।
ते नूनमस्मे ऋभवो वसूनि तृतीये अस्मिन्सवने दधात ॥
verses.rom:
idahnah pitimuta vo madam dhurna rite shrantasya sakhyaya devah |
te nunamasme ribhavo vasuni tritiye asminsavane dadhata ||
verses.en:
This day have they set gladdening drink before you. Not without toil are Gods inclined to friendship.
Therefore do ye who are so great, O Rbhus, vouchsafe us treasures at this third libation.

verses.sa:
ऋभुर्विभ्वा वाज इन्द्रो नो अच्छेमं यज्ञं रत्नधेयोप यात ।
इदा हि वो धिषणा देव्यह्नामधात्पीतिं सं मदा अग्मता वः ॥
verses.rom:
ribhurvibhva vaja indro no achchhemam yajnam ratnadheyopa yata |
ida hi vo dhishana devyahnamadhatpitim sam mada agmata vah ||
verses.en:
To this our sacrifice come Rbhu, Vibhvan, Vaja, and Indra with the gift of riches,
Because this day hath Dhisana the Goddess set drink for you: the gladdening draughts have reached you.

verses.sa:
विदानासो जन्मनो वाजरत्ना उत ऋतुभिरृभवो मादयध्वम् ।
सं वो मदा अग्मत सं पुरंधिः सुवीरामस्मे रयिमेरयध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
vidanaso janmano vajaratna uta ritubhirribhavo madayadhvam |
sam vo mada agmata sam puramdhih suviramasme rayimerayadhvam ||
verses.en:
Knowing your birth and rich in gathered treasure, Rbhus, rejoice together with the Rtus.
The gladdening draughts and wisdom have approached you: send ye us riches with good store of heroes.

verses.sa:
अयं वो यज्ञ ऋभवोऽकारि यमा मनुष्वत्प्रदिवो दधिध्वे ।
प्र वोऽच्छा जुजुषाणासो अस्थुरभूत विश्वे अग्रियोत वाजाः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vo yajna ribhavo'kari yama manushvatpradivo dadhidhve |
pra vo'chchha jujushanaso asthurabhuta vishve agriyota vajah ||
verses.en:
For you was made this sacrifice, O Rbhus, which ye, like men, won for yourselves aforetime.
To you come all who find in you their pleasure: ye all were-even the two elder-Vajas.

verses.sa:
