अभूदु वो विधते रत्नधेयमिदा नरो दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
पिबत वाजा ऋभवो ददे वो महि तृतीयं सवनं मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
abhudu vo vidhate ratnadheyamida naro dashushe martyaya |
pibata vaja ribhavo dade vo mahi tritiyam savanam madaya ||
verses.en:
Now for the mortal worshipper, O Heroes, for him who served you, was the gift of riches.
Drink, Vajas, Rbhus! unto you is offered, to gladden you, the third and great libation.

verses.sa:
आ वाजा यातोप न ऋभुक्षा महो नरो द्रविणसो गृणानाः ।
आ वः पीतयोऽभिपित्वे अह्नामिमा अस्तं नवस्व इव ग्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
a vaja yatopa na ribhuksha maho naro dravinaso grinanah |
a vah pitayo'bhipitve ahnamima astam navasva iva gman ||
verses.en:
Come to us, Heroes, Vajas and Rbhuksans, glorified for the sake of mighty treasure.
These draughts approach you as the day is closing, as cows, whose calves are newly-born, their stable.

verses.sa:
आ नपातः शवसो यातनोपेमं यज्ञं नमसा हूयमानाः ।
सजोषसः सूरयो यस्य च स्थ मध्वः पात रत्नधा इन्द्रवन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
a napatah shavaso yatanopemam yajnam namasa huyamanah |
sajoshasah surayo yasya cha stha madhvah pata ratnadha indravantah ||
verses.en:
Come to this sacrifice of ours, ye Children of Strength, invoked with humble adoration.
Drink of this meath, Wealth-givers, joined with Indra with whom ye are in full accord, ye Princes.

verses.sa:
सजोषा इन्द्र वरुणेन सोमं सजोषाः पाहि गिर्वणो मरुद्भिः ।
अग्रेपाभिरृतुपाभिः सजोषा ग्नास्पत्नीभी रत्नधाभिः सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
sajosha indra varunena somam sajoshah pahi girvano marudbhih |
agrepabhirritupabhih sajosha gnaspatnibhi ratnadhabhih sajoshah ||
verses.en:
Close knit with Varuna drink the Soma, Indra; close-knit, hymn-lover! with the Maruts drink it:
Close-knit with drinkers first, who drink in season; close-knit with heavenly Dames who give us treasures.

verses.sa:
सजोषस आदित्यैर्मादयध्वं सजोषस ऋभवः पर्वतेभिः ।
सजोषसो दैव्येना सवित्रा सजोषसः सिन्धुभी रत्नधेभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sajoshasa adityairmadayadhvam sajoshasa ribhavah parvatebhih |
sajoshaso daivyena savitra sajoshasah sindhubhi ratnadhebhih ||
verses.en:
Rejoice in full accord with the Adityas, in concord with the Parvatas, O Rbhus;
In full accord with Savitar, Divine One; in full accord with floods that pour forth riches.

verses.sa:
ये अश्विना ये पितरा य ऊती धेनुं ततक्षुरृभवो ये अश्वा ।
ये अंसत्रा य ऋधग्रोदसी ये विभ्वो नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः ॥
verses.rom:
ye ashvina ye pitara ya uti dhenum tatakshurribhavo ye ashva |
ye amsatra ya ridhagrodasi ye vibhvo narah svapatyani chakruh ||
verses.en:
Rbhus, who helped their Parents and the Asvins, who formed the Milch-cow and the pair of horses,
Made armour, set the heaven and earth asunder,-far- reaching Heroes, they have made good offspring.

verses.sa:
ये गोमन्तं वाजवन्तं सुवीरं रयिं धत्थ वसुमन्तं पुरुक्षुम् ।
ते अग्रेपा ऋभवो मन्दसाना अस्मे धत्त ये च रातिं गृणन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ye gomantam vajavantam suviram rayim dhattha vasumantam purukshum |
te agrepa ribhavo mandasana asme dhatta ye cha ratim grinanti ||
verses.en:
Ye who have wealth in cattle and in booty, in heroes, in rich sustenance and treasure,
Such, O ye Rbhus, first to drink, rejoicing, give unto us and those who laud our present.

verses.sa:
नापाभूत न वोऽतीतृषामानिःशस्ता ऋभवो यज्ञे अस्मिन् ।
समिन्द्रेण मदथ सं मरुद्भिः सं राजभी रत्नधेयाय देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
napabhuta na vo'titrishamanihshasta ribhavo yajne asmin |
samindrena madatha sam marudbhih sam rajabhi ratnadheyaya devah ||
verses.en:
Ye were not far: we have not left you thirsting, blameless in this our sacrifice, O Rbhus.
Rejoice you with the Maruts and with Indra, with the Kings, Gods! that ye may give us riches.

verses.sa:
इहोप यात शवसो नपातः सौधन्वना ऋभवो माप भूत ।
अस्मिन्हि वः सवने रत्नधेयं गमन्त्विन्द्रमनु वो मदासः ॥
verses.rom:
ihopa yata shavaso napatah saudhanvana ribhavo mapa bhuta |
asminhi vah savane ratnadheyam gamantvindramanu vo madasah ||
verses.en:
Come hither, O ye Sons of Strength, ye Rbhus; stay not afar, ye Children of Sudhanvan.
At this libation is your gift of treasure. Let gladdening draughts approach you after Indra's.

verses.sa:
आगन्नृभूणामिह रत्नधेयमभूत्सोमस्य सुषुतस्य पीतिः ।
सुकृत्यया यत्स्वपस्यया चँ एकं विचक्र चमसं चतुर्धा ॥
verses.rom:
agannribhunamiha ratnadheyamabhutsomasya sushutasya pitih |
sukrityaya yatsvapasyaya chan ekam vichakra chamasam chaturdha ||
verses.en:
Hither is come the Rbhus' gift of riches; here was the drinking of the well-pressed Soma,
Since by dexterity and skill as craftsmen ye made the single chalice to be fourfold

verses.sa:
व्यकृणोत चमसं चतुर्धा सखे वि शिक्षेत्यब्रवीत ।
अथैत वाजा अमृतस्य पन्थां गणं देवानामृभवः सुहस्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
vyakrinota chamasam chaturdha sakhe vi shikshetyabravita |
athaita vaja amritasya pantham ganam devanamribhavah suhastah ||
verses.en:
Ye made fourfold the chalice that wag single: ye spake these words and said, O Friend, assist us;
Then, Vajas! gained the path of life eternal, deft-handed Rbhus, to the Gods' assembly.

verses.sa:
किम्मयः स्विच्चमस एष आस यं काव्येन चतुरो विचक्र ।
अथा सुनुध्वं सवनं मदाय पात ऋभवो मधुनः सोम्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
kimmayah svichchamasa esha asa yam kavyena chaturo vichakra |
atha sunudhvam savanam madaya pata ribhavo madhunah somyasya ||
verses.en:
Out of what substance was that chalice fashioned which ye made fourfold by your art and wisdom?
Now for the gladdening draught press out the liquor, and drink, O Rbhus, of die meath of Soma.

verses.sa:
शच्याकर्त पितरा युवाना शच्याकर्त चमसं देवपानम् ।
शच्या हरी धनुतरावतष्टेन्द्रवाहावृभवो वाजरत्नाः ॥
verses.rom:
shachyakarta pitara yuvana shachyakarta chamasam devapanam |
shachya hari dhanutaravatashtendravahavribhavo vajaratnah ||
verses.en:
Ye with your cunning made your Parents youthful; the cup, for Gods to drink, ye formed with cunning;
With cunning, Rbhus, rich in treasure, fashioned the two swift Tawny Steeds who carry Indra.

verses.sa:
यो वः सुनोत्यभिपित्वे अह्नां तीव्रं वाजासः सवनं मदाय ।
तस्मै रयिमृभवः सर्ववीरमा तक्षत वृषणो मन्दसानाः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vah sunotyabhipitve ahnam tivram vajasah savanam madaya |
tasmai rayimribhavah sarvavirama takshata vrishano mandasanah ||
verses.en:
Whoso pours out for you, when days are closing, the sharp libation for your joy, O Vajas,
For him, O mighty Rbhus, ye, rejoicing, have fashioned wealth with plenteous store of heroes.

verses.sa:
प्रातः सुतमपिबो हर्यश्व माध्यंदिनं सवनं केवलं ते ।
समृभुभिः पिबस्व रत्नधेभिः सखीँर्याँ इन्द्र चकृषे सुकृत्या ॥
verses.rom:
pratah sutamapibo haryashva madhyamdinam savanam kevalam te |
samribhubhih pibasva ratnadhebhih sakhinryan indra chakrishe sukritya ||
verses.en:
Lord of Bay Steeds, at dawn the juice thou drankest: thine, only thine, is the noonday libation.
Now drink thou with the wealth-bestowing Rbhus, whom for their skill thou madest friends, O Indra.

verses.sa:
ये देवासो अभवता सुकृत्या श्येना इवेदधि दिवि निषेद ।
ते रत्नं धात शवसो नपातः सौधन्वना अभवतामृतासः ॥
verses.rom:
ye devaso abhavata sukritya shyena ivedadhi divi nisheda |
te ratnam dhata shavaso napatah saudhanvana abhavatamritasah ||
verses.en:
Ye, whom your artist skill hath raised to Godhead have set you down above in heaven like falcons.
So give us riches, Children of Sudhanvan, O Sons of Strength; ye have become immortal.

verses.sa:
यत्तृतीयं सवनं रत्नधेयमकृणुध्वं स्वपस्या सुहस्ताः ।
तदृभवः परिषिक्तं व एतत्सं मदेभिरिन्द्रियेभिः पिबध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
yattritiyam savanam ratnadheyamakrinudhvam svapasya suhastah |
tadribhavah parishiktam va etatsam madebhirindriyebhih pibadhvam ||
verses.en:
The third libation, that bestoweth treasure, which ye have won by skill, ye dexterous-handed,-
This drink hath been effused for you, O Rbhus . drink it with high delight, with joy like Indra's.

verses.sa:
अनश्वो जातो अनभीशुरुक्थ्यो रथस्त्रिचक्रः परि वर्तते रजः ।
महत्तद्वो देव्यस्य प्रवाचनं द्यामृभवः पृथिवीं यच्च पुष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
anashvo jato anabhishurukthyo rathastrichakrah pari vartate rajah |
mahattadvo devyasya pravachanam dyamribhavah prithivim yachcha pushyatha ||
verses.en:
This car that was not made for horses or for reins, three-wheeled, worthy of lauds, rolls round the firmament.
That is the great announcement of your Deity, that, O ye Rbhus, ye sustain the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
रथं ये चक्रुः सुवृतं सुचेतसोऽविह्वरन्तं मनसस्परि ध्यया ।
ताँ ऊ न्वस्य सवनस्य पीतय आ वो वाजा ऋभवो वेदयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ratham ye chakruh suvritam suchetaso'vihvarantam manasaspari dhyaya |
tan u nvasya savanasya pitaya a vo vaja ribhavo vedayamasi ||
verses.en:
Ye Sapient Ones who made the lightly-rolling car out of your mind, by thought, the car that never errs,
You, being such, to drink of this drink offering, you, O ye Vajas, and ye Rbhus, we invoke.

verses.sa:
तद्वो वाजा ऋभवः सुप्रवाचनं देवेषु विभ्वो अभवन्महित्वनम् ।
जिव्री यत्सन्ता पितरा सनाजुरा पुनर्युवाना चरथाय तक्षथ ॥
verses.rom:
tadvo vaja ribhavah supravachanam deveshu vibhvo abhavanmahitvanam |
jivri yatsanta pitara sanajura punaryuvana charathaya takshatha ||
verses.en:
O Vajas, Rbhus, reaching far, among the Gods this was your exaltation gloriously declared,
In that your aged Parents, worn with length of days, ye wrought again to youth so that they moved at will.

verses.sa:
एकं वि चक्र चमसं चतुर्वयं निश्चर्मणो गामरिणीत धीतिभिः ।
अथा देवेष्वमृतत्वमानश श्रुष्टी वाजा ऋभवस्तद्व उक्थ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ekam vi chakra chamasam chaturvayam nishcharmano gamarinita dhitibhih |
atha deveshvamritatvamanasha shrushti vaja ribhavastadva ukthyam ||
verses.en:
The chalice that wag single ye have made fourfold, and by your wisdom brought the Cow forth from the hide.
So quickly, mid the Gods, ye gained immortal life. Vajas and Rbhus, your great work must be extolled.

verses.sa:
ऋभुतो रयिः प्रथमश्रवस्तमो वाजश्रुतासो यमजीजनन्नरः ।
विभ्वतष्टो विदथेषु प्रवाच्यो यं देवासोऽवथा स विचर्षणिः ॥
verses.rom:
ribhuto rayih prathamashravastamo vajashrutaso yamajijanannarah |
vibhvatashto vidatheshu pravachyo yam devaso'vatha sa vicharshanih ||
verses.en:
Wealth from the Rbhus is most glorious in renown, that which the Heroes, famed for vigour, have produced.
In synods must be sung the car which Vibhvan wrought: that which ye favour, Gods! is famed among mankind.

verses.sa:
स वाज्यर्वा स ऋषिर्वचस्यया स शूरो अस्ता पृतनासु दुष्टरः ।
स रायस्पोषं स सुवीर्यं दधे यं वाजो विभ्वाँ ऋभवो यमाविषुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa vajyarva sa rishirvachasyaya sa shuro asta pritanasu dushtarah |
sa rayasposham sa suviryam dadhe yam vajo vibhvan ribhavo yamavishuh ||
verses.en:
Strong is the steed, the man a sage in eloquence, the bowman is a hero hard to beat in fight,
Great store of wealth and manly power hath he obtained whom Vaja, Vibhvan, Rbhus have looked kindly on.

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठं वः पेशो अधि धायि दर्शतं स्तोमो वाजा ऋभवस्तं जुजुष्टन ।
धीरासो हि ष्ठा कवयो विपश्चितस्तान्व एना ब्रह्मणा वेदयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
shreshtham vah pesho adhi dhayi darshatam stomo vaja ribhavastam jujushtana |
dhiraso hi shtha kavayo vipashchitastanva ena brahmana vedayamasi ||
verses.en:
To you hath been assigned the fairest ornament, the hymn of praise: Vajas and Rbhus, joy therein;
For ye have lore and wisdom and poetic skill: as such, with this our prayer we call on you to come.

verses.sa:
यूयमस्मभ्यं धिषणाभ्यस्परि विद्वांसो विश्वा नर्याणि भोजना ।
द्युमन्तं वाजं वृषशुष्ममुत्तममा नो रयिमृभवस्तक्षता वयः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyamasmabhyam dhishanabhyaspari vidvamso vishva naryani bhojana |
dyumantam vajam vrishashushmamuttamama no rayimribhavastakshata vayah ||
verses.en:
According to the wishes of our hearts may ye, who have full knowledge of all the delights of men,
Fashion for us, O Rbhus, power and splendid wealth, rich in high courage, excellent, and vital strength.

verses.sa:
इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणा इह श्रवो वीरवत्तक्षता नः ।
येन वयं चितयेमात्यन्यान्तं वाजं चित्रमृभवो ददा नः ॥
verses.rom:
iha prajamiha rayim rarana iha shravo viravattakshata nah |
yena vayam chitayematyanyantam vajam chitramribhavo dada nah ||
verses.en:
Bestowing on us here riches and offspring, here fashion fame for us befitting heroes.
Vouchsafe us wealth of splendid sort, O Rbhus, that we may make us more renowned than others.

verses.sa:
उप नो वाजा अध्वरमृभुक्षा देवा यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः ।
यथा यज्ञं मनुषो विक्ष्वासु दधिध्वे रण्वाः सुदिनेष्वह्नाम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa no vaja adhvaramribhuksha deva yata pathibhirdevayanaih |
yatha yajnam manusho vikshvasu dadhidhve ranvah sudineshvahnam ||
verses.en:
COME to our sacrifice, Vajas, Rbhuksans, Gods, by the paths which Gods are wont to travel,
As ye, gay Gods, accept in splendid weather the sacrifice among these folk of Manus.

verses.sa:
ते वो हृदे मनसे सन्तु यज्ञा जुष्टासो अद्य घृतनिर्णिजो गुः ।
प्र वः सुतासो हरयन्त पूर्णाः क्रत्वे दक्षाय हर्षयन्त पीताः ॥
verses.rom:
te vo hride manase santu yajna jushtaso adya ghritanirnijo guh |
pra vah sutaso harayanta purnah kratve dakshaya harshayanta pitah ||
verses.en:
May these rites please you in your heart and spirit; may the drops clothed in oil this day approach you.
May the abundant juices bear you onward to power and strength, and, when imbibed, delight you.

verses.sa:
त्र्युदायं देवहितं यथा व स्तोमो वाजा ऋभुक्षणो ददे वः ।
जुह्वे मनुष्वदुपरासु विक्षु युष्मे सचा बृहद्दिवेषु सोमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tryudayam devahitam yatha va stomo vaja ribhukshano dade vah |
juhve manushvaduparasu vikshu yushme sacha brihaddiveshu somam ||
verses.en:
Your threefold going near is God-appointed, so praise is given you, Vajas and Rbhuksans.
So, Manus-like, mid younger folk I offer, to you who are aloft in heaven, the Soma.

verses.sa:
पीवोअश्वाः शुचद्रथा हि भूतायःशिप्रा वाजिनः सुनिष्काः ।
इन्द्रस्य सूनो शवसो नपातोऽनु वश्चेत्यग्रियं मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
pivoashvah shuchadratha hi bhutayahshipra vajinah sunishkah |
indrasya suno shavaso napato'nu vashchetyagriyam madaya ||
verses.en:
Strong, with fair chains of gold and jaws of iron, ye have a splendid car and well-fed horses.
Ye Sons of Strength, ye progeny of Indra, to you the best is offered to delight you.

verses.sa:
ऋभुमृभुक्षणो रयिं वाजे वाजिन्तमं युजम् ।
इन्द्रस्वन्तं हवामहे सदासातममश्विनम् ॥
verses.rom:
ribhumribhukshano rayim vaje vajintamam yujam |
indrasvantam havamahe sadasatamamashvinam ||
verses.en:
Rbhuksans! him, for handy wealth, the mightiest comrade in the fight,
Him, Indra's equal, we invoke, most bounteous ever, rich in steeds.

verses.sa:
सेदृभवो यमवथ यूयमिन्द्रश्च मर्त्यम् ।
स धीभिरस्तु सनिता मेधसाता सो अर्वता ॥
verses.rom:
sedribhavo yamavatha yuyamindrashcha martyam |
sa dhibhirastu sanita medhasata so arvata ||
verses.en:
The mortal man whom, Rbhus, ye and Indra favour with your help,
Must be successful, by his thoughts, at sacrifice and with the steed.

verses.sa:
वि नो वाजा ऋभुक्षणः पथश्चितन यष्टवे ।
अस्मभ्यं सूरय स्तुता विश्वा आशास्तरीषणि ॥
verses.rom:
vi no vaja ribhukshanah pathashchitana yashtave |
asmabhyam suraya stuta vishva ashastarishani ||
verses.en:
O Vajas and Rbhuksans, free for us the paths to sacrifice,
Ye Princes, lauded, that we may press forward to each point of heaven.

verses.sa:
तं नो वाजा ऋभुक्षण इन्द्र नासत्या रयिम् ।
समश्वं चर्षणिभ्य आ पुरु शस्त मघत्तये ॥
verses.rom:
tam no vaja ribhukshana indra nasatya rayim |
samashvam charshanibhya a puru shasta maghattaye ||
verses.en:
O Vajas and Rbhuksans, ye Nasatyas, Indra, bless this wealth,
And, before other men's, the steed, that ample riches may be won.

verses.sa:
उतो हि वां दात्रा सन्ति पूर्वा या पूरुभ्यस्त्रसदस्युर्नितोशे ।
क्षेत्रासां ददथुरुर्वरासां घनं दस्युभ्यो अभिभूतिमुग्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
uto hi vam datra santi purva ya purubhyastrasadasyurnitoshe |
kshetrasam dadathururvarasam ghanam dasyubhyo abhibhutimugram ||
verses.en:
FROM you two came the gifts in days aforetime which Trasadasyu granted to the Purus.
Ye gave the winner of our fields and plough-lands, and the strong smiter who subdued the Dasytis.

verses.sa:
उत वाजिनं पुरुनिष्षिध्वानं दधिक्रामु ददथुर्विश्वकृष्टिम् ।
ऋजिप्यं श्येनं प्रुषितप्सुमाशुं चर्कृत्यमर्यो नृपतिं न शूरम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta vajinam purunishshidhvanam dadhikramu dadathurvishvakrishtim |
rijipyam shyenam prushitapsumashum charkrityamaryo nripatim na shuram ||
verses.en:
And ye gave mighty Dadhikras, the giver of many gifts, who visiteth all people,
Impetuous hawk, swift and of varied colour, like a brave King whom each true man must honour.

verses.sa:
यं सीमनु प्रवतेव द्रवन्तं विश्वः पूरुर्मदति हर्षमाणः ।
पड्भिर्गृध्यन्तं मेधयुं न शूरं रथतुरं वातमिव ध्रजन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam simanu pravateva dravantam vishvah pururmadati harshamanah |
padbhirgridhyantam medhayum na shuram rathaturam vatamiva dhrajantam ||
verses.en:
Whom, as 'twere down a precipice, swift rushing, each Puru praises and his heart rejoices,-
Springing forth like a hero fain for battle, whirling the car and flying like the tempest.

verses.sa:
यः स्मारुन्धानो गध्या समत्सु सनुतरश्चरति गोषु गच्छन् ।
आविरृजीको विदथा निचिक्यत्तिरो अरतिं पर्याप आयोः ॥
verses.rom:
yah smarundhano gadhya samatsu sanutarashcharati goshu gachchhan |
avirrijiko vidatha nichikyattiro aratim paryapa ayoh ||
verses.en:
Who gaineth precious booty in the combats and moveth, winning spoil, among the cattle;
Shown in bright colour, looking on the assemblies, beyond the churl, to worship of the living.

verses.sa:
उत स्मैनं वस्त्रमथिं न तायुमनु क्रोशन्ति क्षितयो भरेषु ।
नीचायमानं जसुरिं न श्येनं श्रवश्चाच्छा पशुमच्च यूथम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta smainam vastramathim na tayumanu kroshanti kshitayo bhareshu |
nichayamanam jasurim na shyenam shravashchachchha pashumachcha yutham ||
verses.en:
Loudly the folk cry after him in battles, as 'twere a thief who steals away a garment;
Speeding to glory, or a herd of cattle, even as a hungry falcon swooping downward.

verses.sa:
उत स्मासु प्रथमः सरिष्यन्नि वेवेति श्रेणिभी रथानाम् ।
स्रजं कृण्वानो जन्यो न शुभ्वा रेणुं रेरिहत्किरणं ददश्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
uta smasu prathamah sarishyanni veveti shrenibhi rathanam |
srajam krinvano janyo na shubhva renum rerihatkiranam dadashvan ||
verses.en:
And, fain to come forth first amid these armies, this way and that with rows of cars he rushes,
Gay like a bridesman, making him a garland, tossing the dust, champing the rein that holds him.

verses.sa:
उत स्य वाजी सहुरिरृतावा शुश्रूषमाणस्तन्वा समर्ये ।
तुरं यतीषु तुरयन्नृजिप्योऽधि भ्रुवोः किरते रेणुमृञ्जन् ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya vaji sahurirritava shushrushamanastanva samarye |
turam yatishu turayannrijipyo'dhi bhruvoh kirate renumrinjan ||
verses.en:
And that strong Steed, victorious and faithful, obedient with his body in the combat,
Speeding straight on amid the swiftly pressing, casts o'er his brows the dust he tosses upward.

verses.sa:
उत स्मास्य तन्यतोरिव द्योरृघायतो अभियुजो भयन्ते ।
यदा सहस्रमभि षीमयोधीद्दुर्वर्तुः स्मा भवति भीम ऋञ्जन् ॥
verses.rom:
uta smasya tanyatoriva dyorrighayato abhiyujo bhayante |
yada sahasramabhi shimayodhiddurvartuh sma bhavati bhima rinjan ||
verses.en:
And at his thunder, like the roar of heaven, those who attack tremble and are affrighted;
For when he fights against embattled thousands, dread is he in his striving; none may stay him.

verses.sa:
उत स्मास्य पनयन्ति जना जूतिं कृष्टिप्रो अभिभूतिमाशोः ।
उतैनमाहुः समिथे वियन्तः परा दधिक्रा असरत्सहस्रैः ॥
verses.rom:
uta smasya panayanti jana jutim krishtipro abhibhutimashoh |
utainamahuh samithe viyantah para dadhikra asaratsahasraih ||
verses.en:
The people praise the overpowering swiftness of this fleet Steed who giveth men abundance.
Of him they say when drawing back from battle. Dadhikras hath sped forward with his thousands.

verses.sa:
आ दधिक्राः शवसा पञ्च कृष्टीः सूर्य इव ज्योतिषापस्ततान ।
सहस्रसाः शतसा वाज्यर्वा पृणक्तु मध्वा समिमा वचांसि ॥
verses.rom:
a dadhikrah shavasa pancha krishtih surya iva jyotishapastatana |
sahasrasah shatasa vajyarva prinaktu madhva samima vachamsi ||
verses.en:
Dadhikras hath o'erspread the Fivefold People with vigour, as the Sun lightens the waters.
May the strong Steed who winneth hundreds, thousands, requite with sweetness these my words and praises.

verses.sa:
आशुं दधिक्रां तमु नु ष्टवाम दिवस्पृथिव्या उत चर्किराम ।
उच्छन्तीर्मामुषसः सूदयन्त्वति विश्वानि दुरितानि पर्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
ashum dadhikram tamu nu shtavama divasprithivya uta charkirama |
uchchhantirmamushasah sudayantvati vishvani duritani parshan ||
verses.en:
Now give we praise to Dadhikras the rapid, and mention in our laud the Earth and Heaven.
May the Dawns flushing move me to exertion, and bear me safely over every trouble.

verses.sa:
महश्चर्कर्म्यर्वतः क्रतुप्रा दधिक्राव्णः पुरुवारस्य वृष्णः ।
यं पूरुभ्यो दीदिवांसं नाग्निं ददथुर्मित्रावरुणा ततुरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
mahashcharkarmyarvatah kratupra dadhikravnah puruvarasya vrishnah |
yam purubhyo didivamsam nagnim dadathurmitravaruna taturim ||
verses.en:
I praise the mighty Steed who fills my spirit, the Stallion Dadhikravan rich in bounties,
Whom, swift of foot and shining bright as Agni, ye, Varuna and Mitra, gave to Purus.

verses.sa:
यो अश्वस्य दधिक्राव्णो अकारीत्समिद्धे अग्ना उषसो व्युष्टौ ।
अनागसं तमदितिः कृणोतु स मित्रेण वरुणेना सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
yo ashvasya dadhikravno akaritsamiddhe agna ushaso vyushtau |
anagasam tamaditih krinotu sa mitrena varunena sajoshah ||
verses.en:
Him who hath honoured, when the flame is kindled at break of dawn, the Courser Dadhikrivan,
Him, of one mind with Varuna and Mitra may Aditi make free from all transgression.

verses.sa:
दधिक्राव्ण इष ऊर्जो महो यदमन्महि मरुतां नाम भद्रम् ।
स्वस्तये वरुणं मित्रमग्निं हवामह इन्द्रं वज्रबाहुम् ॥
verses.rom:
dadhikravna isha urjo maho yadamanmahi marutam nama bhadram |
svastaye varunam mitramagnim havamaha indram vajrabahum ||
verses.en:
When we remember mighty Dadhikravan our food and strength, then the blest name of Maruts,
Varuna, Mitra, we invoke for welfare, and Agni, and the thunder-wielding Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिवेदुभये वि ह्वयन्त उदीराणा यज्ञमुपप्रयन्तः ।
दधिक्रामु सूदनं मर्त्याय ददथुर्मित्रावरुणा नो अश्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
indramivedubhaye vi hvayanta udirana yajnamupaprayantah |
dadhikramu sudanam martyaya dadathurmitravaruna no ashvam ||
verses.en:
Both sides invoke him as they call on Indra when they stir forth and turn to sacrificing.
To us have Varuna and Mitra granted the Courser Dadhikris, a guide for mortals.

verses.sa:
दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोरश्वस्य वाजिनः ।
सुरभि नो मुखा करत्प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
dadhikravno akarisham jishnorashvasya vajinah |
surabhi no mukha karatpra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en:
So have I glorified with praise strong Dadhikravan, conquering Steed.
Sweet may he make our mouths; may he prolong the days we have to live.

verses.sa:
दधिक्राव्ण इदु नु चर्किराम विश्वा इन्मामुषसः सूदयन्तु ।
अपामग्नेरुषसः सूर्यस्य बृहस्पतेराङ्गिरसस्य जिष्णोः ॥
verses.rom:
dadhikravna idu nu charkirama vishva inmamushasah sudayantu |
apamagnerushasah suryasya brihaspaterangirasasya jishnoh ||
verses.en:
LET us recite the praise of Dadhikravan: may all the Mornings move me to exertion;
Praise of the Lord of Waters, Dawn, and Agni, Brhaspati Son of Angiras, and Surya.

verses.sa:
सत्वा भरिषो गविषो दुवन्यसच्छ्रवस्यादिष उषसस्तुरण्यसत् ।
सत्यो द्रवो द्रवरः पतंगरो दधिक्रावेषमूर्जं स्वर्जनत् ॥
verses.rom:
satva bharisho gavisho duvanyasachchhravasyadisha ushasasturanyasat |
satyo dravo dravarah patamgaro dadhikraveshamurjam svarjanat ||
verses.en:
Brave, seeking war and booty, dwelling with the good and with the swift, may he hasten the food of Dawn.
May he the true, the fleet, the lover of the course, the bird-like Dadhikravan, bring food, strength, and light.

verses.sa:
उत स्मास्य द्रवतस्तुरण्यतः पर्णं न वेरनु वाति प्रगर्धिनः ।
श्येनस्येव ध्रजतो अङ्कसं परि दधिक्राव्णः सहोर्जा तरित्रतः ॥
verses.rom:
uta smasya dravatasturanyatah parnam na veranu vati pragardhinah |
shyenasyeva dhrajato ankasam pari dadhikravnah sahorja taritratah ||
verses.en:
His pinion, rapid runner, fans him m his way, as of a bird that hastens onward to its aim,
And, as it were a falcon's gliding through the air, strikes Dadhikravan's side as he speeds on with might.

verses.sa:
उत स्य वाजी क्षिपणिं तुरण्यति ग्रीवायां बद्धो अपिकक्ष आसनि ।
क्रतुं दधिक्रा अनु संतवीत्वत्पथामङ्कांस्यन्वापनीफणत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya vaji kshipanim turanyati grivayam baddho apikaksha asani |
kratum dadhikra anu samtavitvatpathamankamsyanvapaniphanat ||
verses.en:
Bound by the neck and by the flanks and by the mouth, the vigorous Courser lends new swiftness to his speed.
Drawing himself together, as his strength allows, Dadhikras springs along the windings of the paths.

verses.sa:
हंसः शुचिषद्वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषदतिथिर्दुरोणसत् ।
नृषद्वरसदृतसद्व्योमसदब्जा गोजा ऋतजा अद्रिजा ऋतम् ॥
verses.rom:
hamsah shuchishadvasurantarikshasaddhota vedishadatithirduronasat |
nrishadvarasadritasadvyomasadabja goja ritaja adrija ritam ||
verses.en:
The Hamsa homed in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the priest beside the altar, in the house the guest,
Dweller in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, he is holy Law.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा को वां वरुणा सुम्नमाप स्तोमो हविष्माँ अमृतो न होता ।
यो वां हृदि क्रतुमाँ अस्मदुक्तः पस्पर्शदिन्द्रावरुणा नमस्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
indra ko vam varuna sumnamapa stomo havishman amrito na hota |
yo vam hridi kratuman asmaduktah pasparshadindravaruna namasvan ||
verses.en:
WHAT laud, O Indra-Varuna, with oblation, hath like the Immortal Priest obtained your favour?
Hath our effectual laud, addressed with homage, touched you, O Indra-Varuna, in spirit?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा ह यो वरुणा चक्र आपी देवौ मर्तः सख्याय प्रयस्वान् ।
स हन्ति वृत्रा समिथेषु शत्रूनवोभिर्वा महद्भिः स प्र शृण्वे ॥
verses.rom:
indra ha yo varuna chakra api devau martah sakhyaya prayasvan |
sa hanti vritra samitheshu shatrunavobhirva mahadbhih sa pra shrinve ||
verses.en:
He who with dainty food hath won you, Indra and Varuna, Gods, as his allies to friendship,
Jayeth the Vrtras and his foes in battles, and through your mighty favours is made famous.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा ह रत्नं वरुणा धेष्ठेत्था नृभ्यः शशमानेभ्यस्ता ।
यदी सखाया सख्याय सोमैः सुतेभिः सुप्रयसा मादयैते ॥
verses.rom:
indra ha ratnam varuna dheshthettha nribhyah shashamanebhyasta |
yadi sakhaya sakhyaya somaih sutebhih suprayasa madayaite ||
verses.en:
Indra and Varuna are most liberal givers of treasure to the men who toil to serve them,
When they, as Friends inclined to friendship, honoured with dainty food, delight in flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा युवं वरुणा दिद्युमस्मिन्नोजिष्ठमुग्रा नि वधिष्टं वज्रम् ।
यो नो दुरेवो वृकतिर्दभीतिस्तस्मिन्मिमाथामभिभूत्योजः ॥
verses.rom:
indra yuvam varuna didyumasminnojishthamugra ni vadhishtam vajram |
yo no durevo vrikatirdabhitistasminmimathamabhibhutyojah ||
verses.en:
Indra and Varuna, ye hurl, O Mighty, on him your strongest flashing bolt of thunder
Who treats us ill, the robber and oppressor: measure on him your overwhelming vigour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा युवं वरुणा भूतमस्या धियः प्रेतारा वृषभेव धेनोः ।
सा नो दुहीयद्यवसेव गत्वी सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः ॥
verses.rom:
indra yuvam varuna bhutamasya dhiyah pretara vrishabheva dhenoh |
sa no duhiyadyavaseva gatvi sahasradhara payasa mahi gauh ||
verses.en:
O Indra-Varuna, be ye the lovers of this my song, as steers who love the milch-Cow.
Milk may it yield us as, gone forth to pasture, the great Cow pouring out her thousand rivers.

verses.sa:
तोके हिते तनय उर्वरासु सूरो दृशीके वृषणश्च पौंस्ये ।
इन्द्रा नो अत्र वरुणा स्यातामवोभिर्दस्मा परितक्म्यायाम् ॥
verses.rom:
toke hite tanaya urvarasu suro drishike vrishanashcha paumsye |
indra no atra varuna syatamavobhirdasma paritakmyayam ||
verses.en:
For fertile fields, for worthy sons and grandsons, for the Sun's beauty and for steer-like vigour,
May Indra-Varuna with gracious favours work marvels for us in the stress of battle.

verses.sa:
युवामिद्ध्यवसे पूर्व्याय परि प्रभूती गविषः स्वापी ।
वृणीमहे सख्याय प्रियाय शूरा मंहिष्ठा पितरेव शम्भू ॥
verses.rom:
yuvamiddhyavase purvyaya pari prabhuti gavishah svapi |
vrinimahe sakhyaya priyaya shura mamhishtha pitareva shambhu ||
verses.en:
For you, as Princes, for your ancient kindness, good comrades of the man who seeks for booty,
We choose to us for the dear bond of friendship, most liberal Heroes bringing bliss like parents.

verses.sa:
ता वां धियोऽवसे वाजयन्तीराजिं न जग्मुर्युवयूः सुदानू ।
श्रिये न गाव उप सोममस्थुरिन्द्रं गिरो वरुणं मे मनीषाः ॥
verses.rom:
ta vam dhiyo'vase vajayantirajim na jagmuryuvayuh sudanu |
shriye na gava upa somamasthurindram giro varunam me manishah ||
verses.en:
Showing their strength, these hymns for grace, Free-givers I have gone to you, devoted, as to battle.
For glory have they gone, as milk to Soma, to Indra-Varuna my thoughts and praises.

verses.sa:
इमा इन्द्रं वरुणं मे मनीषा अग्मन्नुप द्रविणमिच्छमानाः ।
उपेमस्थुर्जोष्टार इव वस्वो रघ्वीरिव श्रवसो भिक्षमाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
ima indram varunam me manisha agmannupa dravinamichchhamanah |
upemasthurjoshtara iva vasvo raghviriva shravaso bhikshamanah ||
verses.en:
To Indra and to Varuna, desirous of gaining wealth have these my thoughts proceeded.
They have come nigh to you as treasure lovers, like mares, fleet-footed, eager for the glory.

verses.sa:
अश्व्यस्य त्मना रथ्यस्य पुष्टेर्नित्यस्य रायः पतयः स्याम ।
ता चक्राणा ऊतिभिर्नव्यसीभिरस्मत्रा रायो नियुतः सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvyasya tmana rathyasya pushternityasya rayah patayah syama |
ta chakrana utibhirnavyasibhirasmatra rayo niyutah sachantam ||
verses.en:
May we ourselves be lords of during riches, of ample sustenance for car and hones.
So may the Twain who work with newest succours bring yoked teams hitherward to us and riches.

verses.sa:
आ नो बृहन्ता बृहतीभिरूती इन्द्र यातं वरुण वाजसातौ ।
यद्दिद्यवः पृतनासु प्रक्रीळान्तस्य वां स्याम सनितार आजेः ॥
verses.rom:
a no brihanta brihatibhiruti indra yatam varuna vajasatau |
yaddidyavah pritanasu prakrilantasya vam syama sanitara ajeh ||
verses.en:
Come with your mighty succours, O ye Mighty; come, Indra-Varuna, to us in battle.
What time the flashing arrows play in combat, may we through you be winners in the contest.

verses.sa:
मम द्विता राष्ट्रं क्षत्रियस्य विश्वायोर्विश्वे अमृता यथा नः ।
क्रतुं सचन्ते वरुणस्य देवा राजामि कृष्टेरुपमस्य वव्रेः ॥
verses.rom:
mama dvita rashtram kshatriyasya vishvayorvishve amrita yatha nah |
kratum sachante varunasya deva rajami krishterupamasya vavreh ||
verses.en:
I AM the royal Ruler, mine is empire, as mine who sway all life are all Immortals.
Varuna's will the Gods obey and follow. I am the King of men's most lofty cover.

verses.sa:
अहं राजा वरुणो मह्यं तान्यसुर्याणि प्रथमा धारयन्त ।
क्रतुं सचन्ते वरुणस्य देवा राजामि कृष्टेरुपमस्य वव्रेः ॥
verses.rom:
aham raja varuno mahyam tanyasuryani prathama dharayanta |
kratum sachante varunasya deva rajami krishterupamasya vavreh ||
verses.en:
I am King Varuna. To me were given these first existing high celestial powers.
Varuna's will the Gods obey and follow. I am the King of men's most lofty cover.

verses.sa:
अहमिन्द्रो वरुणस्ते महित्वोर्वी गभीरे रजसी सुमेके ।
त्वष्टेव विश्वा भुवनानि विद्वान्समैरयं रोदसी धारयं च ॥
verses.rom:
ahamindro varunaste mahitvorvi gabhire rajasi sumeke |
tvashteva vishva bhuvanani vidvansamairayam rodasi dharayam cha ||
verses.en:
I Varuna am Indra: in their greatness, these the two wide deep fairly-fashioned regions,
These the two world-halves have I, even as Tvastar knowing all beings, joined and held together.

verses.sa:
अहमपो अपिन्वमुक्षमाणा धारयं दिवं सदन ऋतस्य ।
ऋतेन पुत्रो अदितेरृतावोत त्रिधातु प्रथयद्वि भूम ॥
verses.rom:
ahamapo apinvamukshamana dharayam divam sadana ritasya |
ritena putro aditerritavota tridhatu prathayadvi bhuma ||
verses.en:
I made to flow the moisture-shedding waters, and set the heaven firm in the scat of Order.
By Law the Son of Aditi, Law Observer, hath spread abroad the world in threefold measure.

verses.sa:
मां नरः स्वश्वा वाजयन्तो मां वृताः समरणे हवन्ते ।
कृणोम्याजिं मघवाहमिन्द्र इयर्मि रेणुमभिभूत्योजाः ॥
verses.rom:
mam narah svashva vajayanto mam vritah samarane havante |
krinomyajim maghavahamindra iyarmi renumabhibhutyojah ||
verses.en:
Heroes with noble horses, fain for battle, selected warriors, call on me in combat.
I Indra Maghavan, excite the conflict; I stir the dust, Lord of surpassing vigour.

verses.sa:
अहं ता विश्वा चकरं नकिर्मा दैव्यं सहो वरते अप्रतीतम् ।
यन्मा सोमासो ममदन्यदुक्थोभे भयेते रजसी अपारे ॥
verses.rom:
aham ta vishva chakaram nakirma daivyam saho varate apratitam |
yanma somaso mamadanyadukthobhe bhayete rajasi apare ||
verses.en:
All this I did. The Gods' own conquering power never impedeth me whom none opposeth.
When lauds and Soma juice have made me joyful, both the unbounded regions are affrighted.

verses.sa:
विदुष्टे विश्वा भुवनानि तस्य ता प्र ब्रवीषि वरुणाय वेधः ।
त्वं वृत्राणि शृण्विषे जघन्वान्त्वं वृताँ अरिणा इन्द्र सिन्धून् ॥
verses.rom:
vidushte vishva bhuvanani tasya ta pra bravishi varunaya vedhah |
tvam vritrani shrinvishe jaghanvantvam vritan arina indra sindhun ||
verses.en:
All beings know these deeds of thine thou tellest this unto Varuna, thou great Disposer!
Thou art renowned as having slain the Vrtras. Thou madest flow the floods that were obstructed.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमत्र पितरस्त आसन्सप्त ऋषयो दौर्गहे बध्यमाने ।
त आयजन्त त्रसदस्युमस्या इन्द्रं न वृत्रतुरमर्धदेवम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamatra pitarasta asansapta rishayo daurgahe badhyamane |
ta ayajanta trasadasyumasya indram na vritraturamardhadevam ||
verses.en:
Our fathers then were these, the Seven his, what time the son of Durgaha was captive.
For her they gained by sacrifice Trasadasyu, a demi-god, like Indra, conquering foemen.

verses.sa:
पुरुकुत्सानी हि वामदाशद्धव्येभिरिन्द्रावरुणा नमोभिः ।
अथा राजानं त्रसदस्युमस्या वृत्रहणं ददथुरर्धदेवम् ॥
verses.rom:
purukutsani hi vamadashaddhavyebhirindravaruna namobhih |
atha rajanam trasadasyumasya vritrahanam dadathurardhadevam ||
verses.en:
The spouse of Purukutsa gave oblations to you, O Indra-Varuna, with homage.
Then unto her ye gave King Trasadasyu, the demi-god, the slayer of the foeman.

verses.sa:
राया वयं ससवांसो मदेम हव्येन देवा यवसेन गावः ।
तां धेनुमिन्द्रावरुणा युवं नो विश्वाहा धत्तमनपस्फुरन्तीम् ॥
verses.rom:
raya vayam sasavamso madema havyena deva yavasena gavah |
tam dhenumindravaruna yuvam no vishvaha dhattamanapasphurantim ||
verses.en:
May we, possessing much, delight in riches, Gods in oblations and the kine in pasture;
And that Milch-cow who shrinks not from the milking, O Indra-Varuna, give to us daily.

verses.sa:
क उ श्रवत्कतमो यज्ञियानां वन्दारु देवः कतमो जुषाते ।
कस्येमां देवीममृतेषु प्रेष्ठां हृदि श्रेषाम सुष्टुतिं सुहव्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
ka u shravatkatamo yajniyanam vandaru devah katamo jushate |
kasyemam devimamriteshu preshtham hridi shreshama sushtutim suhavyam ||
verses.en:
WHO will hear, who of those who merit worship, which of all Gods take pleasure in our homage?
On whose heart shall we lay this laud celestial, rich with fair offerings, dearest to Immortals?

verses.sa:
को मृळाति कतम आगमिष्ठो देवानामु कतमः शम्भविष्ठः ।
रथं कमाहुर्द्रवदश्वमाशुं यं सूर्यस्य दुहितावृणीत ॥
verses.rom:
ko mrilati katama agamishtho devanamu katamah shambhavishthah |
ratham kamahurdravadashvamashum yam suryasya duhitavrinita ||
verses.en:
Who will be gracious? Who will come most quickly of all the Gods? Who will bring bliss most largely?
What car do they call swift with rapid coursers? That which the Daughter of the Sun elected.

verses.sa:
मक्षू हि ष्मा गच्छथ ईवतो द्यूनिन्द्रो न शक्तिं परितक्म्यायाम् ।
दिव आजाता दिव्या सुपर्णा कया शचीनां भवथः शचिष्ठा ॥
verses.rom:
makshu hi shma gachchhatha ivato dyunindro na shaktim paritakmyayam |
diva ajata divya suparna kaya shachinam bhavathah shachishtha ||
verses.en:
So many days do ye come swiftly hither, as Indra to give help in stress of battle.
Descended from the sky, divine, strong-pinioned, by which of all your powers are ye most mighty?

verses.sa:
का वां भूदुपमातिः कया न आश्विना गमथो हूयमाना ।
को वां महश्चित्त्यजसो अभीक उरुष्यतं माध्वी दस्रा न ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
ka vam bhudupamatih kaya na ashvina gamatho huyamana |
ko vam mahashchittyajaso abhika urushyatam madhvi dasra na uti ||
verses.en:
What is the prayer that we should bring you, Asvins, whereby ye come to us when invocated?
Whether of you confronts e'en great betrayal? Lovers of sweetness, Dasras, help and save us.

verses.sa:
उरु वां रथः परि नक्षति द्यामा यत्समुद्रादभि वर्तते वाम् ।
मध्वा माध्वी मधु वां प्रुषायन्यत्सीं वां पृक्षो भुरजन्त पक्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
uru vam rathah pari nakshati dyama yatsamudradabhi vartate vam |
madhva madhvi madhu vam prushayanyatsim vam priksho bhurajanta pakvah ||
verses.en:
In the wide space your chariot reacheth heaven, what time it turneth hither from the ocean.
Sweets from your sweet shall drop, lovers of sweetness! These have they dressed for you as dainty viands.

verses.sa:
सिन्धुर्ह वां रसया सिञ्चदश्वान्घृणा वयोऽरुषासः परि ग्मन् ।
तदू षु वामजिरं चेति यानं येन पती भवथः सूर्यायाः ॥
verses.rom:
sindhurha vam rasaya sinchadashvanghrina vayo'rushasah pari gman |
tadu shu vamajiram cheti yanam yena pati bhavathah suryayah ||
verses.en:
Let Sindhu with his wave bedew your horses: in fiery glow have the red birds come hither.
Observed of all was that your rapid going, whereby ye were the Lords of Siirya's Daughter.

verses.sa:
इहेह यद्वां समना पपृक्षे सेयमस्मे सुमतिर्वाजरत्ना ।
उरुष्यतं जरितारं युवं ह श्रितः कामो नासत्या युवद्रिक् ॥
verses.rom:
iheha yadvam samana paprikshe seyamasme sumatirvajaratna |
urushyatam jaritaram yuvam ha shritah kamo nasatya yuvadrik ||
verses.en:
Whene'er I gratified you here together, your grace was given us, O ye rich in booty.
Protect, ye Twain, the singer of your praises: to you, Nasatyas, is my wish directed.

verses.sa:
तं वां रथं वयमद्या हुवेम पृथुज्रयमश्विना संगतिं गोः ।
यः सूर्यां वहति वन्धुरायुर्गिर्वाहसं पुरुतमं वसूयुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam vam ratham vayamadya huvema prithujrayamashvina samgatim goh |
yah suryam vahati vandhurayurgirvahasam purutamam vasuyum ||
verses.en:
WE will invoke this day your car, farspreading, O Asvins, even the gathering, of the sunlight,-
Car praised in hymns, most ample, rich in treasure, fitted with seats, the car that beareth Surya.

verses.sa:
युवं श्रियमश्विना देवता तां दिवो नपाता वनथः शचीभिः ।
युवोर्वपुरभि पृक्षः सचन्ते वहन्ति यत्ककुहासो रथे वाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam shriyamashvina devata tam divo napata vanathah shachibhih |
yuvorvapurabhi prikshah sachante vahanti yatkakuhaso rathe vam ||
verses.en:
Asvins, ye gained that glory by your Godhead, ye Sons of Heaven, by your own might and power.
Food followeth close upon your bright appearing when stately horses in your chariot draw you.

verses.sa:
को वामद्या करते रातहव्य ऊतये वा सुतपेयाय वार्कैः ।
ऋतस्य वा वनुषे पूर्व्याय नमो येमानो अश्विना ववर्तत् ॥
verses.rom:
ko vamadya karate ratahavya utaye va sutapeyaya varkaih |
ritasya va vanushe purvyaya namo yemano ashvina vavartat ||
verses.en:
Who bringeth you to-day for help with offered oblation, or with hymns to drink the juices?
Who, for the sacrifice's ancient lover, turneth you hither, Asvins, offering homage?

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययेन पुरुभू रथेनेमं यज्ञं नासत्योप यातम् ।
पिबाथ इन्मधुनः सोम्यस्य दधथो रत्नं विधते जनाय ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyayena purubhu rathenemam yajnam nasatyopa yatam |
pibatha inmadhunah somyasya dadhatho ratnam vidhate janaya ||
verses.en:
Borne on your golden car, ye omnipresent! come to this sacrifice of ours, Nasatyas.
Drink of the pleasant liquor of the Soma give riches to the people who adore you.

verses.sa:
आ नो यातं दिवो अच्छा पृथिव्या हिरण्ययेन सुवृता रथेन ।
मा वामन्ये नि यमन्देवयन्तः सं यद्ददे नाभिः पूर्व्या वाम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no yatam divo achchha prithivya hiranyayena suvrita rathena |
ma vamanye ni yamandevayantah sam yaddade nabhih purvya vam ||
verses.en:
Come hitherward to us from earth, from heaven, borne on your golden chariot rolling lightly.
Suffer not other worshippers to stay you here are ye bound by earlier bonds of friendship.

verses.sa:
नू नो रयिं पुरुवीरं बृहन्तं दस्रा मिमाथामुभयेष्वस्मे ।
नरो यद्वामश्विना स्तोममावन्सधस्तुतिमाजमीळ्हासो अग्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
nu no rayim puruviram brihantam dasra mimathamubhayeshvasme |
naro yadvamashvina stomamavansadhastutimajamilhaso agman ||
verses.en:
Now for us both, mete out, O Wonder Workers, riches exceeding great with store of heroes,
Because the men have sent you praise, O Asvins, and Ajamilhas come to the laudation.

verses.sa:
इहेह यद्वां समना पपृक्षे सेयमस्मे सुमतिर्वाजरत्ना ।
उरुष्यतं जरितारं युवं ह श्रितः कामो नासत्या युवद्रिक् ॥
verses.rom:
iheha yadvam samana paprikshe seyamasme sumatirvajaratna |
urushyatam jaritaram yuvam ha shritah kamo nasatya yuvadrik ||
verses.en:
Whene'er I gratified you here together, your grace was given us, O ye rich in booty.
Protect, ye Twain, the singer of your praises: to you, Nasatyas, is my wish directed.

verses.sa:
एष स्य भानुरुदियर्ति युज्यते रथः परिज्मा दिवो अस्य सानवि ।
पृक्षासो अस्मिन्मिथुना अधि त्रयो दृतिस्तुरीयो मधुनो वि रप्शते ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya bhanurudiyarti yujyate rathah parijma divo asya sanavi |
prikshaso asminmithuna adhi trayo dritisturiyo madhuno vi rapshate ||
verses.en:
YONDER goes up that light: your chariot is yoked that travels round upon the summit of this heaven.
Within this car are stored three kindred shares of food, and a skin filled with meath is rustling as the fourth.

verses.sa:
उद्वां पृक्षासो मधुमन्त ईरते रथा अश्वास उषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
अपोर्णुवन्तस्तम आ परीवृतं स्वर्ण शुक्रं तन्वन्त आ रजः ॥
verses.rom:
udvam prikshaso madhumanta irate ratha ashvasa ushaso vyushtishu |
apornuvantastama a parivritam svarna shukram tanvanta a rajah ||
verses.en:
Forth come your viands rich with store of pleasant meath, and cars and horses at the flushing of the dawn,
Stripping the covering from the surrounded gloom, and spreading through mid-air bright radiance like the Sun.

verses.sa:
मध्वः पिबतं मधुपेभिरासभिरुत प्रियं मधुने युञ्जाथां रथम् ।
आ वर्तनिं मधुना जिन्वथस्पथो दृतिं वहेथे मधुमन्तमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
madhvah pibatam madhupebhirasabhiruta priyam madhune yunjatham ratham |
a vartanim madhuna jinvathaspatho dritim vahethe madhumantamashvina ||
verses.en:
Drink of the meath with lips accustomed to the draught; harness for the meath's sake the chariot that ye love.
Refresh the way ye go, refresh the paths with meath: hither, O Asvins, bring the skin that holds the meath.

verses.sa:
हंसासो ये वां मधुमन्तो अस्रिधो हिरण्यपर्णा उहुव उषर्बुधः ।
उदप्रुतो मन्दिनो मन्दिनिस्पृशो मध्वो न मक्षः सवनानि गच्छथः ॥
verses.rom:
hamsaso ye vam madhumanto asridho hiranyaparna uhuva usharbudhah |
udapruto mandino mandinisprisho madhvo na makshah savanani gachchhathah ||
verses.en:
The swans ye have are friendly, rich in store of meath, gold-pinioned, strong to draw, awake at early morn,
Swimming the flood, exultant, fain for draughts that cheer: ye come like flies to our libations of-the meath.

verses.sa:
स्वध्वरासो मधुमन्तो अग्नय उस्रा जरन्ते प्रति वस्तोरश्विना ।
यन्निक्तहस्तस्तरणिर्विचक्षणः सोमं सुषाव मधुमन्तमद्रिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
svadhvaraso madhumanto agnaya usra jarante prati vastorashvina |
yanniktahastastaranirvichakshanah somam sushava madhumantamadribhih ||
verses.en:
Well knowing solemn rites and rich in meath, the fires sing to the morning Asvins at the break of day,
When with pure hands the prudent energetic priest hath with the stones pressed out the Soma rich in meath.

verses.sa:
आकेनिपासो अहभिर्दविध्वतः स्वर्ण शुक्रं तन्वन्त आ रजः ।
सूरश्चिदश्वान्युयुजान ईयते विश्वाँ अनु स्वधया चेतथस्पथः ॥
verses.rom:
akenipaso ahabhirdavidhvatah svarna shukram tanvanta a rajah |
surashchidashvanyuyujana iyate vishvan anu svadhaya chetathaspathah ||
verses.en:
The rays advancing nigh, chasing with day the gloom, spread through the firmament bright radiance like the Sun;
And the Sun harnessing his horses goeth forth: ye through your Godlike nature let his paths be known.

verses.sa:
प्र वामवोचमश्विना धियंधा रथः स्वश्वो अजरो यो अस्ति ।
येन सद्यः परि रजांसि याथो हविष्मन्तं तरणिं भोजमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
pra vamavochamashvina dhiyamdha rathah svashvo ajaro yo asti |
yena sadyah pari rajamsi yatho havishmantam taranim bhojamachchha ||
verses.en:
Devout in thought I have declared, O Asvins, your chariot with good steeds, which lasts for ever,
Wherewith ye travel swiftly through the regions to the prompt worshipper who brings oblation.

verses.sa:
अग्रं पिबा मधूनां सुतं वायो दिविष्टिषु ।
त्वं हि पूर्वपा असि ॥
verses.rom:
agram piba madhunam sutam vayo divishtishu |
tvam hi purvapa asi ||
verses.en:
DRINK the best draught of Soma-juice, O Vayu, at our holy rites:
For thou art he who drinketh first.

verses.sa:
शतेना नो अभिष्टिभिर्नियुत्वाँ इन्द्रसारथिः ।
वायो सुतस्य तृम्पतम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatena no abhishtibhirniyutvan indrasarathih |
vayo sutasya trimpatam ||
verses.en:
Come, team-drawn, with thy hundred helps, with Indra, seated in the car,
Vaya, and drink your fill of juice.

verses.sa:
आ वां सहस्रं हरय इन्द्रवायू अभि प्रयः ।
वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a vam sahasram haraya indravayu abhi prayah |
vahantu somapitaye ||
verses.en:
May steeds a thousand bring you both, Indra. and Vayu, hitherward
To drink the Soma, to the feagt.

verses.sa:
रथं हिरण्यवन्धुरमिन्द्रवायू स्वध्वरम् ।
आ हि स्थाथो दिविस्पृशम् ॥
verses.rom:
ratham hiranyavandhuramindravayu svadhvaram |
a hi sthatho divisprisham ||
verses.en:
For ye, O Indra-Vayu, mount the golden seated car that aids
The sacrifice, that reaches heaven.

verses.sa:
रथेन पृथुपाजसा दाश्वांसमुप गच्छतम् ।
इन्द्रवायू इहा गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
rathena prithupajasa dashvamsamupa gachchhatam |
indravayu iha gatam ||
verses.en:
On far-refulgent chariot come unto the man who offers gifts:
Come, Indra-Vayu, hitherward.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रवायू अयं सुतस्तं देवेभिः सजोषसा ।
पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
indravayu ayam sutastam devebhih sajoshasa |
pibatam dashusho grihe ||
verses.en:
Here, Indra-Vayu, is the juice: drink it, accordant with the Gods,
Within the giver's dwelling-place.

verses.sa:
इह प्रयाणमस्तु वामिन्द्रवायू विमोचनम् ।
इह वां सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
iha prayanamastu vamindravayu vimochanam |
iha vam somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Hither, O Indra-Vayu, be your journey here unyoke your steeds,
Here for your draught of Soma juice.

verses.sa:
वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते मध्वो अग्रं दिविष्टिषु ।
आ याहि सोमपीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्वता ॥
verses.rom:
vayo shukro ayami te madhvo agram divishtishu |
a yahi somapitaye sparho deva niyutvata ||
verses.en:
Vayu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath at holy rites.
Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God, longed-for, on thy team-drawn car.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्च वायवेषां सोमानां पीतिमर्हथः ।
युवां हि यन्तीन्दवो निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक् ॥
verses.rom:
indrashcha vayavesham somanam pitimarhathah |
yuvam hi yantindavo nimnamapo na sadhryak ||
verses.en:
O Vayu, thou and Indra are meet drinkers of these Soma-draughts,
For unto you the drops proceed as waters gather to the vale.

verses.sa:
वायविन्द्रश्च शुष्मिणा सरथं शवसस्पती ।
नियुत्वन्ता न ऊतय आ यातं सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
vayavindrashcha shushmina saratham shavasaspati |
niyutvanta na utaya a yatam somapitaye ||
verses.en:
O Indra-Vayu, mighty Twain, speeding together, Lords of Strength,
Come to our succour with your team, that ye may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
या वां सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा ।
अस्मे ता यज्ञवाहसेन्द्रवायू नि यच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya vam santi puruspriho niyuto dashushe nara |
asme ta yajnavahasendravayu ni yachchhatam ||
verses.en:
The longed-for teams which ye possess, O Heroes, for the worshipper,
Turn to us, Indra-Vayu, ye to whom the sacrifice is paid.

verses.sa:
विहि होत्रा अवीता विपो न रायो अर्यः ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
vihi hotra avita vipo na rayo aryah |
vayava chandrena rathena yahi sutasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
TASTE offerings never tasted yet, as bards enjoy the foeman's wealth.
O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.

verses.sa:
निर्युवाणो अशस्तीर्नियुत्वाँ इन्द्रसारथिः ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
niryuvano ashastirniyutvan indrasarathih |
vayava chandrena rathena yahi sutasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Removing curses, drawn by teams, with Indra, seated by thy side,
O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.

verses.sa:
अनु कृष्णे वसुधिती येमाते विश्वपेशसा ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
anu krishne vasudhiti yemate vishvapeshasa |
vayava chandrena rathena yahi sutasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
The two dark treasuries of wealth that wear all beauties wait on thee.
O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.

verses.sa:
वहन्तु त्वा मनोयुजो युक्तासो नवतिर्नव ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
vahantu tva manoyujo yuktaso navatirnava |
vayava chandrena rathena yahi sutasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
May nine-and-ninety harnessed steeds who yoke them at thy will bring thee.
O Vayu, on refulgent car come to the drinking of the juice.

verses.sa:
वायो शतं हरीणां युवस्व पोष्याणाम् ।
उत वा ते सहस्रिणो रथ आ यातु पाजसा ॥
verses.rom:
vayo shatam harinam yuvasva poshyanam |
uta va te sahasrino ratha a yatu pajasa ||
verses.en:
Harness, O Vayu, to thy car a hundred well-fed tawny steeds,
Yea, or a thousand steeds, and let thy chariot come to us with might.

verses.sa:
इदं वामास्ये हविः प्रियमिन्द्राबृहस्पती ।
उक्थं मदश्च शस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
idam vamasye havih priyamindrabrihaspati |
uktham madashcha shasyate ||
verses.en:
DEAR is this offering in your mouth, O Indra and Brhaspati:
Famed is the laud, the gladdening draught.

verses.sa:
अयं वां परि षिच्यते सोम इन्द्राबृहस्पती ।
चारुर्मदाय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vam pari shichyate soma indrabrihaspati |
charurmadaya pitaye ||
verses.en:
This lovely Soma is effused, O Indra and Brhaspati,
For you, to drink it and rejoice.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्द्राबृहस्पती गृहमिन्द्रश्च गच्छतम् ।
सोमपा सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a na indrabrihaspati grihamindrashcha gachchhatam |
somapa somapitaye ||
verses.en:
As Soma-drinkers to our house come,
Indra and Brhaspati-and Indra-to drink Soma juice.

verses.sa:
अस्मे इन्द्राबृहस्पती रयिं धत्तं शतग्विनम् ।
अश्वावन्तं सहस्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
asme indrabrihaspati rayim dhattam shatagvinam |
ashvavantam sahasrinam ||
verses.en:
Vouchsafe us riches hundredfold, O Indra, and Brhaspati,
With store of horses, thousandfold.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राबृहस्पती वयं सुते गीर्भिर्हवामहे ।
अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
indrabrihaspati vayam sute girbhirhavamahe |
asya somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
O Indra. and Brhaspati, we call you when the meath is shed,
With songs, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
सोममिन्द्राबृहस्पती पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे ।
मादयेथां तदोकसा ॥
verses.rom:
somamindrabrihaspati pibatam dashusho grihe |
madayetham tadokasa ||
verses.en:
Drink, Indra and Brhaspati, the Soma in the giver's house:
Delight yourselves abiding there.

verses.sa:
यस्तस्तम्भ सहसा वि ज्मो अन्तान्बृहस्पतिस्त्रिषधस्थो रवेण ।
तं प्रत्नास ऋषयो दीध्यानाः पुरो विप्रा दधिरे मन्द्रजिह्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
yastastambha sahasa vi jmo antanbrihaspatistrishadhastho ravena |
tam pratnasa rishayo didhyanah puro vipra dadhire mandrajihvam ||
verses.en:
Him who with might hath propped earth's ends, who sitteth in threefold seat, Brhaspati, with thunder,
Him of the pleasant tongue have ancient sages, deep-thinking, holy singers, set before them.

verses.sa:
धुनेतयः सुप्रकेतं मदन्तो बृहस्पते अभि ये नस्ततस्रे ।
पृषन्तं सृप्रमदब्धमूर्वं बृहस्पते रक्षतादस्य योनिम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhunetayah supraketam madanto brihaspate abhi ye nastatasre |
prishantam sripramadabdhamurvam brihaspate rakshatadasya yonim ||
verses.en:
Wild in their course, in well-marked wise rejoicing were they, Brhaspati, who pressed around us.
Preserve Brhaspati, the stall uninjured, this company's raining, ever-moving birthplace.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते या परमा परावदत आ त ऋतस्पृशो नि षेदुः ।
तुभ्यं खाता अवता अद्रिदुग्धा मध्व श्चोतन्त्यभितो विरप्शम् ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate ya parama paravadata a ta ritasprisho ni sheduh |
tubhyam khata avata adridugdha madhva shchotantyabhito virapsham ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati, from thy remotest distance have they sat down who love the law eternal.
For thee were dug wells springing from the mountain, which murmuring round about pour streams of sweetness.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः प्रथमं जायमानो महो ज्योतिषः परमे व्योमन् ।
सप्तास्यस्तुविजातो रवेण वि सप्तरश्मिरधमत्तमांसि ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatih prathamam jayamano maho jyotishah parame vyoman |
saptasyastuvijato ravena vi saptarashmiradhamattamamsi ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati, when first he had his being from mighty splendour in supremest heaven,
Strong, with his sevenfold mouth, with noise of thunder, with his seven rays, blew and dispersed the darkness.

verses.sa:
स सुष्टुभा स ऋक्वता गणेन वलं रुरोज फलिगं रवेण ।
बृहस्पतिरुस्रिया हव्यसूदः कनिक्रदद्वावशतीरुदाजत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa sushtubha sa rikvata ganena valam ruroja phaligam ravena |
brihaspatirusriya havyasudah kanikradadvavashatirudajat ||
verses.en:
With the loud-shouting band who sang his praises, with thunder, he destroyed obstructive Vala.
Brhaspati thundering drave forth the cattle, the lowing cows who make oblations ready.

verses.sa:
एवा पित्रे विश्वदेवाय वृष्णे यज्ञैर्विधेम नमसा हविर्भिः ।
बृहस्पते सुप्रजा वीरवन्तो वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva pitre vishvadevaya vrishne yajnairvidhema namasa havirbhih |
brihaspate supraja viravanto vayam syama patayo rayinam ||
verses.en:
Serve we with sacrifices, gifts, and homage even thus the Steer of all the Gods, the Father.
Brhaspati, may we be lords of riches, with noble progeny and store of heroes.

verses.sa:
स इद्राजा प्रतिजन्यानि विश्वा शुष्मेण तस्थावभि वीर्येण ।
बृहस्पतिं यः सुभृतं बिभर्ति वल्गूयति वन्दते पूर्वभाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa idraja pratijanyani vishva shushmena tasthavabhi viryena |
brihaspatim yah subhritam bibharti valguyati vandate purvabhajam ||
verses.en:
Surely that King by power and might heroic hath made him lord of all his foes' posses-ions,
Who cherishes Brhaspati well-tended, adorns and worships him as foremost sharer.

verses.sa:
स इत्क्षेति सुधित ओकसि स्वे तस्मा इळा पिन्वते विश्वदानीम् ।
तस्मै विशः स्वयमेवा नमन्ते यस्मिन्ब्रह्मा राजनि पूर्व एति ॥
verses.rom:
sa itksheti sudhita okasi sve tasma ila pinvate vishvadanim |
tasmai vishah svayameva namante yasminbrahma rajani purva eti ||
verses.en:
In his own house he dwells in peace and comfort: to him for ever holy food flows richly.
To him the people with free will pay homage-the King with whom the Brahman hatb precedence.

verses.sa:
अप्रतीतो जयति सं धनानि प्रतिजन्यान्युत या सजन्या ।
अवस्यवे यो वरिवः कृणोति ब्रह्मणे राजा तमवन्ति देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
apratito jayati sam dhanani pratijanyanyuta ya sajanya |
avasyave yo varivah krinoti brahmane raja tamavanti devah ||
verses.en:
He, unopposed, is master of the riches of his own subjects and of hostile people.
The Gods uphold that King with their protection who helps the Brahman when he seeks his favour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्च सोमं पिबतं बृहस्पतेऽस्मिन्यज्ञे मन्दसाना वृषण्वसू ।
आ वां विशन्त्विन्दवः स्वाभुवोऽस्मे रयिं सर्ववीरं नि यच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrashcha somam pibatam brihaspate'sminyajne mandasana vrishanvasu |
a vam vishantvindavah svabhuvo'sme rayim sarvaviram ni yachchhatam ||
verses.en:
Indra, Brhaspati, rainers of treasure, rejoicing at this sacrifice drink the Soma.
Let the abundant drops sink deep within you: vouchsafe us riches with full store of heroes.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पत इन्द्र वर्धतं नः सचा सा वां सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ।
अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्जजस्तमर्यो वनुषामरातीः ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspata indra vardhatam nah sacha sa vam sumatirbhutvasme |
avishtam dhiyo jigritam puramdhirjajastamaryo vanushamaratih ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati and Indra, make us prosper may this be your benevolence to usward.
Assist our holy thoughts, wake up our spirit: weaken the hatred of our foe and rivals.

verses.sa:
इदमु त्यत्पुरुतमं पुरस्ताज्ज्योतिस्तमसो वयुनावदस्थात् ।
नूनं दिवो दुहितरो विभातीर्गातुं कृणवन्नुषसो जनाय ॥
verses.rom:
idamu tyatpurutamam purastajjyotistamaso vayunavadasthat |
nunam divo duhitaro vibhatirgatum krinavannushaso janaya ||
verses.en:
FORTH from the darkness in the region eastward this most abundant splendid light hath mounted.
Now verily the far-refulgent Mornings, Daughters of Heaven, bring welfare to the people.

verses.sa:
अस्थुरु चित्रा उषसः पुरस्तान्मिता इव स्वरवोऽध्वरेषु ।
व्यू व्रजस्य तमसो द्वारोच्छन्तीरव्रञ्छुचयः पावकाः ॥
verses.rom:
asthuru chitra ushasah purastanmita iva svaravo'dhvareshu |
vyu vrajasya tamaso dvarochchhantiravranchhuchayah pavakah ||
verses.en:
The richly-coloured Dawns have mounted eastward, like pillars planted at our sacrifices,
And, flushing far, splendid and purifying, unbarred the portals of the fold of darkness.

verses.sa:
उच्छन्तीरद्य चितयन्त भोजान्राधोदेयायोषसो मघोनीः ।
अचित्रे अन्तः पणयः ससन्त्वबुध्यमानास्तमसो विमध्ये ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhantiradya chitayanta bhojanradhodeyayoshaso maghonih |
achitre antah panayah sasantvabudhyamanastamaso vimadhye ||
verses.en:
Dispelling gloom this day the wealthy Mornings urge liberal givers to present their treasures.
In the unlightened depth of darkness round them let niggard traffickers sleep unawakened.

verses.sa:
कुवित्स देवीः सनयो नवो वा यामो बभूयादुषसो वो अद्य ।
येना नवग्वे अङ्गिरे दशग्वे सप्तास्ये रेवती रेवदूष ॥
verses.rom:
kuvitsa devih sanayo navo va yamo babhuyadushaso vo adya |
yena navagve angire dashagve saptasye revati revadusha ||
verses.en:
O Goddesses, is this your car, I ask you, ancient this day, or is it new, ye Mornings,
Wherewith, rich Dawns, ye seek with wealth Navagva, Dasagva Angira, the seven-toned singer?

verses.sa:
यूयं हि देवीरृतयुग्भिरश्वैः परिप्रयाथ भुवनानि सद्यः ।
प्रबोधयन्तीरुषसः ससन्तं द्विपाच्चतुष्पाच्चरथाय जीवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam hi devirritayugbhirashvaih pariprayatha bhuvanani sadyah |
prabodhayantirushasah sasantam dvipachchatushpachcharathaya jivam ||
verses.en:
With horses harnessed by eternal Order, Goddesses, swiftly round the worlds ye travel,
Arousing from their rest, O Dawns, the sleeping, and all that lives, man, bird, and beast, to motion.

verses.sa:
क्व स्विदासां कतमा पुराणी यया विधाना विदधुरृभूणाम् ।
शुभं यच्छुभ्रा उषसश्चरन्ति न वि ज्ञायन्ते सदृशीरजुर्याः ॥
verses.rom:
kva svidasam katama purani yaya vidhana vidadhurribhunam |
shubham yachchhubhra ushasashcharanti na vi jnayante sadrishirajuryah ||
verses.en:
Which among these is eldest, and where is she through whom they fixed the Rbhus' regulations?
What time the splendid Dawns go forth for splendour, they are not known apart alike, unwasting.

verses.sa:
ता घा ता भद्रा उषसः पुरासुरभिष्टिद्युम्ना ऋतजातसत्याः ।
यास्वीजानः शशमान उक्थै स्तुवञ्छंसन्द्रविणं सद्य आप ॥
verses.rom:
ta gha ta bhadra ushasah purasurabhishtidyumna ritajatasatyah |
yasvijanah shashamana ukthai stuvanchhamsandravinam sadya apa ||
verses.en:
Blest were these Dawns of old, shining with succour, true with the truth that springs from holy Order;
With whom the toiling worshipper, by praises, hymning and lauding, soon attained to riches.

verses.sa:
ता आ चरन्ति समना पुरस्तात्समानतः समना पप्रथानाः ।
ऋतस्य देवीः सदसो बुधाना गवां न सर्गा उषसो जरन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
ta a charanti samana purastatsamanatah samana paprathanah |
ritasya devih sadaso budhana gavam na sarga ushaso jarante ||
verses.en:
Hither from eastward all at once they travel, from one place spreading in the selfsame manner.
Awaking, from the seat of holy Order the Godlike Dawns come nigh like troops of cattle.

verses.sa:
ता इन्न्वेव समना समानीरमीतवर्णा उषसश्चरन्ति ।
गूहन्तीरभ्वमसितं रुशद्भिः शुक्रास्तनूभिः शुचयो रुचानाः ॥
verses.rom:
ta innveva samana samaniramitavarna ushasashcharanti |
guhantirabhvamasitam rushadbhih shukrastanubhih shuchayo ruchanah ||
verses.en:
Thus they go forth with undiminished colours, these Mornings similar, in self-same fashion,
Concealing the gigantic might of darkness with radiant bodies bright and pure and shining.

verses.sa:
रयिं दिवो दुहितरो विभातीः प्रजावन्तं यच्छतास्मासु देवीः ।
स्योनादा वः प्रतिबुध्यमानाः सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
rayim divo duhitaro vibhatih prajavantam yachchhatasmasu devih |
syonada vah pratibudhyamanah suviryasya patayah syama ||
verses.en:
O Goddesses, O Heaven's refulgent Daughters, bestow upon us wealth with store of children.
As from our pleasant place of rest ye rouse us may we be masters of heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
तद्वो दिवो दुहितरो विभातीरुप ब्रुव उषसो यज्ञकेतुः ।
वयं स्याम यशसो जनेषु तद्द्यौश्च धत्तां पृथिवी च देवी ॥
verses.rom:
tadvo divo duhitaro vibhatirupa bruva ushaso yajnaketuh |
vayam syama yashaso janeshu taddyaushcha dhattam prithivi cha devi ||
verses.en:
Well-skilled in lore of sacrifice, ye Daughters of Heaven, refulgent Dawns, I thus address you.
May we be glorious among the people. May Heaven vouchsafe us this, and Earth the Goddess,

verses.sa:
प्रति ष्या सूनरी जनी व्युच्छन्ती परि स्वसुः ।
दिवो अदर्शि दुहिता ॥
verses.rom:
prati shya sunari jani vyuchchhanti pari svasuh |
divo adarshi duhita ||
verses.en:
THIS Lady, giver of delight, after her Sister shining forth,
Daughter of Heaven, hath shown herself.-

verses.sa:
अश्वेव चित्रारुषी माता गवामृतावरी ।
सखाभूदश्विनोरुषाः ॥
verses.rom:
ashveva chitrarushi mata gavamritavari |
sakhabhudashvinorushah ||
verses.en:
Unfailing, Mother of the Kine, in colour like a bright red mare,
The Dawn became the Asvins' Friend.

verses.sa:
उत सखास्यश्विनोरुत माता गवामसि ।
उतोषो वस्व ईशिषे ॥
verses.rom:
uta sakhasyashvinoruta mata gavamasi |
utosho vasva ishishe ||
verses.en:
Yea, and thou art the Asvins' Friend, the Mother of the Kine art thou:
O Dawn thou rulest over wealth.

verses.sa:
यावयद्द्वेषसं त्वा चिकित्वित्सूनृतावरि ।
प्रति स्तोमैरभुत्स्महि ॥
verses.rom:
yavayaddveshasam tva chikitvitsunritavari |
prati stomairabhutsmahi ||
verses.en:
Thinking of thee, O joyous One, as her who driveth hate away,
We woke to meet thee with our lauds.

verses.sa:
प्रति भद्रा अदृक्षत गवां सर्गा न रश्मयः ।
ओषा अप्रा उरु ज्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
prati bhadra adrikshata gavam sarga na rashmayah |
osha apra uru jrayah ||
verses.en:
Our eyes behold thy blessed rays like troops of cattle loosed to feed.
Dawn hath filled full the wide expanse.

verses.sa:
आपप्रुषी विभावरि व्यावर्ज्योतिषा तमः ।
उषो अनु स्वधामव ॥
verses.rom:
apaprushi vibhavari vyavarjyotisha tamah |
usho anu svadhamava ||
verses.en:
When thou hast filled it, Fulgent One! thou layest bare the gloom with light.
After thy nature aid us, Dawn.

verses.sa:
आ द्यां तनोषि रश्मिभिरान्तरिक्षमुरु प्रियम् ।
उषः शुक्रेण शोचिषा ॥
verses.rom:
a dyam tanoshi rashmibhirantarikshamuru priyam |
ushah shukrena shochisha ||
verses.en:
Thou overspreadest heaven with rays, the dear wide region of mid-air.
With thy bright shining lustre, Dawn.

verses.sa:
तद्देवस्य सवितुर्वार्यं महद्वृणीमहे असुरस्य प्रचेतसः ।
छर्दिर्येन दाशुषे यच्छति त्मना तन्नो महाँ उदयान्देवो अक्तुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
taddevasya saviturvaryam mahadvrinimahe asurasya prachetasah |
chhardiryena dashushe yachchhati tmana tanno mahan udayandevo aktubhih ||
verses.en:
OF Savitar the God, the sapient Asura, we crave this great gift which is worthy of our choice,
Wherewith he freely grants his worshiper defense. This with his rays the Great God hath vouchsafed to us.

verses.sa:
दिवो धर्ता भुवनस्य प्रजापतिः पिशङ्गं द्रापिं प्रति मुञ्चते कविः ।
विचक्षणः प्रथयन्नापृणन्नुर्वजीजनत्सविता सुम्नमुक्थ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
divo dharta bhuvanasya prajapatih pishangam drapim prati munchate kavih |
vichakshanah prathayannaprinannurvajijanatsavita sumnamukthyam ||
verses.en:
Sustainer of the heaven, Lord of the whole world's life, the Sage, he putteth on his golden-coloured mail.
Clear-sighted, spreading far, filling the spacious realm, Savitar hath brought forth bliss that deserveth laud.

verses.sa:
आप्रा रजांसि दिव्यानि पार्थिवा श्लोकं देवः कृणुते स्वाय धर्मणे ।
प्र बाहू अस्राक्सविता सवीमनि निवेशयन्प्रसुवन्नक्तुभिर्जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
apra rajamsi divyani parthiva shlokam devah krinute svaya dharmane |
pra bahu asraksavita savimani niveshayanprasuvannaktubhirjagat ||
verses.en:
He hath filled full the regions of the heaven and earth: the God for his own strengthening waketh up the hymn.
Savitar hath stretched out his arms to cherish life, producing with his rays and lulling all that moves.

verses.sa:
अदाभ्यो भुवनानि प्रचाकशद्व्रतानि देवः सविताभि रक्षते ।
प्रास्राग्बाहू भुवनस्य प्रजाभ्यो धृतव्रतो महो अज्मस्य राजति ॥
verses.rom:
adabhyo bhuvanani prachakashadvratani devah savitabhi rakshate |
prasragbahu bhuvanasya prajabhyo dhritavrato maho ajmasya rajati ||
verses.en:
Lighting all living creatures, ne'er to be deceived, Savitar, God, protects each holy ordinance.
He hath stretched out his arms to all the folk of earth, and, with his laws observed, rules his own mighty course.

verses.sa:
त्रिरन्तरिक्षं सविता महित्वना त्री रजांसि परिभुस्त्रीणि रोचना ।
तिस्रो दिवः पृथिवीस्तिस्र इन्वति त्रिभिर्व्रतैरभि नो रक्षति त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
trirantariksham savita mahitvana tri rajamsi paribhustrini rochana |
tisro divah prithivistisra invati tribhirvratairabhi no rakshati tmana ||
verses.en:
Savitar thrice surrounding with his mightiness mid-air, three regions, and the triple sphere of light,
Sets the three heavens in motion and the threefold earth, and willingly protects us with his triple law.

verses.sa:
बृहत्सुम्नः प्रसवीता निवेशनो जगत स्थातुरुभयस्य यो वशी ।
स नो देवः सविता शर्म यच्छत्वस्मे क्षयाय त्रिवरूथमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
brihatsumnah prasavita niveshano jagata sthaturubhayasya yo vashi |
sa no devah savita sharma yachchhatvasme kshayaya trivaruthamamhasah ||
verses.en:
Most gracious God, who brings to life and lulls to rest, he who controls the world, what moves not and what moves,
May he vouchsafe us shelter, -Savitar the God,- for tranquil life, with triple bar against distress.

verses.sa:
आगन्देव ऋतुभिर्वर्धतु क्षयं दधातु नः सविता सुप्रजामिषम् ।
स नः क्षपाभिरहभिश्च जिन्वतु प्रजावन्तं रयिमस्मे समिन्वतु ॥
verses.rom:
agandeva ritubhirvardhatu kshayam dadhatu nah savita suprajamisham |
sa nah kshapabhirahabhishcha jinvatu prajavantam rayimasme saminvatu ||
verses.en:
With the year's seasons hath Savitar, God, come nigh: may he prosper our home, give food and noble sons.
May he invigorate us through the days and nights, and may he send us opulence with progeny.

verses.sa:
अभूद्देवः सविता वन्द्यो नु न इदानीमह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः ।
वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणं यथा दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
abhuddevah savita vandyo nu na idanimahna upavachyo nribhih |
vi yo ratna bhajati manavebhyah shreshtham no atra dravinam yatha dadhat ||
verses.en:
Now must we praise and honour Savitar the God: at this time of the day the men must call to him,
Him who distributes wealth to Manu's progeny, that he may grant us here riches most excellent.

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यो हि प्रथमं यज्ञियेभ्योऽमृतत्वं सुवसि भागमुत्तमम् ।
आदिद्दामानं सवितर्व्यूर्णुषेऽनूचीना जीविता मानुषेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
devebhyo hi prathamam yajniyebhyo'mritatvam suvasi bhagamuttamam |
adiddamanam savitarvyurnushe'nuchina jivita manushebhyah ||
verses.en:
For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of all portions, immortality:
Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence, life succeeding life.

verses.sa:
अचित्ती यच्चकृमा दैव्ये जने दीनैर्दक्षैः प्रभूती पूरुषत्वता ।
देवेषु च सवितर्मानुषेषु च त्वं नो अत्र सुवतादनागसः ॥
verses.rom:
achitti yachchakrima daivye jane dinairdakshaih prabhuti purushatvata |
deveshu cha savitarmanusheshu cha tvam no atra suvatadanagasah ||
verses.en:
If we, men as we are, have sinned against the Gods through want of thought, in weakness, or through insolence,
Absolve us from the guilt and make us free from sin, O Savitar, alike among both Gods and men.

verses.sa:
न प्रमिये सवितुर्दैव्यस्य तद्यथा विश्वं भुवनं धारयिष्यति ।
यत्पृथिव्या वरिमन्ना स्वङ्गुरिर्वर्ष्मन्दिवः सुवति सत्यमस्य तत् ॥
verses.rom:
na pramiye saviturdaivyasya tadyatha vishvam bhuvanam dharayishyati |
yatprithivya varimanna svangurirvarshmandivah suvati satyamasya tat ||
verses.en:
None may impede that power of Savitar the God whereby he will maintain the universal world.
What the fair-fingered God brings forth on earth's expanse or in the height of heaven, that work of his stands sure.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रज्येष्ठान्बृहद्भ्यः पर्वतेभ्यः क्षयाँ एभ्यः सुवसि पस्त्यावतः ।
यथायथा पतयन्तो वियेमिर एवैव तस्थुः सवितः सवाय ते ॥
verses.rom:
indrajyeshthanbrihadbhyah parvatebhyah kshayan ebhyah suvasi pastyavatah |
yathayatha patayanto viyemira evaiva tasthuh savitah savaya te ||
verses.en:
To lofty hills thou sendest those whom Indra leads, and givest fixed abodes with houses unto these.
However they may fly and draw themselves apart, still, Savitar, they stand obeying thy behest.

verses.sa:
ये ते त्रिरहन्सवितः सवासो दिवेदिवे सौभगमासुवन्ति ।
इन्द्रो द्यावापृथिवी सिन्धुरद्भिरादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यंसत् ॥
verses.rom:
ye te trirahansavitah savaso divedive saubhagamasuvanti |
indro dyavaprithivi sindhuradbhiradityairno aditih sharma yamsat ||
verses.en:
May the libations poured to thee thrice daily, day after day, O Savitar, bring us blessing.
May Indra, Heaven, Earth, Sindhu with the Waters, Aditi with Adityas, give us shelter.

verses.sa:
को वस्त्राता वसवः को वरूता द्यावाभूमी अदिते त्रासीथां नः ।
सहीयसो वरुण मित्र मर्तात्को वोऽध्वरे वरिवो धाति देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
ko vastrata vasavah ko varuta dyavabhumi adite trasitham nah |
sahiyaso varuna mitra martatko vo'dhvare varivo dhati devah ||
verses.en:
WHO of you, Vasus, saveth? who protecteth? O Heaven and Earth and Aditi, preserve us,
Varuna., Mitra, from the stronger mortal. Gods, which of you at sacrifice giveth comfort?

verses.sa:
प्र ये धामानि पूर्व्याण्यर्चान्वि यदुच्छान्वियोतारो अमूराः ।
विधातारो वि ते दधुरजस्रा ऋतधीतयो रुरुचन्त दस्माः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye dhamani purvyanyarchanvi yaduchchhanviyotaro amurah |
vidhataro vi te dadhurajasra ritadhitayo ruruchanta dasmah ||
verses.en:
They who with laud extol the ancient statutes, when they shine forth infallible dividers,
Have ordered as perpetual Ordainers, and beamed as holy-thoughted WonderWorkers.

verses.sa:
प्र पस्त्यामदितिं सिन्धुमर्कैः स्वस्तिमीळे सख्याय देवीम् ।
उभे यथा नो अहनी निपात उषासानक्ता करतामदब्धे ॥
verses.rom:
pra pastyamaditim sindhumarkaih svastimile sakhyaya devim |
ubhe yatha no ahani nipata ushasanakta karatamadabdhe ||
verses.en:
The Housewife Goddess, Aditi, and Sindhu, the Goddess Svasti I implore for friendship:
And may the unobstructed Night and Morning both, day and night, provide for our protection.

verses.sa:
व्यर्यमा वरुणश्चेति पन्थामिषस्पतिः सुवितं गातुमग्निः ।
इन्द्राविष्णू नृवदु षु स्तवाना शर्म नो यन्तममवद्वरूथम् ॥
verses.rom:
vyaryama varunashcheti panthamishaspatih suvitam gatumagnih |
indravishnu nrivadu shu stavana sharma no yantamamavadvarutham ||
verses.en:
Aryaman, Varuna have disclosed the pathway, Agni as Lord of Strength the road to welfare.
Lauded in manly mode may Indra-Visnu grant us their powerful defense and shelter.

verses.sa:
आ पर्वतस्य मरुतामवांसि देवस्य त्रातुरव्रि भगस्य ।
पात्पतिर्जन्यादंहसो नो मित्रो मित्रियादुत न उरुष्येत् ॥
verses.rom:
a parvatasya marutamavamsi devasya traturavri bhagasya |
patpatirjanyadamhaso no mitro mitriyaduta na urushyet ||
verses.en:
I have besought the favourof the Maruts, of Parvata, of Bhaga God who rescues.
From trouble caused by man the Lord preserve us; from woe sent by his friend let Mitra save us.

verses.sa:
नू रोदसी अहिना बुध्न्येन स्तुवीत देवी अप्येभिरिष्टैः ।
समुद्रं न संचरणे सनिष्यवो घर्मस्वरसो नद्यो अप व्रन् ॥
verses.rom:
nu rodasi ahina budhnyena stuvita devi apyebhirishtaih |
samudram na samcharane sanishyavo gharmasvaraso nadyo apa vran ||
verses.en:
Agree, through these our watery oblations, Goddesses, Heaven and Earth, with Ahibudhnya.
As if to win the sea, the Gharma-heaters have opened, as they come anear, the rivers.

verses.sa:
देवैर्नो देव्यदितिर्नि पातु देवस्त्राता त्रायतामप्रयुच्छन् ।
नहि मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धासिमर्हामसि प्रमियं सान्वग्नेः ॥
verses.rom:
devairno devyaditirni patu devastrata trayatamaprayuchchhan |
nahi mitrasya varunasya dhasimarhamasi pramiyam sanvagneh ||
verses.en:
May Goddess Aditi with Gods defend us, save us the saviour God with care unceasing.
We dare not stint the sacred food of Mitra and Varuna upon the back of Agni.

verses.sa:
अग्निरीशे वसव्यस्याग्निर्महः सौभगस्य ।
तान्यस्मभ्यं रासते ॥
verses.rom:
agnirishe vasavyasyagnirmahah saubhagasya |
tanyasmabhyam rasate ||
verses.en:
Agni is Sovran Lord of wealth, Agni of great prosperity:
May he bestow these gifts on us.

verses.sa:
उषो मघोन्या वह सूनृते वार्या पुरु ।
अस्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति ॥
verses.rom:
usho maghonya vaha sunrite varya puru |
asmabhyam vajinivati ||
verses.en:
Hither to us, rich pleasant Dawn, bring many things to be desired,
Thou who hast ample store of wealth.

verses.sa:
तत्सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
इन्द्रो नो राधसा गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
tatsu nah savita bhago varuno mitro aryama |
indro no radhasa gamat ||
verses.en: So then may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Indra, with bounty come to us.

verses.sa:
मही द्यावापृथिवी इह ज्येष्ठे रुचा भवतां शुचयद्भिरर्कैः ।
यत्सीं वरिष्ठे बृहती विमिन्वन्रुवद्धोक्षा पप्रथानेभिरेवैः ॥
verses.rom:
mahi dyavaprithivi iha jyeshthe rucha bhavatam shuchayadbhirarkaih |
yatsim varishthe brihati viminvanruvaddhoksha paprathanebhirevaih ||
verses.en:
MAY mighty Heaven and Earth, most meet for honour, be present here with light and gleaming splendours;
When, fixing them apart, vast, most extensive, the Steer roars loudly in far-reaching courses.

verses.sa:
देवी देवेभिर्यजते यजत्रैरमिनती तस्थतुरुक्षमाणे ।
ऋतावरी अद्रुहा देवपुत्रे यज्ञस्य नेत्री शुचयद्भिरर्कैः ॥
verses.rom:
devi devebhiryajate yajatrairaminati tasthaturukshamane |
ritavari adruha devaputre yajnasya netri shuchayadbhirarkaih ||
verses.en:
The Goddesses with Gods, holy with holy, the Two stand pouring out their rain, exhaustless:
Faithful and guileless, having Gods for children, leaders of sacrifice with shining splendours.

verses.sa:
स इत्स्वपा भुवनेष्वास य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जजान ।
उर्वी गभीरे रजसी सुमेके अवंशे धीरः शच्या समैरत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa itsvapa bhuvaneshvasa ya ime dyavaprithivi jajana |
urvi gabhire rajasi sumeke avamshe dhirah shachya samairat ||
verses.en:
Sure in the worlds he was a skillful Craftsman, he who produced these Twain the Earth and Heaven.
Wise, with his power he brought both realms, together spacious and deep, wellfashioned, unsupported.

verses.sa:
नू रोदसी बृहद्भिर्नो वरूथैः पत्नीवद्भिरिषयन्ती सजोषाः ।
उरूची विश्वे यजते नि पातं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu rodasi brihadbhirno varuthaih patnivadbhirishayanti sajoshah |
uruchi vishve yajate ni patam dhiya syama rathyah sadasah ||
verses.en:
O Heaven and Earth, with one accord promoting, with high protection as of Queens, our welfare,
Far-reaching, universal, holy, guard us. May we, car-borne, through song be victors ever.

verses.sa:
प्र वां महि द्यवी अभ्युपस्तुतिं भरामहे ।
शुची उप प्रशस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
pra vam mahi dyavi abhyupastutim bharamahe |
shuchi upa prashastaye ||
verses.en:
To both of you, O Heaven and Earth, we bring our lofty song of praise,
Pure Ones! to glorify you both.

verses.sa:
पुनाने तन्वा मिथः स्वेन दक्षेण राजथः ।
ऊह्याथे सनादृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
punane tanva mithah svena dakshena rajathah |
uhyathe sanadritam ||
verses.en:
Ye sanctify each other's form, by your own proper might ye rule,
And from of old observe the Law.

verses.sa:
मही मित्रस्य साधथस्तरन्ती पिप्रती ऋतम् ।
परि यज्ञं नि षेदथुः ॥
verses.rom:
mahi mitrasya sadhathastaranti piprati ritam |
pari yajnam ni shedathuh ||
verses.en:
Furthering and fulfilling, ye, O Mighty, perfect Mitra's Law.
Ye sit around our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रस्य पतिना वयं हितेनेव जयामसि ।
गामश्वं पोषयित्न्वा स नो मृळातीदृशे ॥
verses.rom:
kshetrasya patina vayam hiteneva jayamasi |
gamashvam poshayitnva sa no mrilatidrishe ||
verses.en:
WE through the Master of the Field, even as through a friend, obtain
What nourisheth our kine and steeds. In such may he be good to us.

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रस्य पते मधुमन्तमूर्मिं धेनुरिव पयो अस्मासु धुक्ष्व ।
मधुश्चुतं घृतमिव सुपूतमृतस्य नः पतयो मृळयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
kshetrasya pate madhumantamurmim dhenuriva payo asmasu dhukshva |
madhushchutam ghritamiva suputamritasya nah patayo mrilayantu ||
verses.en:
As the cow yieldeth milk, pour for us freely, Lord of the Field, the wave that beareth sweetness,
Distilling meath, well-purified like butter, and let the. Lords of holy Law be gracious.

verses.sa:
मधुमतीरोषधीर्द्याव आपो मधुमन्नो भवत्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
क्षेत्रस्य पतिर्मधुमान्नो अस्त्वरिष्यन्तो अन्वेनं चरेम ॥
verses.rom:
madhumatiroshadhirdyava apo madhumanno bhavatvantariksham |
kshetrasya patirmadhumanno astvarishyanto anvenam charema ||
verses.en:
Sweet be the plants for us. the heavens, the waters, and full of sweets for us be air's mid-region.
May the Field's Lord for us be full of sweetness, and may we follow after him uninjured.

verses.sa:
शुनं वाहाः शुनं नरः शुनं कृषतु लाङ्गलम् ।
शुनं वरत्रा बध्यन्तां शुनमष्ट्रामुदिङ्गय ॥
verses.rom:
shunam vahah shunam narah shunam krishatu langalam |
shunam varatra badhyantam shunamashtramudingaya ||
verses.en:
Happily work our steers and men, may the plough furrow happily.
Happily be the traces bound; happily may he ply the goad.

verses.sa:
शुनासीराविमां वाचं जुषेथां यद्दिवि चक्रथुः पयः ।
तेनेमामुप सिञ्चतम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunasiravimam vacham jushetham yaddivi chakrathuh payah |
tenemamupa sinchatam ||
verses.en:
Suna and Sira, welcome ye this laud, and with the milk which ye have made in heaven
Bedew ye both this earth of ours.

verses.sa:
अर्वाची सुभगे भव सीते वन्दामहे त्वा ।
यथा नः सुभगाससि यथा नः सुफलाससि ॥
verses.rom:
arvachi subhage bhava site vandamahe tva |
yatha nah subhagasasi yatha nah suphalasasi ||
verses.en:
Auspicious Sita, come thou near: we venerate and worship thee
That thou mayst bless and prosper us and bring us fruits abundantly.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सीतां नि गृह्णातु तां पूषानु यच्छतु ।
सा नः पयस्वती दुहामुत्तरामुत्तरां समाम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrah sitam ni grihnatu tam pushanu yachchhatu |
sa nah payasvati duhamuttaramuttaram samam ||
verses.en:
May Indra press the furrow down, may Pusan guide its course aright.
May she, as rich in milk, be drained for us through each succeeding year.

verses.sa:
शुनं नः फाला वि कृषन्तु भूमिं शुनं कीनाशा अभि यन्तु वाहैः ।
शुनं पर्जन्यो मधुना पयोभिः शुनासीरा शुनमस्मासु धत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam nah phala vi krishantu bhumim shunam kinasha abhi yantu vahaih |
shunam parjanyo madhuna payobhih shunasira shunamasmasu dhattam ||
verses.en:
Happily let the shares turn up the ploughland, happily go the ploughers with the oxen.
With meath and milk Parjanya make us happy. Grant us prosperity, Suna and Sira.

verses.sa:
समुद्रादूर्मिर्मधुमाँ उदारदुपांशुना सममृतत्वमानट् ।
घृतस्य नाम गुह्यं यदस्ति जिह्वा देवानाममृतस्य नाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
samudradurmirmadhuman udaradupamshuna samamritatvamanat |
ghritasya nama guhyam yadasti jihva devanamamritasya nabhih ||
verses.en:
FORTH from the ocean sprang the wave of sweetness: together with the stalk it turned to Amrta,
That which is holy oil's mysterious title: but the Gods' tongue is truly Amrta's centre.

verses.sa:
वयं नाम प्र ब्रवामा घृतस्यास्मिन्यज्ञे धारयामा नमोभिः ।
उप ब्रह्मा शृणवच्छस्यमानं चतुःशृङ्गोऽवमीद्गौर एतत् ॥
verses.rom:
vayam nama pra bravama ghritasyasminyajne dharayama namobhih |
upa brahma shrinavachchhasyamanam chatuhshringo'vamidgaura etat ||
verses.en:
Let us declare aloud the name of Ghrta, and at this sacrifice hold it up with homage.
So let the Brahman hear the praise we utter. This hath the four-horned Buffalo emitted.

verses.sa:
चत्वारि शृङ्गा त्रयो अस्य पादा द्वे शीर्षे सप्त हस्तासो अस्य ।
त्रिधा बद्धो वृषभो रोरवीति महो देवो मर्त्याँ आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
chatvari shringa trayo asya pada dve shirshe sapta hastaso asya |
tridha baddho vrishabho roraviti maho devo martyan a vivesha ||
verses.en:
Four are his horns, three are the feet that bear him; his heads are two, his hands are seven in number.
Bound with a triple bond the Steer roars loudly: the mighty God hath entered in to mortals.

verses.sa:
त्रिधा हितं पणिभिर्गुह्यमानं गवि देवासो घृतमन्वविन्दन् ।
इन्द्र एकं सूर्य एकं जजान वेनादेकं स्वधया निष्टतक्षुः ॥
verses.rom:
tridha hitam panibhirguhyamanam gavi devaso ghritamanvavindan |
indra ekam surya ekam jajana venadekam svadhaya nishtatakshuh ||
verses.en:
That oil in triple shape the Gods discovered laid down within the Cow, concealed by Panis.
Indra produced one shape, Surya another: by their own power they formed the third from Vena.

verses.sa:
एता अर्षन्ति हृद्यात्समुद्राच्छतव्रजा रिपुणा नावचक्षे ।
घृतस्य धारा अभि चाकशीमि हिरण्ययो वेतसो मध्य आसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
eta arshanti hridyatsamudrachchhatavraja ripuna navachakshe |
ghritasya dhara abhi chakashimi hiranyayo vetaso madhya asam ||
verses.en:
From inmost reservoir in countless channels flow down these rivers which the foe beholds not.
I look upon the streams of oil descending, and lo! the Golden Reed is there among them.

verses.sa:
सम्यक्स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेना अन्तर्हृदा मनसा पूयमानाः ।
एते अर्षन्त्यूर्मयो घृतस्य मृगा इव क्षिपणोरीषमाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
samyaksravanti sarito na dhena antarhrida manasa puyamanah |
ete arshantyurmayo ghritasya mriga iva kshipanorishamanah ||
verses.en:
Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit.
The streams of holy oil pour swiftly downward like the wild beasts that fly before the bowman.

verses.sa:
सिन्धोरिव प्राध्वने शूघनासो वातप्रमियः पतयन्ति यह्वाः ।
घृतस्य धारा अरुषो न वाजी काष्ठा भिन्दन्नूर्मिभिः पिन्वमानः ॥
verses.rom:
sindhoriva pradhvane shughanaso vatapramiyah patayanti yahvah |
ghritasya dhara arusho na vaji kashtha bhindannurmibhih pinvamanah ||
verses.en:
As rushing down the rapids of a river, flow swifter than the wind the vigorous currents,
The streams of oil in swelling fluctuation like a red courser bursting through the fences.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रवन्त समनेव योषाः कल्याण्यः स्मयमानासो अग्निम् ।
घृतस्य धाराः समिधो नसन्त ता जुषाणो हर्यति जातवेदाः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pravanta samaneva yoshah kalyanyah smayamanaso agnim |
ghritasya dharah samidho nasanta ta jushano haryati jatavedah ||
verses.en:
Like women at a gathering fair to look on and gently smiling, they incline to Agni.
The streams of holy oil attain the fuel, and Jatavedas joyfully receives them.

verses.sa:
कन्या इव वहतुमेतवा उ अञ्ज्यञ्जाना अभि चाकशीमि ।
यत्र सोमः सूयते यत्र यज्ञो घृतस्य धारा अभि तत्पवन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
kanya iva vahatumetava u anjyanjana abhi chakashimi |
yatra somah suyate yatra yajno ghritasya dhara abhi tatpavante ||
verses.en:
As maidens dock themselves with gay adornment to join the bridal feast, I now behold them.
Where Soma flows and sacrifice is ready, thither the streams of holy oil are running.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्षत सुष्टुतिं गव्यमाजिमस्मासु भद्रा द्रविणानि धत्त ।
इमं यज्ञं नयत देवता नो घृतस्य धारा मधुमत्पवन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarshata sushtutim gavyamajimasmasu bhadra dravinani dhatta |
imam yajnam nayata devata no ghritasya dhara madhumatpavante ||
verses.en:
Send to our eulogy a herd of cattle bestow upon us excellent possessions.
Bear to the Gods the sacrifice we offer the streams of oil flow pure and full of sweetness.

verses.sa:
धामन्ते विश्वं भुवनमधि श्रितमन्तः समुद्रे हृद्यन्तरायुषि ।
अपामनीके समिथे य आभृतस्तमश्याम मधुमन्तं त ऊर्मिम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhamante vishvam bhuvanamadhi shritamantah samudre hridyantarayushi |
apamanike samithe ya abhritastamashyama madhumantam ta urmim ||
verses.en: The universe depends upon thy power and might within the sea, within the heart, within all life.
